statement:
theorem isNilpotent_or_isUnit_of_idempotent
    (h : ∀ e : E, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1) (f : E) : IsNilpotent f ∨ IsUnit f

name: StringDiagrams.FiniteDimensionalAlgebra.isUnit_of_mul_eq_one_left
statement: theorem isUnit_of_mul_eq_one_left {g f : E} (h : g * f = 1) : IsUnit f

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.isCyclic_iff_doubleMate_eq
statement:
theorem isCyclic_iff_doubleMate_eq (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (P' : f' ⊣⊢ g') (α : f ⟶ f') :
    IsCyclic P P' α ↔ doubleMate P P' α = α

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.leftMate_apply
statement:
theorem leftMate_apply (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (P' : f' ⊣⊢ g') (α : f ⟶ f') :
    leftMate P P' α =
      (λ_ _).inv ≫ P.right.unit ▷ g' ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ g ◁ α ▷ g' ≫
        g ◁ P'.right.counit ≫ (ρ_ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.rightMate_apply
statement:
theorem rightMate_apply (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (P' : f' ⊣⊢ g') (α : f ⟶ f') :
    rightMate P P' α =
      (ρ_ _).inv ≫ g' ◁ P.left.unit ≫ g' ◁ α ▷ g ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫
        P'.left.counit ▷ g ≫ (λ_ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.symm_comp
StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.symm_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_id (a : B) : (id a).symm = id a

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.symm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (P : f ⊣⊢ g) : P.symm.symm = P

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_associator
statement:
theorem comp_associator {x y z t : B} (k : x ⟶ y) (l : y ⟶ z) (m : z ⟶ t) :
    (comp E k l).hom ▷ map E m ≫ (comp E (k ≫ l) m).hom ≫ map₂ E (α_ k l m).hom =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ map E k ◁ (comp E l m).hom ≫ (comp E k (l ≫ m)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_hom
statement:
theorem comp_hom {x y z : B} (k : x ⟶ y) (l : y ⟶ z) :
    (comp E k l).hom = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (E x).hom ◁ k ◁ (E y).counit.hom ▷ l ▷ (E z).inv ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_inv
statement:
theorem comp_inv {x y z : B} (k : x ⟶ y) (l : y ⟶ z) :
    (comp E k l).inv = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (E x).hom ◁ k ◁ (E y).counit.inv ▷ l ▷ (E z).inv ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem comp_leftUnitor {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    (comp E (𝟙 x) k).hom ≫ map₂ E (λ_ k).hom = (id E x).hom ▷ map E k ≫ (λ_ (map E k)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_naturality_left {x y z : B} {k k' : x ⟶ y} (η : k ⟶ k') (l : y ⟶ z) :
    map₂ E η ▷ map E l ≫ (comp E k' l).hom = (comp E k l).hom ≫ map₂ E (η ▷ l)

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_naturality_right {x y z : B} (k : x ⟶ y) {l l' : y ⟶ z} (η : l ⟶ l') :
    map E k ◁ map₂ E η ≫ (comp E k l').hom = (comp E k l).hom ≫ map₂ E (k ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.comp_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem comp_rightUnitor {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    (comp E k (𝟙 y)).hom ≫ map₂ E (ρ_ k).hom = map E k ◁ (id E y).hom ≫ (ρ_ (map E k)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counitNat_comp
statement:
theorem counitNat_comp {x y z : B} (k : x ⟶ y) (l : y ⟶ z) :
    (counitNat E (k ≫ l)).hom ≫ (E x).hom ◁ 𝟙 (k ≫ l) =
      (comp E k l).inv ▷ (E z).hom ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ map E k ◁ (counitNat E l).hom ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (counitNat E k).hom ▷ l ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counitNat_hom
statement:
theorem counitNat_hom {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    (counitNat E k).hom = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (E x).hom ◁ k ◁ (E y).counit.hom ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counitNat_id
statement:
theorem counitNat_id (x : B) :
    (counitNat E (𝟙 x)).hom ≫ (E x).hom ◁ 𝟙 (𝟙 x) =
      (id E x).hom ▷ (E x).hom ≫ (λ_ (E x).hom).hom ≫ (ρ_ (E x).hom).inv

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counitNat_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counitNat_naturality {x y : B} {k k' : x ⟶ y} (η : k ⟶ k') :
    map₂ E η ▷ (E y).hom ≫ (counitNat E k').hom = (counitNat E k).hom ≫ (E x).hom ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counitNat_unitNat
statement:
theorem counitNat_unitNat {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    map E k ◁ (E y).unit.inv ≫ (ρ_ (map E k)).hom ≫ (λ_ (map E k)).inv =
      ((α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (counitNat E k).hom ▷ (E y).inv ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        (E x).hom ◁ (unitNat E k).hom ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv) ≫ (E x).unit.inv ▷ map E k

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counit_inv_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem counit_inv_whiskerRight :
    e.counit.inv ▷ e.inv = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ e.inv ◁ e.unit.hom ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.counit_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem counit_whiskerRight :
    e.counit.hom ▷ e.inv = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ e.inv ◁ e.unit.inv ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.id_hom
statement:
theorem id_hom (x : B) :
    (id E x).hom = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (E x).unit.inv

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.map₂_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem map₂_comp {x y : B} {k k' k'' : x ⟶ y} (η : k ⟶ k') (θ : k' ⟶ k'') :
    map₂ E (η ≫ θ) = map₂ E η ≫ map₂ E θ

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.map₂_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map₂_id {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) : map₂ E (𝟙 k) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.unitNat_comp
statement:
theorem unitNat_comp {x y z : B} (k : x ⟶ y) (l : y ⟶ z) :
    (unitNat E (k ≫ l)).hom ≫ (E x).inv ◁ (comp E k l).inv =
      𝟙 (k ≫ l) ▷ (E z).inv ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ k ◁ (unitNat E l).hom ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (unitNat E k).hom ▷ map E l ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.unitNat_counitNat
statement:
theorem unitNat_counitNat {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    k ◁ (E y).counit.hom ≫ (ρ_ k).hom ≫ (λ_ k).inv =
      ((α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (unitNat E k).hom ▷ (E y).hom ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        (E x).inv ◁ (counitNat E k).hom ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv) ≫ (E x).counit.hom ▷ k

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.unitNat_hom
statement:
theorem unitNat_hom {x y : B} (k : x ⟶ y) :
    (unitNat E k).hom = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (E x).counit.inv ▷ (k ≫ (E y).inv) ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.unitNat_id
statement:
theorem unitNat_id (x : B) :
    (unitNat E (𝟙 x)).hom ≫ (E x).inv ◁ (id E x).hom =
      𝟙 (𝟙 x) ▷ (E x).inv ≫ (λ_ (E x).inv).hom ≫ (ρ_ (E x).inv).inv

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.unitNat_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitNat_naturality {x y : B} {k k' : x ⟶ y} (η : k ⟶ k') :
    η ▷ (E y).inv ≫ (unitNat E k').hom = (unitNat E k).hom ≫ (E x).inv ◁ map₂ E η

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.whiskerLeft_counit
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_counit :
    e.hom ◁ e.counit.hom = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ e.unit.inv ▷ e.hom ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ConjPseudofunctor.whiskerLeft_counit_inv
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_counit_inv :
    e.hom ◁ e.counit.inv = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ e.unit.hom ▷ e.hom ⊗≫ 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_assoc
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem K2_assoc {a b c d : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (Q.map f ≫ Q.map g) ◁ (κ h).inv ≫ (K2 Q pmap κ f g).inv ▷ pmap h ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
      (κ f).hom ▷ (pmap g ≫ pmap h) ≫ Q.map f ◁ (K2 Q pmap κ g h).hom = (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_comp_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem K2_comp_left {a b c d : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (K2 Q pmap κ (f ≫ g) h).inv ≫
        ((κ (f ≫ g)).hom ≫ (Q.mapComp f g).hom ≫ (K2 Q pmap κ f g).inv) ▷ pmap h =
      (Q.mapComp f g).hom ▷ Q.map h ≫ (Q.map f ≫ Q.map g) ◁ (κ h).inv ≫
        (K2 Q pmap κ f g).inv ▷ pmap h

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_comp_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem K2_comp_right {a b c d : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    pmap f ◁ ((K2 Q pmap κ g h).hom ≫ (Q.mapComp g h).inv ≫ (κ (g ≫ h)).inv) ≫
        (K2 Q pmap κ f (g ≫ h)).hom =
      (κ f).hom ▷ (pmap g ≫ pmap h) ≫ Q.map f ◁ (K2 Q pmap κ g h).hom ≫
        Q.map f ◁ (Q.mapComp g h).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_hom
statement:
theorem K2_hom {a b c : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (K2 Q pmap κ f g).hom = (κ f).hom ▷ pmap g ≫ Q.map f ◁ (κ g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_inv
statement:
theorem K2_inv {a b c : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (K2 Q pmap κ f g).inv = Q.map f ◁ (κ g).inv ≫ (κ f).inv ▷ pmap g

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem K2_whiskerLeft {a b c : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (X : Q.map g ⟶ Q.map h) :
    (K2 Q pmap κ f g).inv ≫ pmap f ◁ ((κ g).hom ≫ X ≫ (κ h).inv) ≫ (K2 Q pmap κ f h).hom =
      Q.map f ◁ X

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.K2_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem K2_whiskerRight {a b c : 𝒳} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : b ⟶ c) (X : Q.map f ⟶ Q.map g) :
    (K2 Q pmap κ f h).inv ≫ ((κ f).hom ≫ X ≫ (κ g).inv) ▷ pmap h ≫ (K2 Q pmap κ g h).hom =
      X ▷ Q.map h

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.copy_mapComp_inv
statement:
theorem copy_mapComp_inv {a b c : 𝒳} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((copy Q pmap κ).mapComp f g).inv =
      (κ f).hom ▷ pmap g ≫ Q.map f ◁ (κ g).hom ≫ (Q.mapComp f g).inv ≫ (κ (f ≫ g)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.copy_mapId_inv
statement:
theorem copy_mapId_inv (a : 𝒳) :
    ((copy Q pmap κ).mapId a).inv = (Q.mapId a).inv ≫ (κ (𝟙 a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.modLeftRight_aux
statement:
theorem modLeftRight_aux {A B M N : 𝒴} {qf pf : A ⟶ B} (k : pf ≅ qf) {sa : A ⟶ M}
    {sb : B ⟶ N} {ta : M ⟶ A} {tb : N ⟶ B} {hf : M ⟶ N} (nσ : qf ≫ sb ⟶ sa ≫ hf)
    (nτ : hf ≫ tb ⟶ ta ≫ qf) (Γa : sa ≫ ta ⟶ 𝟙 A) (Γb : sb ≫ tb ⟶ 𝟙 B)
    (hΓ : qf ◁ Γb ≫ (ρ_ qf).hom ≫ (λ_ qf).inv =
      ((α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nσ ▷ tb ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ sa ◁ nτ ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv) ≫ Γa ▷ qf) :
    pf ◁ Γb ≫ (ρ_ pf).hom ≫ (λ_ pf).inv =
      ((α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (k.hom ▷ sb ≫ nσ) ▷ tb ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ sa ◁ (nτ ≫ ta ◁ k.inv) ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).inv) ≫ Γa ▷ pf

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.modRightLeft_aux
statement:
theorem modRightLeft_aux {A B M N : 𝒴} {qf pf : A ⟶ B} (k : pf ≅ qf) {sa : A ⟶ M}
    {sb : B ⟶ N} {ta : M ⟶ A} {tb : N ⟶ B} {hf : M ⟶ N} (nσ : qf ≫ sb ⟶ sa ≫ hf)
    (nτ : hf ≫ tb ⟶ ta ≫ qf) :
    (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (nτ ≫ ta ◁ k.inv) ▷ sb ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ ta ◁ (k.hom ▷ sb ≫ nσ) ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).inv =
      (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nτ ▷ sb ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ ta ◁ nσ ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.transLeft_aux
statement:
theorem transLeft_aux {A B C A' B' C' : 𝒴} {qf pf : A ⟶ B} {qg pg : B ⟶ C} (kf : pf ≅ qf)
    (kg : pg ≅ qg) {sa : A ⟶ A'} {sb : B ⟶ B'} {sc : C ⟶ C'} {hf : A' ⟶ B'} {hg : B' ⟶ C'}
    (nf : qf ≫ sb ⟶ sa ≫ hf) (ng : qg ≫ sc ⟶ sb ≫ hg) :
    (qf ◁ kg.inv ≫ kf.inv ▷ pg) ▷ sc ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ pf ◁ (kg.hom ▷ sc ≫ ng) ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (kf.hom ▷ sb ≫ nf) ▷ hg ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ qf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nf ▷ hg ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorCopy.transRight_aux
statement:
theorem transRight_aux {A B C A' B' C' : 𝒴} {qf pf : A' ⟶ B'} {qg pg : B' ⟶ C'}
    (kf : pf ≅ qf) (kg : pg ≅ qg) {ta : A ⟶ A'} {tb : B ⟶ B'} {tc : C ⟶ C'} {hf : A ⟶ B}
    {hg : B ⟶ C} (nf : hf ≫ tb ⟶ ta ≫ qf) (ng : hg ≫ tc ⟶ tb ≫ qg) :
    (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ hf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nf ▷ qg ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        ta ◁ (qf ◁ kg.inv ≫ kf.inv ▷ pg) =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ hf ◁ (ng ≫ tb ◁ kg.inv) ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ (nf ≫ ta ◁ kf.inv) ▷ pg ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorLift.map₂_injective
statement:
theorem map₂_injective {a b : 𝔅} {f g : a ⟶ b} {x y : f ⟶ g} (h : 𝔉.map₂ x = 𝔉.map₂ y) :
    x = y

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorLift.map₂_lift_mapComp_hom
statement:
theorem map₂_lift_mapComp_hom {x y z : 𝒳} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    𝔉.map₂ ((lift 𝔉 pre map_pre pre_map gobj gmap map₂' mapId' mapComp' map₂_id' map₂_comp'
      map₂_whisker_left' map₂_whisker_right' map₂_associator' map₂_left_unitor'
      map₂_right_unitor').mapComp f g).hom =
        (mapComp' f g).hom ≫ (𝔉.mapComp (gmap f) (gmap g)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorLift.map₂_lift_mapComp_inv
statement:
theorem map₂_lift_mapComp_inv {x y z : 𝒳} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    𝔉.map₂ ((lift 𝔉 pre map_pre pre_map gobj gmap map₂' mapId' mapComp' map₂_id' map₂_comp'
      map₂_whisker_left' map₂_whisker_right' map₂_associator' map₂_left_unitor'
      map₂_right_unitor').mapComp f g).inv =
        (𝔉.mapComp (gmap f) (gmap g)).hom ≫ (mapComp' f g).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorLift.map₂_lift_mapId_hom
statement:
theorem map₂_lift_mapId_hom (x : 𝒳) :
    𝔉.map₂ ((lift 𝔉 pre map_pre pre_map gobj gmap map₂' mapId' mapComp' map₂_id' map₂_comp'
      map₂_whisker_left' map₂_whisker_right' map₂_associator' map₂_left_unitor'
      map₂_right_unitor').mapId x).hom =
        (mapId' x).hom ≫ (𝔉.mapId (gobj x)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PseudofunctorLift.map₂_lift_mapId_inv
statement:
theorem map₂_lift_mapId_inv (x : 𝒳) :
    𝔉.map₂ ((lift 𝔉 pre map_pre pre_map gobj gmap map₂' mapId' mapComp' map₂_id' map₂_comp'
      map₂_whisker_left' map₂_whisker_right' map₂_associator' map₂_left_unitor'
      map₂_right_unitor').mapId x).inv =
        (𝔉.mapId (gobj x)).hom ≫ (mapId' x).inv

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_eq_iff_unit
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_eq_iff_unit (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α = β ↔ adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂ = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂)
    (h : adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂ = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β) : conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α = β

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerLeft {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : d ⟶ e} {g : e ⟶ d} (adj : f ⊣ g) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    (conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj) (adj₂.comp adj)).symm (g ◁ β) =
      (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerRight {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : e ⟶ c} {g : c ⟶ e} (adj : f ⊣ g) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    (conjugateEquiv (adj.comp adj₁) (adj.comp adj₂)).symm (β ▷ g) =
      f ◁ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : e ⟶ c} {g : c ⟶ e} (adj : f ⊣ g) (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    conjugateEquiv (adj.comp adj₁) (adj.comp adj₂) (f ◁ α) =
      conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α ▷ g

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : d ⟶ e} {g : e ⟶ d} (adj : f ⊣ g) (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj) (adj₂.comp adj) (α ▷ f) =
      g ◁ conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem unit_comp_whiskerLeft_eq (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β = adj₂.unit ≫ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β ▷ r₂

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerLeft_injective
statement:
theorem unit_comp_whiskerLeft_injective {r₂ : d ⟶ c} {β β' : r₁ ⟶ r₂}
    (h : adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β') : β = β'

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem ok_append (r : S.Region) (w w' : List S.Colour) :
    S.ok r (w ++ w') ↔ S.ok r w ∧ S.ok (S.endR r w) w'

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem ok_cons (r : S.Region) (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour) :
    S.ok r (c :: w) ↔ S.colourSrc c = r ∧ S.ok (S.colourTgt c) w

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ok_nil (r : S.Region) : S.ok r []

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem ok_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S.Region] (r : S.Region) (w : List S.Colour) :
    S.ok r w

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.append
statement:
theorem Chain.append {a b c : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h₁ : Chain a ls b)
    (h₂ : Chain b ms c) : Chain a (ls ++ ms) c

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.endR_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.endR_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    b.endR = a.endR

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.start_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.start_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    b.start = a.start

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_append_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem Chain.target_append_singleton (a : Obj S) (ls : List (Layer S)) (L : Layer S) :
    Chain.target a (ls ++ [L]) = L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.target_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    Chain.target a ls = b

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.whisker
statement:
theorem Chain.whisker {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    Chain (a.whisker u v) (ls.map (·.whisker u v)) (b.whisker u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.whiskerOK
statement:
theorem Chain.whiskerOK {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : b.WhiskerOK u v

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_cast {a' b' a'' b'' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (ha' : a' = a'') (hb' : b' = b'') :
    cast (cast f ha hb) ha' hb' = cast f (ha.trans ha') (hb.trans hb')

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_comp
statement:
theorem cast_comp {a' b' c' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (hc : c = c') : cast (f ≫ g) ha hc = cast f ha hb ≫ cast g hb hc

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_eq
statement:
theorem cast_eq {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast f ha hb = eqToHom ha.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom hb

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_id {a' a'' : Obj S} (ha : a = a') (ha' : a = a'') :
    cast (𝟙 a) ha' ha = eqToHom (ha'.symm.trans ha)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_rfl
statement: @[simp] theorem cast_rfl (f : a ⟶ b) : cast f rfl rfl = f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.chain
statement: theorem chain (f : a ⟶ b) : Chain a (layers f) b

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_cast_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem eq_cast_of_layers_eq {a' b' : Obj S} {f : a ⟶ b} {g : a' ⟶ b'} (ha : a' = a)
    (hb : b' = b) (h : layers f = layers g) : f = cast g ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_cod_of_layers_eq_append
statement:
theorem eq_cod_of_layers_eq_append (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} {ls : List (Layer S)}
    (h : layers f = ls ++ [L]) : b = L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_dom_of_layers_eq_cons
statement:
theorem eq_dom_of_layers_eq_cons (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} {ls : List (Layer S)}
    (h : layers f = L :: ls) : a = L.dom

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_pair
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_pair (f : a ⟶ b) {L₁ L₂ : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L₁, L₂]) :
    a = L₁.dom ∧ L₁.cod = L₂.dom ∧ b = L₂.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_singleton (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L]) :
    a = L.dom ∧ b = L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_triple
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_triple (f : a ⟶ b) {L₁ L₂ L₃ : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L₁, L₂, L₃]) :
    a = L₁.dom ∧ L₁.cod = L₂.dom ∧ L₂.cod = L₃.dom ∧ b = L₃.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : layers f = layers g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    layers (cast f ha hb) = layers f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : layers (f ≫ g) = layers f ++ layers g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_eqToHom
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_eqToHom (h : a = b) : layers (eqToHom h) = []

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_id
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_id (a : Obj S) : layers (𝟙 a) = []

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    layers (layer L hv ha hb) = [L]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_mk (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    layers (mk ls h) = ls

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_ofLayer
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) : layers (ofLayer L hv) = [L]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : layers (whisker f u v hw) = (layers f).map (·.whisker u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_comp
statement:
theorem whisker_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (f ≫ g) u v hw = whisker f u v hw ≫ whisker g u v ((chain f).whiskerOK hw)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_id
statement:
theorem whisker_id (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (𝟙 a) u v hw = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.chain_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem chain_cons (a b : Obj S) (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    Chain a (L :: ls) b ↔ L.Valid ∧ L.dom = a ∧ Chain L.cod ls b

name: StringDiagrams.chain_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem chain_nil (a b : Obj S) : Chain a [] b ↔ a = b

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.valid_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem valid_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S.Region] : x.Valid

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_add {a' b' : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast (f + g) ha hb = cast f ha hb + cast g ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_neg {a' b' : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast (-f) ha hb = -cast f ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_of {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast (of f : LinDiagram R a b) ha hb = of (Diagram.cast f ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_rfl
statement: @[simp] theorem cast_rfl (f : LinDiagram R a b) : cast f rfl rfl = f

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_single {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) ha hb = Finsupp.single (Diagram.cast f ha hb) r

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_smul {a' b' : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') : cast (r • f) ha hb = r • cast f ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_sub {a' b' : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast (f - g) ha hb = cast f ha hb - cast g ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.of_comp
statement: theorem of_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (of (f ≫ g) : LinDiagram R a c) = of f ≫ of g

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_add
statement:
theorem whisker_add (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisker (f + g) u v hw = whisker f u v hw + whisker g u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_neg
statement:
theorem whisker_neg (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisker (-f) u v hw = -whisker f u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisker_of (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (of f : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw = of (Diagram.whisker f u v hw)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisker_single (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw =
      Finsupp.single (Diagram.whisker f u v hw) r

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_smul
statement:
theorem whisker_smul (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisker (r • f) u v hw = r • whisker f u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_sub
statement:
theorem whisker_sub (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisker (f - g) u v hw = whisker f u v hw - whisker g u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisker_zero (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.comp_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem comp_mem_ideal {a b c : Obj S} (g : LinDiagram R a b) {f : LinDiagram R b c}
    (hf : f ∈ P.ideal b c) : g ≫ f ∈ P.ideal a c

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    P.diag (f ≫ g) = P.diag f ≫ P.diag g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq {a b : Obj S} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) : P.diag f = P.diag g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_id
statement: @[simp] theorem diag_id (a : Obj S) : P.diag (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange
statement:
theorem diag_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) {a b : Obj S} (ha : x.dom.whisker u v = a)
    (hb : x.cod.whisker u v = b) :
    P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) u v hw) ha hb) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
        P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) u v hw) ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homRel_add
statement:
theorem homRel_add : ∀ ⦃X Y : Free R (Obj S)⦄ (f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y) (_ : P.homRel f₁ f₂)
    (_ : P.homRel g₁ g₂), P.homRel (f₁ + g₁) (f₂ + g₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homRel_smul
statement:
theorem homRel_smul : ∀ (a : R) ⦃X Y : Free R (Obj S)⦄ (f₁ f₂ : X ⟶ Y) (_ : P.homRel f₁ f₂),
    P.homRel (a • f₁) (a • f₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (f + g) = P.lin f + P.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) :
    P.lin (f ≫ g) = P.lin f ≫ P.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_eq_iff
statement:
theorem lin_eq_iff {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin f = P.lin g ↔ f - g ∈ P.ideal a b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_id
statement: @[simp] theorem lin_id (a : Obj S) : P.lin (𝟙 (Free.of R a)) = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_interchange
statement:
theorem lin_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.whisker (InterchangeData.rel R hx) u v hw) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_interchange_cast
statement:
theorem lin_interchange_cast (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) {a b : Obj S} (ha : x.dom.whisker u v = a)
    (hb : x.cod.whisker u v = b) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (InterchangeData.rel R hx) u v hw) ha hb) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_neg {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (-f) = -P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_of
statement: @[simp] theorem lin_of {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) : P.lin (LinDiagram.of f) = P.diag f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_rel
statement:
theorem lin_rel (i : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : (P.dom i).WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel i) u v hw) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_rel_cast
statement:
theorem lin_rel_cast (i : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : (P.dom i).WhiskerOK u v)
    {a b : Obj S} (ha : (P.dom i).whisker u v = a) (hb : (P.cod i).whisker u v = b) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel i) u v hw) ha hb) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_single
statement:
theorem lin_single {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    P.lin (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • P.diag f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (r • f) = r • P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (f - g) = P.lin f - P.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lin_zero {a b : Obj S} : P.lin (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_ideal_comp
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_comp {a b c : Obj S} {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b)
    (g : LinDiagram R b c) : f ≫ g ∈ P.ideal a c

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisker_rel_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem whisker_rel_mem_ideal (k : P.AllRel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : k.dom.WhiskerOK u v) : LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw ∈ P.ideal _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_cast
statement:
theorem whisker_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a'.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (cast f ha hb) u v hw =
      cast (whisker f u v (ha ▸ hw)) (by rw [ha]) (by rw [hb])

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (whisker f u' v' h') u v h =
      cast (whisker f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) (h'.trans h)) (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
        (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem Layer.whisker_whisker (L : Layer S) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour) :
    (L.whisker u' v').whisker u v = L.whisker (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_eq_comp
statement:
theorem cast_eq_comp {a' b' : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast f ha hb = eqToHom (by rw [ha]) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hb])

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_add
statement:
theorem whisk_add (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (f + g) u v = whisk f u v + whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_comp
statement:
theorem whisk_comp (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : whisk (f ≫ g) u v = whisk f u v ≫ whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_id
statement:
theorem whisk_id (a : Obj S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisk (𝟙 (Free.of R a)) u v = 𝟙 (Free.of R (a.whisker u v))

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_of_not_ok
statement:
theorem whisk_of_not_ok (f : LinDiagram R a b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (h : ¬ a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisk f u v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok
statement:
theorem whisk_of_ok (f : LinDiagram R a b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisk f u v = whisker f u v h

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_smul
statement:
theorem whisk_smul (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (r • f) u v = r • whisk f u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_sub
statement:
theorem whisk_sub (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (f - g) u v = whisk f u v - whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_zero
statement: theorem whisk_zero (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : whisk (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whiskerOK_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem whiskerOK_of_ne_zero {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ≠ 0) {u : Obj S}
    {v : List S.Colour} (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : b.WhiskerOK u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_comp
statement:
theorem whisker_comp (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : b.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (f ≫ g) u v ha = whisker f u v ha ≫ whisker g u v hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (whisker f u' v' h') u v h =
      cast (whisker f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) (h'.trans h)) (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
        (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.WhiskerOK.trans
statement:
theorem WhiskerOK.trans {a u' u : Obj S} {v' v : List S.Colour} (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v')
    (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) : a.WhiskerOK (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_start
statement: @[simp] theorem tensor_start (u u' : Obj S) : (u.tensor u').start = u.start

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_word
statement: @[simp] theorem tensor_word (u u' : Obj S) : (u.tensor u').word = u.word ++ u'.word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (a u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour) :
    (a.whisker u' v').whisker u v = a.whisker (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_eqToHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) :
    P.lin (eqToHom (congrArg (Free.of R) h)) = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_surjective
statement: theorem lin_surjective {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : ∃ g, P.lin g = f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_add
statement:
theorem whisk_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (f + g) u v = P.whisk f u v + P.whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_comp
statement:
theorem whisk_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : P.whisk (f ≫ g) u v = P.whisk f u v ≫ P.whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_diag
statement:
theorem whisk_diag {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : P.whisk (P.diag f) u v = P.diag (Diagram.whisker f u v h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whisk_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h)) u v =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) h))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_id
statement:
theorem whisk_id (a : Obj S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (𝟙 (P.obj a)) u v = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisk_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (P.lin f) u v = P.lin (LinDiagram.whisk f u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem whisk_mem_ideal {a b : Obj S} {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : LinDiagram.whisk f u v ∈ P.ideal _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_smul
statement:
theorem whisk_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : P.whisk (r • f) u v = r • P.whisk f u v

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_sub
statement:
theorem whisk_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (f - g) u v = P.whisk f u v - P.whisk g u v

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_whisk
statement:
theorem whisk_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (P.whisk f u' v') u v =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.whisker_whisker a u' u v' v)) ≫
        P.whisk f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.whisker_whisker b u' u v' v).symm)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_zero
statement:
theorem whisk_zero {a b : Obj S} (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) u v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.wl

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem oddCountList_nil : oddCountList ([] : List (Layer S)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_diagrams
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_diagrams (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') :
    P.diag (whiskerR f b ≫ whiskerL a' g) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) • P.diag (whiskerL a g ≫ whiskerR f b')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mk_congr
statement:
theorem diag_mk_congr {a b : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h : ls = ms) (hl : Chain a ls b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layer_right
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layer_right (f : a ⟶ a') (M : Layer S) :
    P.diag (whiskerR f M.dom ≫ whiskerL a' (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (whiskerL a (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M)) ≫ whiskerR f M.cod)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layers
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layers (L M : Layer S) :
    P.diag (whiskerR (ofLayer L (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton L)) M.dom ≫
        whiskerL L.cod (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (whiskerL L.dom (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M)) ≫
          whiskerR (ofLayer L (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton L)) M.cod)

statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_composable (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    P.diag (rwhisker f b h ≫ lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) •
        P.diag (lwhisker a g h ≫ rwhisker f b' (h.map_right g))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_composable'

    P.diag (rwhisker f b h ≫ lwhisker a' g h₁) =

    (h : a.Composable M.dom) (h₁ : a'.Composable M.dom) (h₂ : a.Composable M.cod) :
    P.diag (rwhisker f M.dom h ≫ lwhisker a' (ofLayer M hM) h₁) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (lwhisker a (ofLayer M hM) h ≫ rwhisker f M.cod h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layers_of_composable

theorem diag_swap_layers_of_composable (L M : Layer S) (hL : L.Valid) (hM : M.Valid)

    P.diag (rwhisker (ofLayer L hL) M.dom h ≫ lwhisker L.cod (ofLayer M hM) h₁) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (lwhisker L.dom (ofLayer M hM) h ≫ rwhisker (ofLayer L hL) M.cod h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hom_induction
StringDiagrams.Presentation.hom_induction_layers
statement:
theorem hom_induction_layers {p : ∀ {a b : Obj S}, (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) → Prop}
    (nil : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b), p (P.diag (eqToHom h)))
    (layer : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid), p (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv)))
    (comp : ∀ {a b c : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c),
      p f → p g → p (f ≫ g))
    (zero : ∀ {a b : Obj S}, p (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b))
    (add : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b), p f → p g → p (f + g))
    (smul : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b), p f → p (r • f))
    {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : p f

    (hcomp : ∀ {a b c : Obj S}, a ∈ C → b ∈ C → c ∈ C → ∀ (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
      (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c), f ∈ M a b → g ∈ M b c → f ≫ g ∈ M a c)
    (hlayer : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid), L.dom ∈ C →
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ∈ M L.dom L.cod)
    {a b : Obj S} (ha : a ∈ C) (hb : b ∈ C) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : f ∈ M a b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.associator_naturality_aux
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_aux {a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : Obj S} (f₁ : P.obj a₁ ⟶ P.obj b₁)
    (f₂ : P.obj a₂ ⟶ P.obj b₂) (f₃ : P.obj a₃ ⟶ P.obj b₃) :
    (P.wR (P.wR f₁ a₂ ≫ P.wL b₁ f₂) a₃ ≫ P.wL (b₁.tensor b₂) f₃) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b₁ b₂ b₃)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a₁ a₂ a₃)) ≫
        (P.wR f₁ (a₂.tensor a₃) ≫ P.wL b₁ (P.wR f₂ a₃ ≫ P.wL b₂ f₃))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq'
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq' {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) :
    P.diag f = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha) ≫ P.diag g ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_whiskerLeft (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : b ⟶ b') :
    P.obj a ◁ P.diag g = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerL a g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_whiskerRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_whiskerRight {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.diag f ▷ P.obj b = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerR f b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.eqToHom_obj
statement:
theorem eqToHom_obj {a b : Obj S} (h : P.obj a = P.obj b) :
    eqToHom h = P.diag (eqToHom (P.obj_injective h))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.leftUnitor_eq
statement: theorem leftUnitor_eq (X : P.Presented) : λ_ X = eqToIso (P.unit_tensor_obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_inj {a b : Obj S} : P.obj a = P.obj b ↔ a = b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_injective
statement: theorem obj_injective : Function.Injective P.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_tensor
statement: theorem obj_tensor (a b : Obj S) : P.obj a ⊗ P.obj b = P.obj (a.tensor b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_toObj
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_toObj (X : P.Presented) : P.obj (P.toObj X) = X

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_unit
statement: theorem obj_unit : 𝟙_ P.Presented = P.obj Obj.unit

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.pentagon_aux
statement:
theorem pentagon_aux (a b c d : Obj S) :
    P.wR (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c))) d ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a (b.tensor c) d)) ≫
          P.wL a (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b c d))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc (a.tensor b) c d)) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b (c.tensor d)))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.rightUnitor_eq
statement: theorem rightUnitor_eq (X : P.Presented) : ρ_ X = eqToIso (P.tensor_unit_obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_assoc_obj
statement: theorem tensor_assoc_obj (X Y Z : P.Presented) : (X ⊗ Y) ⊗ Z = X ⊗ (Y ⊗ Z)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_comp_aux
statement:
theorem tensor_comp_aux [S.IsEven] (f₁ : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (g₁ : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'')
    (f₂ : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g₂ : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'') :
    P.wR (f₁ ≫ g₁) b ≫ P.wL a'' (f₂ ≫ g₂) =
      (P.wR f₁ b ≫ P.wL a' f₂) ≫ (P.wR g₁ b' ≫ P.wL a'' g₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_unit_obj
statement: theorem tensor_unit_obj (X : P.Presented) : X ⊗ 𝟙_ P.Presented = X

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.toObj_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem toObj_obj (a : Obj S) : P.toObj (P.obj a) = a

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.triangle_aux
statement:
theorem triangle_aux (a b : Obj S) :
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a Obj.unit b)) ≫
        P.wL a (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b))) =
      P.wR (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a))) b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.unit_tensor_obj
statement: theorem unit_tensor_obj (X : P.Presented) : 𝟙_ P.Presented ⊗ X = X

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.unit_wL
statement:
theorem unit_wL (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL Obj.unit g ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b)) ≫ g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_add
statement:
theorem wL_add (a : Obj S) (g g' : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (g + g') = P.wL a g + P.wL a g'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_comp
statement:
theorem wL_comp (a : Obj S) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g' : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'') :
    P.wL a (g ≫ g') = P.wL a g ≫ P.wL a g'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_diag
statement: theorem wL_diag (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') : P.wL a (P.diag g) = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerL a g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wL_eqToHom (a : Obj S) (h : P.obj b = P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_id
statement: theorem wL_id (a b : Obj S) : P.wL a (𝟙 (P.obj b)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_smul
statement:
theorem wL_smul (a : Obj S) (r : R) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (r • g) = r • P.wL a g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_wL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wL_wL (a b : Obj S) (h : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj c') :
    P.wL (a.tensor b) h ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wL b h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_wR
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wL_wR (a : Obj S) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (c : Obj S) :
    P.wR (P.wL a g) c ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b' c)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wR g c)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_zero
statement: theorem wL_zero (a : Obj S) : P.wL a (0 : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_add
statement:
theorem wR_add (f f' : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (f + f') b = P.wR f b + P.wR f' b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_comp
statement:
theorem wR_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (f ≫ f') b = P.wR f b ≫ P.wR f' b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_comp_wL
statement:
theorem wR_comp_wL [S.IsEven] (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wR f b ≫ P.wL a' g = P.wL a g ≫ P.wR f b'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_diag
statement: theorem wR_diag (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) : P.wR (P.diag f) b = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerR f b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wR_eqToHom (h : P.obj a = P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (eqToHom h) b = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_id
statement: theorem wR_id (a b : Obj S) : P.wR (𝟙 (P.obj a)) b = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_smul
statement:
theorem wR_smul (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (r • f) b = r • P.wR f b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_unit
statement:
theorem wR_unit (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') :
    P.wR f Obj.unit ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a)) ≫ f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_wR
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wR_wR (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b c : Obj S) :
    P.wR (P.wR f b) c ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a' b c)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wR f (b.tensor c)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_zero
statement: theorem wR_zero (b : Obj S) : P.wR (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_eq (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.obj a ◁ g = P.wL a g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerLeft_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_eqToHom (X : P.Presented) {Y Y' : P.Presented} (h : Y = Y') :
    X ◁ eqToHom h = eqToHom (congrArg (X ⊗ ·) h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_eq {a a' : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    f ▷ P.obj b = P.wR f b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerRight_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_eqToHom {X X' : P.Presented} (h : X = X') (Y : P.Presented) :
    eqToHom h ▷ Y = eqToHom (congrArg (· ⊗ Y) h)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.nil_left
statement:
theorem Composable.nil_left (hb : b.WF) {r : S.Region} (h : b.start = r) :
    (nil r).Composable b

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.nil_right
statement:
theorem Composable.nil_right (ha : a.WF) {r : S.Region} (h : a.endR = r) :
    a.Composable (nil r)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.tensor_left
statement:
theorem Composable.tensor_left (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) :
    (a.tensor b).Composable c

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.tensor_right
statement:
theorem Composable.tensor_right (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) :
    a.Composable (b.tensor c)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_start
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_start (r : S.Region) : (nil r).start = r

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_tensor
statement: theorem nil_tensor {b : Obj S} {r : S.Region} (h : b.start = r) : (nil r).tensor b = b

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_wf
statement: theorem nil_wf (r : S.Region) : (nil r).WF

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_word
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_word (r : S.Region) : (nil r).word = ([] : List S.Colour)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start
statement:
theorem tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start {a : Obj S} (b : Obj S) {r : S.Region}
    (h : a.start = r) : a.tensor b = a.whisker (nil r) b.word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_nil
statement: theorem tensor_nil (a : Obj S) (r : S.Region) : a.tensor (nil r) = a

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.comp_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem Hom.comp_obj (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) :
    (a.comp b).obj = a.obj.tensor b.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.composable
statement: theorem Hom.composable (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) : a.obj.Composable b.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem Hom.id_obj (l : P.Bicat) : (Hom.id l).obj = Obj.nil l.region

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.isoOfEq_eq_eqToIso
statement:
theorem isoOfEq_eq_eqToIso {a b : Hom l m} (e : a.obj = b.obj) (e' : a = b) :
    isoOfEq e = eqToIso e'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.pentagon_aux
statement:
theorem pentagon_aux (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) (c : Hom n k) (d : Hom k j) :
    P.wRAt l.region (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj b.obj c.obj))) d.obj
        a.start_eq a.start_eq ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj (b.obj.tensor c.obj) d.obj)) ≫
        P.wL a.obj (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b.obj c.obj d.obj))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc (a.obj.tensor b.obj) c.obj d.obj)) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj b.obj (c.obj.tensor d.obj)))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.triangle_aux
statement:
theorem triangle_aux (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) :
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj (Obj.nil m.region) b.obj)) ≫
        P.wL a.obj (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor b.start_eq))) =
      P.wRAt l.region (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a.obj m.region))) b.obj
        a.start_eq a.start_eq

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem Bicat.whiskerLeft_eq (a : l ⟶ m) {b b' : m ⟶ n} (θ : b ⟶ b') :
    a ◁ θ = P.wL (Bicat.Hom.obj a) θ

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem Bicat.whiskerRight_eq {a a' : l ⟶ m} (η : a ⟶ a') (b : m ⟶ n) :
    η ▷ b = P.wRAt l.region η (Bicat.Hom.obj b) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_comp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp [S.IsEven] (h : a'.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g' : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) (ha'' : a''.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g') ha ha'' =
      P.hcomp r f g ha ha' ≫ P.hcomp r f' g' ha' ha''

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_diag
statement:
theorem hcomp_diag (h : a.Composable b) (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (ha : a.start = r)
    (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (P.diag f) (P.diag g) ha ha' =
      P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_eq
statement:
theorem hcomp_eq [S.IsEven] (h : a.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r f g ha ha' = P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_id
statement:
theorem hcomp_id (h : a.Composable b) (ha : a.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (𝟙 (P.obj a)) (𝟙 (P.obj b)) ha ha = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_diag_of_composable
statement:
theorem wL_diag_of_composable (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    P.wL a (P.diag g) = P.diag (Diagram.lwhisker a g h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_eqToHom_of_composable
statement:
theorem wL_eqToHom_of_composable (h : P.obj b = P.obj b') (hab : a.Composable b) :
    P.wL a (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_id_of_composable
statement: theorem wL_id_of_composable (h : a.Composable b) : P.wL a (𝟙 (P.obj b)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_nil
statement:
theorem wL_nil (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (hb : b.WF) (hs : b.start = r) (hs' : b'.start = r) :
    P.wL (Obj.nil r) g =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor hs)) ≫ g ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor hs')).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_tensor
statement:
theorem wL_tensor (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (g : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj c') :
    P.wL (a.tensor b) g =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wL b g) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c')).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_add
statement:
theorem wRAt_add (f f' : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (f + f') b ha ha' = P.wRAt r f b ha ha' + P.wRAt r f' b ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_comp
statement:
theorem wRAt_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (f ≫ f') b ha ha'' = P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wRAt r f' b ha' ha''

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_comp_wL
statement:
theorem wRAt_comp_wL [S.IsEven] (h : a.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' g = P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_diag
statement:
theorem wRAt_diag (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) (ha : a.start = r)
    (ha' : a'.start = r) : P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b ha ha' = P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker f b h)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag
statement:
theorem wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag (h : a.Composable b) (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' (P.diag g) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g)) •
        (P.wL a (P.diag g) ≫ P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b' ha ha')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wRAt_eqToHom (h : P.obj a = P.obj a') (b : Obj S) (hb : S.ok a.endR b.word)
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r (eqToHom h) b ha ha' = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_id
statement:
theorem wRAt_id (b : Obj S) (hb : S.ok a.endR b.word) :
    P.wRAt r (𝟙 (P.obj a)) b ha ha = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_nil
statement:
theorem wRAt_nil (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (ha : a.WF) (he : a.endR = s) (hr : a.start = r)
    (hr' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f (Obj.nil s) hr hr' =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a s)) ≫ f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a' s)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_smul
statement:
theorem wRAt_smul (x : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (x • f) b ha ha' = x • P.wRAt r f b ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_tensor
statement:
theorem wRAt_tensor (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f (b.tensor c) ha ha' =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)).symm ≫
        P.wRAt r (P.wRAt r f b ha ha') c ha ha' ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a' b c))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_wL
statement:
theorem wRAt_wL (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b')
    (ha : a.start = r) (hb : b.start = s) (hb' : b'.start = s) :
    P.wRAt r (P.wL a g) c ha ha =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wRAt s g c hb hb') ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b' c)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_zero
statement: theorem wRAt_zero (b : Obj S) : P.wRAt r (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') b ha ha' = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    degree deg (cast f ha hb) = degree deg f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    degree deg (f ≫ g) = degree deg f + degree deg g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_eqToHom
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_eqToHom (h : a = b) : degree deg (eqToHom h) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_id
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_id (a : Obj S) : degree deg (𝟙 a) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    degree deg (layer L hv ha hb) = deg L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_mk
statement:
theorem degree_mk (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    degree deg (mk ls h) = (ls.map fun L => deg L.gen).sum

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_ofLayer
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    degree deg (ofLayer L hv) = deg L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_whisker

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_adj
statement:
theorem canon_adj {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hr : Same s r (r + 1))
    (hmin : ∀ r' < r, ¬ Same s r' (r' + 1)) :
    canon s = canon (rmAt s r) ++ [.cup r (s[r]'hr.lt_left).2]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_cross
statement:
theorem canon_cross {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) (hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same s r (r + 1))
    (hne : s ≠ []) : ∃ q, Opn s q ∧ Cls s (q + 1) ∧ canon s = canon (swapAt s q) ++ [.cross q] ∧
      ∀ q' < q, ¬ (Opn s q' ∧ Cls s (q' + 1))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_nil
statement: theorem canon_nil : canon ([] : List (ℕ × α)) = []

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cr_rmAt_le

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.getElem?_insAt
statement:
theorem getElem?_insAt (s : List β) {g : ℕ} (hg : g ≤ s.length) (x y : β) (i : ℕ) :
    (insAt s g x y)[i]? = if i < g then s[i]? else if i = g then some x
      else if i = g + 1 then some y else s[i - 2]?

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.getElem?_rmAt
statement:
theorem getElem?_rmAt (s : List β) {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) (i : ℕ) :
    (rmAt s r)[i]? = s[rmIdx r i]?

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.getElem?_swapAt
statement:
theorem getElem?_swapAt (s : List β) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (i : ℕ) :
    (swapAt s p)[i]? = s[tau p i]?

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_insAt
StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_ne_none_iff
statement: theorem idAt_ne_none_iff {i : ℕ} : idAt s i ≠ none ↔ i < s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_rmAt
statement:
theorem idAt_rmAt {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) (i : ℕ) :

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_swapAt
statement:
theorem idAt_swapAt {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (i : ℕ) :
    idAt (swapAt s p) i = idAt s (tau p i)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_iff
statement:
theorem ilv_iff (hv : Valid s) {q a b : ℕ} (ha : Same s q a) (hb : Same s (q + 1) b) :
    Ilv s q ↔ (q + 1 < a ∧ a < b) ∨ (b < q ∧ q + 1 < a) ∨ (a < b ∧ b < q)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_of_opn_cls
statement:
theorem ilv_of_opn_cls {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {q : ℕ} (hn : ¬ Same s q (q + 1))
    (ho : Opn s q) (hc : Cls s (q + 1)) : Ilv s q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_swapAt_iff
statement:
theorem ilv_swapAt_iff (hv : Valid s) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length)
    (hab : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) : Ilv (swapAt s p) p ↔ ¬ Ilv s p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_rmAt
statement:
theorem insAt_rmAt (s : List β) {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 1 < s.length) :
    insAt (rmAt s r) r s[r] s[r + 1] = s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_insAt
statement:
theorem length_insAt (s : List β) {g : ℕ} (h : g ≤ s.length) (x y : β) :
    (insAt s g x y).length = s.length + 2

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_rmAt
statement:
theorem length_rmAt (s : List β) {r : ℕ} (h : r + 2 ≤ s.length) :

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_swapAt
statement: @[simp] theorem length_swapAt (s : List β) (p : ℕ) : (swapAt s p).length = s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.mem_crSet
statement: theorem mem_crSet {x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ} : x ∈ crSet s ↔ Cr4 s x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmAt_insAt
statement:
theorem rmAt_insAt (s : List β) (g : ℕ) (x y : β) (hg : g ≤ s.length) :
    rmAt (insAt s g x y) g = s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmIdx_inj
statement: theorem rmIdx_inj {r i j : ℕ} : rmIdx r i = rmIdx r j ↔ i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmIdx_lt_iff
statement: theorem rmIdx_lt_iff (r : ℕ) {i j : ℕ} : rmIdx r i < rmIdx r j ↔ i < j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_comm
statement: theorem same_comm {i j : ℕ} : Same s i j ↔ Same s j i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_insAt_iff
statement:
theorem same_insAt_iff {g : ℕ} (hg : g ≤ s.length) {k : ℕ} (hk : ∀ x ∈ s, x.1 ≠ k) (a b : α)
    {i j : ℕ} : Same (insAt s g (k, a) (k, b)) i j ↔
      ((i = g ∧ j = g + 1) ∨ (i = g + 1 ∧ j = g) ∨
        (i ≠ g ∧ i ≠ g + 1 ∧ j ≠ g ∧ j ≠ g + 1 ∧ Same s (if i < g then i else i - 2)
          (if j < g then j else j - 2)))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_rmAt
statement:
theorem same_rmAt {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) {i j : ℕ} :
    Same (rmAt s r) i j ↔ Same s (rmIdx r i) (rmIdx r j)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_swapAt
statement:
theorem same_swapAt {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) {i j : ℕ} :
    Same (swapAt s p) i j ↔ Same s (tau p i) (tau p j)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_of_le
statement: theorem swapAt_of_le (s : List β) {p : ℕ} (hp : ¬ p + 1 < s.length) : swapAt s p = s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_partners
statement:
theorem swapAt_partners {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) {a b : ℕ} (ha : Same s p a)
    (hb : Same s (p + 1) b) (hab : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) :
    Same (swapAt s p) p b ∧ Same (swapAt s p) (p + 1) a

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_swapAt
statement: theorem swapAt_swapAt (s : List β) (p : ℕ) : swapAt (swapAt s p) p = s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_inj
statement: theorem tau_inj {p i j : ℕ} : tau p i = tau p j ↔ i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_lt_iff
statement:
theorem tau_lt_iff (p : ℕ) {i j : ℕ} (h : ¬ (i = p ∧ j = p + 1)) (h' : ¬ (i = p + 1 ∧ j = p)) :
    tau p i < tau p j ↔ i < j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_tau
statement: theorem tau_tau (p i : ℕ) : tau p (tau p i) = i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ExHyp.apply
StringDiagrams.Chord.Inv.step
statement:

statement:
theorem Valid.eq_of_same {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {x y x' y' : ℕ} (h : Same s x y)
    (h' : Same s x' y') (e : x = x') : y = y'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_cup
statement:
theorem canon_cup {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hr : Same s r (r + 1)) :
    Equiv (canon s) (canon (rmAt s r) ++ [.cup r (s[r]'hr.lt_left).2])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_ilv
statement:
theorem canon_ilv {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {q : ℕ} (h : Ilv t q) :
    Equiv (canon t) (canon (swapAt t q) ++ [.cross q])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.equiv_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem equiv_canon_or_reducible : ∀ {D : List (Move α)}, Fits 0 D →
    Reducible D ∨ Equiv D (canon (run d D))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ex_adj
statement:
theorem ex_adj {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {q r : ℕ} (h : Ilv t q)
    (hr : Same t r (r + 1)) (ih : ExHyp (α := α) (t.length + cr t)) :
    Equiv (canon t) (canon (swapAt t q) ++ [.cross q])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ex_far
statement:
theorem ex_far {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {q q₀ : ℕ} (h : Ilv t q)
    (hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same t r (r + 1)) (ho : Opn t q₀) (hc : Cls t (q₀ + 1))
    (hcanon : canon t = canon (swapAt t q₀) ++ [.cross q₀])
    (far : q + 2 ≤ q₀ ∨ q₀ + 2 ≤ q) (ih : ExHyp (α := α) (t.length + cr t)) :
    Equiv (canon t) (canon (swapAt t q) ++ [.cross q])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ex_left
statement:
theorem ex_left {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {P : ℕ} (h : Ilv t P)
    (hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same t r (r + 1)) (ho : Opn t (P + 1)) (hc : Cls t (P + 1 + 1))
    (hcanon : canon t = canon (swapAt t (P + 1)) ++ [.cross (P + 1)])
    (ih : ExHyp (α := α) (t.length + cr t)) :
    Equiv (canon t) (canon (swapAt t P) ++ [.cross P])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ex_right
statement:
theorem ex_right {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {q₀ : ℕ} (h : Ilv t (q₀ + 1))
    (hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same t r (r + 1)) (ho : Opn t q₀) (hc : Cls t (q₀ + 1))
    (hcanon : canon t = canon (swapAt t q₀) ++ [.cross q₀])
    (ih : ExHyp (α := α) (t.length + cr t)) :
    Equiv (canon t) (canon (swapAt t (q₀ + 1)) ++ [.cross (q₀ + 1)])

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.fits_append
statement:
theorem fits_append : ∀ (n : ℕ) (D E : List (Move α)),
    Fits n (D ++ E) ↔ Fits n D ∧ Fits (D.foldl Move.len n) E
  | n, [], E => by simp [Fits]
  | n, m :: D, E => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, Fits, List.foldl_cons, fits_append _ D E, and_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.fits_snoc
statement:
theorem fits_snoc {D : List (Move α)} {m : Move α} :
    Fits 0 (D ++ [m]) ↔ Fits 0 D ∧ m.Ok (run d D).length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.getElem_eq_of_getElem?
statement:
theorem getElem_eq_of_getElem? {β : Type*} {l l' : List β} {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < l.length)
    (hj : j < l'.length) (h : l[i]? = l'[j]?) : l[i] = l'[j]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_swapAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem ilv_swapAt_of_ne {t : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid t) {p q a b : ℕ}
    (hp : p + 1 < t.length) (far : q + 2 ≤ p ∨ p + 2 ≤ q) (ha : Same t q a)
    (hb : Same t (q + 1) b) (hpair : ¬ (a = p ∧ b = p + 1) ∧ ¬ (a = p + 1 ∧ b = p)) :
    Ilv (swapAt t p) q ↔ Ilv t q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.inv_run
statement: theorem inv_run : ∀ {D : List (Move α)}, Fits 0 D → Inv (run d D)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_foldl_step
statement:
theorem length_foldl_step : ∀ (s : List (ℕ × α)) (D : List (Move α)),
    (D.foldl (step d) s).length = D.foldl Move.len s.length
  | s, [] => rfl
  | s, m :: D => by
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, length_foldl_step _ D, length_step]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_step
statement: theorem length_step (s : List (ℕ × α)) (m : Move α) : (step d s m).length = m.len s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.mem_swapAt
statement: theorem mem_swapAt {β : Type*} {s : List β} {p : ℕ} {x : β} (h : x ∈ swapAt s p) : x ∈ s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmAt_rmAt
statement:
theorem rmAt_rmAt {β : Type*} (s : List β) {r₀ m : ℕ} (h : r₀ ≤ m) (hl : m + 4 ≤ s.length) :
    rmAt (rmAt s (m + 2)) r₀ = rmAt (rmAt s r₀) m

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmAt_swapAt
statement:
theorem rmAt_swapAt {β : Type*} (s : List β) {q q' r : ℕ}
    (h : (q + 2 ≤ r ∧ q' = q) ∨ (r + 2 ≤ q ∧ q' + 2 = q))
    (hq : q + 1 < s.length) (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) :
    rmAt (swapAt s q) r = swapAt (rmAt s r) q'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmAt_swapAt_pitch
statement:
theorem rmAt_swapAt_pitch {β : Type*} (s : List β) {q : ℕ} (hl : q + 2 < s.length) :
    rmAt (swapAt s q) (q + 1) = rmAt (swapAt s (q + 1)) q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.run_append
statement: theorem run_append (D E : List (Move α)) : run d (D ++ E) = E.foldl (step d) (run d D)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_swapAt_of
statement:
theorem same_swapAt_of {s : List (ℕ × α)} {p x y : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length)
    (h : Same s (tau p x) y) : Same (swapAt s p) x (tau p y)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_braid
statement:
theorem swapAt_braid {β : Type*} (s : List β) {p : ℕ} (hl : p + 2 < s.length) :
    swapAt (swapAt (swapAt s p) (p + 1)) p = swapAt (swapAt (swapAt s (p + 1)) p) (p + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_comm
statement:
theorem swapAt_comm {β : Type*} (s : List β) {p p' : ℕ} (h : p + 2 ≤ p') (hl : p' + 1 < s.length) :
    swapAt (swapAt s p) p' = swapAt (swapAt s p') p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_getElem?
statement:
theorem swapAt_getElem? {β : Type*} (s : List β) {p i : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (h1 : i ≠ p)
    (h2 : i ≠ p + 1) : (swapAt s p)[i]? = s[i]?

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_braid
statement: theorem tau_braid (p i : ℕ) : tau p (tau (p + 1) (tau p i)) = tau (p + 1) (tau p (tau (p + 1) i))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_cases
statement:
theorem tau_cases (p i : ℕ) : (i = p ∧ tau p i = p + 1) ∨ (i = p + 1 ∧ tau p i = p) ∨
    (i ≠ p ∧ i ≠ p + 1 ∧ tau p i = i)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_left
statement: theorem tau_left (p : ℕ) : tau p p = p + 1

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_of_ne
statement: theorem tau_of_ne {p i : ℕ} (h1 : i ≠ p) (h2 : i ≠ p + 1) : tau p i = i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_right
statement: theorem tau_right (p : ℕ) : tau p (p + 1) = p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.fits_letters

theorem Equiv.fits_letters {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) (l : List α) :
    (Fits l.length X ↔ Fits l.length Y) ∧
      (Fits l.length X → X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.insAt
StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.length_eq

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.rmAt

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.snd_getElem
statement:
theorem Iso.snd_getElem {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') {i : ℕ} (hi : i < s.length)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.swapAt
statement:
theorem Iso.swapAt {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (p : ℕ) :

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.symm
statement: theorem Iso.symm {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : Iso s' s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.valid
statement: theorem Iso.valid {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (hv : Valid s) : Valid s'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Lettered.rmAt
statement:
theorem Lettered.rmAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Lettered d s) {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) :

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Lettered.swapAt
statement:
theorem Lettered.swapAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Lettered d s) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (hn : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) : Lettered d (Chord.swapAt s p)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Rw.fits_letters
statement:
theorem Rw.fits_letters {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y) (l : List α) :
    (Fits l.length X ↔ Fits l.length Y) ∧
      (Fits l.length X → X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Step.fits_letters

theorem Step.fits_letters {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) (l : List α) :
