      (Fits l.length L → L.foldl (lstep d) l = R.foldl (lstep d) l)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_congr
statement:
theorem canon_congr : ∀ (n : ℕ) {s s' : List (ℕ × α)}, s.length + cr s < n → Iso s s' →
    canon s = canon s'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem canon_eq_of_iso {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : canon s = canon s'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cls_iff
statement: theorem cls_iff {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (q : ℕ) : Cls s q ↔ Cls s' q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cr_le_of_iso
statement: theorem cr_le_of_iso {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : cr s ≤ cr s'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.foldl_lstep_len
statement:
theorem foldl_lstep_len : ∀ (l : List α) (D : List (Move α)),
    (D.foldl (lstep d) l).length = D.foldl Move.len l.length
  | l, [] => rfl
  | l, m :: D => by simp only [List.foldl_cons, foldl_lstep_len _ D, length_lstep]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_insAt
statement:
theorem insAt_insAt {β : Type*} (l : List β) {g g' : ℕ} (h : g' ≤ g) (hg : g ≤ l.length)
    (x y u v : β) : insAt (insAt l g x y) g' u v = insAt (insAt l g' u v) (g + 2) x y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_pitch
statement:
theorem insAt_pitch {β : Type*} (l : List β) {g : ℕ} (hg : g < l.length) (x y : β) :
    swapAt (insAt l g x y) (g + 1) = swapAt (insAt l (g + 1) x y) g

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_swapAt_ge
statement:
theorem insAt_swapAt_ge {β : Type*} (l : List β) {p g : ℕ} (h : g ≤ p) (hp : p + 1 < l.length)
    (x y : β) : insAt (swapAt l p) g x y = swapAt (insAt l g x y) (p + 2)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_swapAt_lt
statement:
theorem insAt_swapAt_lt {β : Type*} (l : List β) {p g : ℕ} (h : p + 2 ≤ g) (hg : g ≤ l.length)
    (x y : β) : insAt (swapAt l p) g x y = swapAt (insAt l g x y) p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_lstep
statement: theorem length_lstep (l : List α) (m : Move α) : (lstep d l m).length = m.len l.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_insAt
statement:
theorem map_insAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (g : ℕ) (x y : β) :
    (insAt s g x y).map f = insAt (s.map f) g (f x) (f y)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_rmAt
statement:
theorem map_rmAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (r : ℕ) :
    (rmAt s r).map f = rmAt (s.map f) r

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_swapAt
statement:
theorem map_swapAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (p : ℕ) :
    (swapAt s p).map f = swapAt (s.map f) p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ne_id_of_mem_rmAt
statement:
theorem ne_id_of_mem_rmAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hr : Same s r (r + 1))
    {x : ℕ × α} (hx : x ∈ Chord.rmAt s r) : x.1 ≠ (s[r]'hr.lt_left).1

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.opn_iff
statement: theorem opn_iff {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (q : ℕ) : Opn s q ↔ Opn s' q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.run_canon
statement:
theorem run_canon : ∀ (n : ℕ) {s : List (ℕ × α)}, s.length + cr s < n → Valid s →
    Lettered d s → Fits 0 (canon s) ∧ Iso (run d (canon s)) s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_foldl_step
statement:
theorem snd_foldl_step : ∀ (s : List (ℕ × α)) (D : List (Move α)),
    (D.foldl (step d) s).map Prod.snd = D.foldl (lstep d) (s.map Prod.snd)
  | s, [] => rfl
  | s, m :: D => by simp only [List.foldl_cons, snd_foldl_step _ D, snd_step]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_run
statement: theorem snd_run (D : List (Move α)) : (run d D).map Prod.snd = D.foldl (lstep d) []

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_step
statement:
theorem snd_step (s : List (ℕ × α)) (m : Move α) :
    (step d s m).map Prod.snd = lstep d (s.map Prod.snd) m

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Equiv.ncross_eq {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) : ncross X = ncross Y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.append
statement:
theorem Near.append {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l) (B : List (Move α))
    (hB : Fits (Y.foldl (lstep d) l).length B) :
    Φ.Near (n + ncross B) l (X ++ B) (Y ++ B)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.cons
StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.prefix
statement:
theorem Near.prefix {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (A : List (Move α))
    (h : Φ.Near n (A.foldl (lstep d) l) X Y) (hA : Fits l.length A) :
    Φ.Near (ncross A + n) l (A ++ X) (A ++ Y)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.refl
statement: theorem Near.refl (n : ℕ) (l : List α) (X : List (Move α)) : Φ.Near n l X X

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.symm
statement:
theorem Near.symm {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l) : Φ.Near n l Y X

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.trans
statement:
theorem Near.trans {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y Z : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (h' : Φ.Near n l Y Z) (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
    (e' : Y.foldl (lstep d) l = Z.foldl (lstep d) l) : Φ.Near n l X Z

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Respects.near_rw
statement:
theorem Respects.near_rw (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y)
    (hf : Fits l.length X) : Φ.Near (ncross X) l X Y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.comp_eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem comp_eqToHom_mem {n : ℕ} {l l' l'' : List α} {x : F.obj l ⟶ F.obj l'} (h : l' = l'')
    (hx : x ∈ Φ.sub n l l') : x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj h) ∈ Φ.sub n l l''

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.comp_sub_comp_eq
statement:
theorem comp_sub_comp_eq {X Y Y' Z Z' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X ⟶ Y') (g : Y ⟶ Z) (g' : Y' ⟶ Z')
    (h : Y = Y') (h' : Z = Z') (hg : g ≫ eqToHom h' = eqToHom h ≫ g') :
    (f ≫ g) ≫ eqToHom h' - f' ≫ g' = (f ≫ eqToHom h - f') ≫ g'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.eval_comp_mem
statement:
theorem eval_comp_mem {n : ℕ} {l₀ l : List α} {x : F.obj l₀ ⟶ F.obj l} (hx : x ∈ Φ.sub n l₀ l)
    {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    x ≫ F.eval l D ∈ Φ.sub (n + ncross D) l₀ (D.foldl (lstep d) l)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.mem_eval_comp
StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_bot_iff
statement:
theorem near_bot_iff {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} :
    (Filtration.bot F).Near n l X Y ↔ ∀ e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l,
      F.eval l X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj e) = F.eval l Y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ,
        Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : α,
        Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run d D))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_of_equiv
statement:
theorem near_of_equiv (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y)
    (hf : Fits l.length X) : Φ.Near (ncross X) l X Y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_append
statement:
theorem eval_append (l : List α) (D E : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l (D ++ E) = F.eval l D ≫ F.eval (D.foldl (lstep d) l) E ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (List.foldl_append).symm)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_congr
statement:
theorem eval_congr {l l' : List α} (h : l = l') (D : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l D ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (congrArg (D.foldl (lstep d)) h)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj h) ≫ F.eval l' D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_cons (l : List α) (m : Move α) (D : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l (m :: D) = F.map l m ≫ F.eval (lstep d l m) D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_nil (l : List α) : F.eval l [] = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Rw.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Rw.ncross_eq {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y) : ncross X = ncross Y

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Step.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Step.ncross_eq {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) : ncross L = ncross R

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_append
statement: @[simp] theorem ncross_append (D E : List (Move α)) : ncross (D ++ E) = ncross D + ncross E

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncross_cons (m : Move α) (D : List (Move α)) :
    ncross (m :: D) = m.ncross + ncross D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ncross_nil : ncross ([] : List (Move α)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.IsMatching.eq_of_min_eq
statement:
theorem IsMatching.eq_of_min_eq (hσ : IsMatching σ) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : min (i : ℕ) (σ i : ℕ) = min (j : ℕ) (σ j : ℕ)) : σ i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.refl
statement: theorem Iso.refl (s : List (ℕ × α)) : Iso s s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.trans
statement: theorem Iso.trans {s s' s'' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (h' : Iso s' s'') : Iso s s''

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_ofMatching_matchingOf
statement:
theorem canon_ofMatching_matchingOf :
    canon (ofMatching (matchingOf hv hn) (lettersOf s hn)) = canon s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.equiv_canon_matching_or_reducible
statement:
theorem equiv_canon_matching_or_reducible {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    Reducible D ∨ Equiv D (canon (ofMatching (matchingOf (inv_run (d := d) hf).1 rfl)
      (lettersOf (run d D) rfl)))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.getElem_ofMatching
statement:
theorem getElem_ofMatching (i : ℕ) (h : i < (ofMatching σ lab).length) :
    (ofMatching σ lab)[i] =
      (min i (σ ⟨i, by simpa using h⟩ : ℕ), lab ⟨i, by simpa using h⟩)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_ofMatching
statement:
theorem idAt_ofMatching (i : ℕ) :
    idAt (ofMatching σ lab) i = if h : i < n then some (min i (σ ⟨i, h⟩ : ℕ)) else none

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.isMatching_matchingOf
statement: theorem isMatching_matchingOf : IsMatching (matchingOf hv hn)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.iso_iff
statement:
theorem iso_iff {s' : List (ℕ × α)} (hv' : Valid s') (hn' : s'.length = n) :
    Iso s s' ↔ matchingOf hv hn = matchingOf hv' hn' ∧ lettersOf s hn = lettersOf s' hn'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.iso_ofMatching_matchingOf
statement: theorem iso_ofMatching_matchingOf : Iso (ofMatching (matchingOf hv hn) (lettersOf s hn)) s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_ofMatching
statement: @[simp] theorem length_ofMatching : (ofMatching σ lab).length = n

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lettered_ofMatching
statement:
theorem lettered_ofMatching {d : α → α} (hσ : IsMatching σ)
    (hlab : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < σ i → lab (σ i) = d (lab i)) : Lettered d (ofMatching σ lab)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lettersOf_ofMatching
statement:
theorem lettersOf_ofMatching (lab : Fin n → α) (hn : (ofMatching σ lab).length = n) :
    lettersOf (ofMatching σ lab) hn = lab

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_snd_eq_ofFn_lettersOf
statement:
theorem map_snd_eq_ofFn_lettersOf (s : List (ℕ × α)) (hn : s.length = n) :
    s.map Prod.snd = List.ofFn (lettersOf s hn)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_snd_ofMatching
statement: @[simp] theorem map_snd_ofMatching : (ofMatching σ lab).map Prod.snd = List.ofFn lab

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.matchingOf_apply
statement: theorem matchingOf_apply (i : Fin n) : matchingOf hv hn i = partner hv hn i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.matchingOf_ofMatching
statement:
theorem matchingOf_ofMatching (hσ : IsMatching σ) (lab : Fin n → α)
    (hv : Valid (ofMatching σ lab)) (hn : (ofMatching σ lab).length = n) :
    matchingOf hv hn = σ

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.matchingOf_run_canon
statement:
theorem matchingOf_run_canon (hσ : IsMatching σ)
    (hlab : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < σ i → lab (σ i) = d (lab i))
    (hv : Valid (run d (canon (ofMatching σ lab))))
    (hn : (run d (canon (ofMatching σ lab))).length = n) : matchingOf hv hn = σ

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ofMatching_inj
statement:
theorem ofMatching_inj {τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} (hσ : IsMatching σ) (hτ : IsMatching τ)
    {lab lab' : Fin n → α} : ofMatching σ lab = ofMatching τ lab' ↔ σ = τ ∧ lab = lab'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.partner_eq_iff
statement: theorem partner_eq_iff (i j : Fin n) : partner hv hn i = j ↔ Same s i j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.partner_involutive
statement: theorem partner_involutive : Function.Involutive (partner hv hn)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.run_canon_ofMatching
statement:
theorem run_canon_ofMatching (hσ : IsMatching σ)
    (hlab : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) < σ i → lab (σ i) = d (lab i)) :
    Fits 0 (canon (ofMatching σ lab)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin n, Same (run d (canon (ofMatching σ lab))) i j ↔ σ i = j) ∧
      (run d (canon (ofMatching σ lab))).map Prod.snd = List.ofFn lab

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_iff_matchingOf
statement: theorem same_iff_matchingOf (i j : Fin n) : Same s i j ↔ matchingOf hv hn i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_ofMatching
statement:
theorem same_ofMatching (hσ : IsMatching σ) (i j : Fin n) :
    Same (ofMatching σ lab) i j ↔ σ i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_ofMatching_iff
statement:
theorem same_ofMatching_iff (hσ : IsMatching σ) {i j : ℕ} :
    Same (ofMatching σ lab) i j ↔ ∃ (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n), σ ⟨i, hi⟩ = ⟨j, hj⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_partner
statement: theorem same_partner (i : Fin n) : Same s i (partner hv hn i)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.valid_ofMatching
statement: theorem valid_ofMatching (hσ : IsMatching σ) : Valid (ofMatching σ lab)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_add
statement:
theorem castHom_add (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (f + g) = P.castHom ha hb f + P.castHom ha hb g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_castHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_castHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (ha' : a' = a'') (hb' : b' = b'')
    (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha' hb' (P.castHom ha hb f) = P.castHom (ha.trans ha') (hb.trans hb') f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_comp
statement:
theorem castHom_comp (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) :
    P.castHom ha hc (f ≫ g) = P.castHom ha hb f ≫ P.castHom hb hc g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_diag (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (P.diag f) = P.diag (Diagram.cast f ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_eqToHom
statement:
theorem castHom_eqToHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (h : P.obj a = P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [← ha, ← hb, h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_eq_iff
statement:
theorem castHom_eq_iff (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
    (g : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj b') : P.castHom ha hb f = g ↔ f = P.castHom ha.symm hb.symm g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_id
statement: @[simp] theorem castHom_id (ha : a = a') : P.castHom ha ha (𝟙 (P.obj a)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_inj
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_inj (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') {f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} :
    P.castHom ha hb f = P.castHom ha hb g ↔ f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_injective
statement: theorem castHom_injective (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') : Function.Injective (P.castHom ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_lin (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (P.lin f) = P.lin (LinDiagram.cast f ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_neg
statement:
theorem castHom_neg (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (-f) = -P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_rfl
statement: @[simp] theorem castHom_rfl (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : P.castHom rfl rfl f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_smul
statement:
theorem castHom_smul (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (r • f) = r • P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_sub
statement:
theorem castHom_sub (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (f - g) = P.castHom ha hb f - P.castHom ha hb g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_zero (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem castLinearEquiv_apply (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castLinearEquiv ha hb f = P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem castLinearEquiv_symm_apply (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (f : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj b') :
    (P.castLinearEquiv ha hb).symm f = P.castHom ha.symm hb.symm f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq (f : a ⟶ b) (g : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b)
    (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) : P.diag f = P.castHom ha hb (P.diag g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_diag_iff_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_diag_iff_of_layers_eq (A B : a ⟶ b) (A' B' : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') (hA : Diagram.layers A = Diagram.layers A')
    (hB : Diagram.layers B = Diagram.layers B') : P.diag A = P.diag B ↔ P.diag A' = P.diag B'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_transfer
statement:
theorem diag_transfer (A B : a ⟶ b) (A' B' : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (hA : Diagram.layers A = Diagram.layers A') (hB : Diagram.layers B = Diagram.layers B')
    (h : P.diag A' = P.diag B') : P.diag A = P.diag B

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.endCast_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem endCast_apply (h : a = a') (f : End (P.obj a)) : P.endCast h f = P.castHom h h f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.endCast_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem endCast_symm_apply (h : a = a') (f : End (P.obj a')) :
    (P.endCast h).symm f = P.castHom h.symm h.symm f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_cast
statement:
theorem lin_cast (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast f ha hb) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.lin f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_subalgebra_of_layers
statement:
theorem mem_subalgebra_of_layers {a : Obj S}
    (ha : ∀ (L : Layer S), L.Valid → L.dom = a → L.cod = a) (A : Subalgebra R (End (P.obj a)))
    (hA : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (hd : L.dom = a), P.layer L hv hd (ha L hv hd) ∈ A)
    (f : End (P.obj a)) : f ∈ A

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_castHom
statement:
theorem whisk_castHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (P.castHom ha hb f) u v =
      P.castHom (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) ha) (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) hb)
        (P.whisk f u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.eq_of_cod_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_cod_eq {L L' : Layer S} (hc : L.cod = L'.cod)
    (hl : L.left.length = L'.left.length) (hg : L.gen = L'.gen) : L = L'

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.eq_of_dom_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_dom_eq {L L' : Layer S} (hd : L.dom = L'.dom)
    (hl : L.left.length = L'.left.length) (hg : L.gen = L'.gen) : L = L'

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whiskerAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerAlgHom_apply (a u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (f : End (Free.of R a)) : whiskerAlgHom R a u v hw f = whisker f u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = ((if S.odd g && S.odd h then -1 else 1 : ℤ) : R) • P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (hgh : S.odd g = false ∨ S.odd h = false) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_odd
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers_of_odd {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (hg : S.odd g = true) (hh : S.odd h = true) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = -P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.linAlgHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem linAlgHom_apply (a : Obj S) (f : End (Free.of R a)) : P.linAlgHom a f = P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskAlgHom_apply (a u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (f : End (P.obj a)) : P.whiskAlgHom a u v hw f = P.whisk f u v

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.chain_layersOf
statement:
theorem chain_layersOf (l : List S.Colour) (D : List (Move S.Colour)) :
    Chain ⟨r₀, l⟩ (G.layersOf r₀ l D) ⟨r₀, D.foldl (lstep d) l⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.chain_moveLayers
statement:
theorem chain_moveLayers (l : List S.Colour) (m : Move S.Colour) :
    Chain ⟨r₀, l⟩ (G.moveLayers r₀ l m) ⟨r₀, lstep d l m⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq {a b b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (f' : a ⟶ b') (h : b = b')
    (hl : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers f') :
    P.diag f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) = P.diag f'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_mk_congr
statement:
theorem diag_mk_congr {a b : Obj S} {ls ls' : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (e : ls = ls') :
    P.diag ⟨ls, h⟩ = P.diag ⟨ls', e ▸ h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_mk_singleton
statement:
theorem diag_mk_singleton {a b : Obj S} (L : Layer S) (h : Chain a [L] b) :
    P.diag ⟨[L], h⟩ = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h.2.1.symm) ≫
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L h.1) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h.2.2)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.eval_comp_eqToHom_eq
statement:
theorem eval_comp_eqToHom_eq {l : List S.Colour} {X Y : List (Move S.Colour)}
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
    (f : (⟨r₀, l⟩ : Obj S) ⟶ ⟨r₀, Y.foldl (lstep d) l⟩) (hf : Diagram.layers f = G.layersOf r₀ l X) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).eval l X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (G.interp r₀ P).obj e) = P.diag f

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.eval_interp
statement:
theorem eval_interp (l : List S.Colour) (D : List (Move S.Colour)) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).eval l D = P.diag ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l D, G.chain_layersOf r₀ l D⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.layersOf_pair
statement:
theorem layersOf_pair (l : List S.Colour) (m₁ m₂ : Move S.Colour) :
    G.layersOf r₀ l [m₁, m₂] = G.moveLayers r₀ l m₁ ++ G.moveLayers r₀ (lstep d l m₁) m₂

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.layersOf_shift
statement:
theorem layersOf_shift (u v : List S.Colour) {l : List S.Colour} {D : List (Move S.Colour)}
    (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    G.layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (D.map (Move.shift u.length)) =
      (G.layersOf r₀ l D).map (·.whisker ⟨r₀, u⟩ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.map_interp_of_singleton
statement:
theorem map_interp_of_singleton {l : List S.Colour} {m : Move S.Colour} {L : Layer S}
    (h : G.moveLayers r₀ l m = [L]) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).map l m = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ((h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m :
        Chain _ [L] _).2.1.symm)) ≫
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L (h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m : Chain _ [L] _).1) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m : Chain _ [L] _).2.2)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cross
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cross (u : List S.Colour) (x y : S.Colour) (t : List S.Colour) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross u.length) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cross x y, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cross'
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cross' (u : List S.Colour) (x y : S.Colour) (t : List S.Colour) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : u.length = p) : G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross p) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cross x y, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cup
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cup (u t : List S.Colour) (a : S.Colour) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ t) (.cup u.length a) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cup a, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cup'
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cup' (u t : List S.Colour) (a : S.Colour) {g : ℕ} (hg : u.length = g) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ t) (.cup g a) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cup a, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem moveLayers_eq_singleton {l : List S.Colour} {m : Move S.Colour} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    ∃ L, G.moveLayers r₀ l m = [L]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_shift
statement:
theorem moveLayers_shift (u l v : List S.Colour) {m : Move S.Colour} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (m.shift u.length) =
      (G.moveLayers r₀ l m).map (·.whisker ⟨r₀, u⟩ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1)
    (hbraid : ∀ a b c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 3 [a, b, c]
      [.cross 0, .cross 1, .cross 0] [.cross 1, .cross 0, .cross 1])
    (hpitch : ∀ a c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 1 [c]
      [.cup 0 a, .cross 1] [.cup 1 a, .cross 0])
    {D : List (Move S.Colour)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move S.Colour), ∃ p : ℕ, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) []
        D (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move S.Colour), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : S.Colour,
        (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run d D))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_of_diag_eq
StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_shift
statement:
theorem near_shift (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1) {n : ℕ} {l : List S.Colour}
    {X Y : List (Move S.Colour)} (h : (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near n l X Y)
    (hX : Fits l.length X) (hY : Fits l.length Y) (u v : List S.Colour) :
    (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near n (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length))
      (Y.map (Move.shift u.length))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_uu
statement:
theorem near_uu (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n g g' : ℕ} (a b : S.Colour) (hg : g' ≤ g)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [(.cup g a : Move S.Colour), .cup g' b]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cup g a, .cup g' b] [.cup g' b, .cup (g + 2) a]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xuL
statement:
theorem near_xuL (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p g : ℕ} (a : S.Colour) (hp : p + 2 ≤ g)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [.cross p, (.cup g a : Move S.Colour)]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cup g a] [.cup g a, .cross p]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xuR
statement:
theorem near_xuR (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p g : ℕ} (a : S.Colour) (hg : g ≤ p)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [.cross p, (.cup g a : Move S.Colour)]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cup g a] [.cup g a, .cross (p + 2)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xx
statement:
theorem near_xx (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p p' : ℕ} (hp : p + 2 ≤ p')
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length ([.cross p, .cross p'] : List (Move S.Colour))) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cross p'] [.cross p', .cross p]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.respects
statement:
theorem respects (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1)
    (hbraid : ∀ a b c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 3 [a, b, c]
      [.cross 0, .cross 1, .cross 0] [.cross 1, .cross 0, .cross 1])
    (hpitch : ∀ a c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 1 [c]
      [.cup 0 a, .cross 1] [.cup 1 a, .cross 0]) :
    (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Respects

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.comp_eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem comp_eqToHom_mem {n : ℕ} {a b b' : Obj S} (h : b = b') {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b}
    (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n a b) : x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) ∈ Q.sub n a b'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.comp_layer_mem'
statement:
theorem comp_layer_mem' {n : ℕ} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) {a b c : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) {x : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj a} (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n c a) :
    x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb) ∈ Q.sub (n + wt L.gen) c b

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.eqToHom_comp_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_mem {n : ℕ} {a a' b : Obj S} (h : a' = a) {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b}
    (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n a b) : eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) ≫ x ∈ Q.sub n a' b

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.layer_comp_mem'
statement:
theorem layer_comp_mem' {n : ℕ} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) {a b c : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) {x : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c} (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n b c) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb)) ≫ x ∈ Q.sub (wt L.gen + n) a c

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Move.len_shift
statement: theorem Move.len_shift (k j n : ℕ) (m : Move α) : (m.shift k).len (k + n + j) = k + m.len n + j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Move.ok_shift
statement: theorem Move.ok_shift {n : ℕ} (k m' : ℕ) {m : Move α} (hm : m.Ok n) : (m.shift k).Ok (k + n + m')

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.exists_eq_append
statement:
theorem exists_eq_append {l : List β} {g : ℕ} (h : g ≤ l.length) :
    ∃ u t, l = u ++ t ∧ u.length = g

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.exists_eq_append_cons_cons
statement:
theorem exists_eq_append_cons_cons {l : List β} {p : ℕ} (h : p + 1 < l.length) :
    ∃ u x y t, l = u ++ x :: y :: t ∧ u.length = p

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.fits_shift
statement:
theorem fits_shift (k j : ℕ) {n : ℕ} {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits n D) :
    Fits (k + n + j) (D.map (Move.shift k))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.foldl_shift
statement:
theorem foldl_shift (u v : List α) {l : List α} {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    (D.map (Move.shift u.length)).foldl (lstep d) (u ++ l ++ v) = u ++ D.foldl (lstep d) l ++ v

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cross_append
statement:
theorem lstep_cross_append (u : List α) (x y : α) (t : List α) :
    lstep d (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross u.length) = u ++ y :: x :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cross_append'
statement:
theorem lstep_cross_append' (u : List α) (x y : α) (t : List α) {p : ℕ} (hp : u.length = p) :
    lstep d (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross p) = u ++ y :: x :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cup_append
statement:
theorem lstep_cup_append (u t : List α) (a : α) :
    lstep d (u ++ t) (.cup u.length a) = u ++ a :: d a :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cup_append'
statement:
theorem lstep_cup_append' (u t : List α) (a : α) {g : ℕ} (hg : u.length = g) :
    lstep d (u ++ t) (.cup g a) = u ++ a :: d a :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_shift
statement:
theorem lstep_shift (u l v : List α) {m : Move α} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    lstep d (u ++ l ++ v) (m.shift u.length) = u ++ lstep d l m ++ v

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_append_cons_cons
statement:
theorem swapAt_append_cons_cons (u : List β) (x y : β) (t : List β) :
    swapAt (u ++ x :: y :: t) u.length = u ++ y :: x :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.congr
statement:
theorem Chain.congr {a a' b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') : Chain a' ls b'

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.of_append
statement:
theorem Chain.of_append {a b : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a (ls ++ ms) b) :
    Chain a ls (Chain.target a ls) ∧ Chain (Chain.target a ls) ms b

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.ok
statement: theorem Chain.ok {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (ha : a.Ok) : b.Ok

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.source_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.source_eq {a a' b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (hne : ls ≠ [])
    (h : Chain a ls b) (h' : Chain a' ls b) : a = a'

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_unique
statement:
theorem Chain.target_unique {a b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    (h' : Chain a ls b') : b = b'

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.cod_obj_ok
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.cod_obj_ok {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.cod.Ok

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.dom_obj_ok
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.dom_obj_ok {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.dom.Ok

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.chain
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.chain {a a' b b' : Obj S} (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) {F G : List (Layer S)}
    (hF : Chain a F a') (hG : Chain b G b') : SideBySideOK u m v a' b'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.of_ok
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.of_ok {a b : Obj S} (hu : S.ok u.start u.word) (ha : a.Ok)
    (hm : S.ok a.endR m) (hb : b.Ok) (hv : S.ok b.endR v) (hua : u.endR = a.start)
    (hmb : S.endR a.endR m = b.start) : SideBySideOK u m v a b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.parts
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.parts {a b : Obj S} (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) :
    S.ok u.start u.word ∧ a.Ok ∧ S.ok a.endR m ∧ b.Ok ∧ S.ok b.endR v

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.chain_leftLayers
statement:
theorem chain_leftLayers {a a' e : Obj S} {F : List (Layer S)} (hF : Chain a F a')
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a e) :
    Chain (sbs u m v a e) (leftLayers u m v F e) (sbs u m v a' e)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.chain_rightLayers
statement:
theorem chain_rightLayers {b b' c : Obj S} {G : List (Layer S)} (hG : Chain b G b')
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v c b) :
    Chain (sbs u m v c b) (rightLayers u m v G c) (sbs u m v c b')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b) (g₁ g₂ : a' ⟶ b')
    (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = Diagram.layers g₁)
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = Diagram.layers g₂) (h : P.diag g₁ = P.diag g₂) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append {a b : Obj S} (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b) (X Y Z Z' : List (Layer S))
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = X ++ Z ++ Y) (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = X ++ Z' ++ Y)
    (hZ : ∀ (c d : Obj S) (g₁ g₂ : c ⟶ d), Chain a X c → Diagram.layers g₁ = Z →
      Diagram.layers g₂ = Z' → P.diag g₁ = P.diag g₂) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_layer_right
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_layer_right {a a' : Obj S} {F : List (Layer S)} (hF : Chain a F a')
    {M : Layer S} (hM : M.Valid) (heven : ∀ L ∈ F, S.odd L.gen = false ∨ S.odd M.gen = false)
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a M.dom)
    (f₁ f₂ : sbs u m v a M.dom ⟶ sbs u m v a' M.cod)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = leftLayers u m v F M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] a')
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = rightLayers u m v [M] a ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_layers_of_even
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_layers_of_even {a a' b b' : Obj S} {F G : List (Layer S)}
    (hF : Chain a F a') (hG : Chain b G b')
    (heven : ∀ L ∈ F, ∀ M ∈ G, S.odd L.gen = false ∨ S.odd M.gen = false)
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) (f₁ f₂ : sbs u m v a b ⟶ sbs u m v a' b')
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = leftLayers u m v F b ++ rightLayers u m v G a')
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = rightLayers u m v G a ++ leftLayers u m v F b') :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mk_append
statement:
theorem diag_mk_append {a b c : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h₁ : Chain a ls b)
    (h₂ : Chain b ms c) :
    P.diag (Diagram.mk (ls ++ ms) (h₁.append h₂)) = P.diag (Diagram.mk ls h₁) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.mk ms h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.letters_obj
statement: theorem letters_obj (ρ : S.Region) (l : List S.Colour) : (letters S).obj ρ l = ⟨ρ, l⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.letters_word
statement: @[simp] theorem letters_word (ρ : S.Region) (l : List S.Colour) : (letters S).word ρ l = l

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.comp_diag_mem
statement:
theorem comp_diag_mem {n : ℕ} {a b c : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.RegionChordGens.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (Q : LayerFiltration P wt)
    (hcup : ∀ ρ a, layerWeight wt (G.cup ρ a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ ρ a b, layerWeight wt (G.cross ρ a b) = 1)
    (hbraid : ∀ (ρ : S.Region) (a b c : α), (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near 3 [a, b, c]
      [.cross 0, .cross 1, .cross 0] [.cross 1, .cross 0, .cross 1])
    (hpitch : ∀ (ρ : S.Region) (a c : α), (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near 1 [c]
      [.cup 0 a, .cross 1] [.cup 1 a, .cross 0]) (ρ : S.Region)
    {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ, (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) []
        D (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : α,
        (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run d D))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.RegionChordGens.near_of_diag_eq
StringDiagrams.Chord.RegionChordGens.near_shift
statement:
theorem near_shift (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ ρ a, layerWeight wt (G.cup ρ a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ ρ a b, layerWeight wt (G.cross ρ a b) = 1) (ρ : S.Region) {n : ℕ}
    {w : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (u t : List α)
    (h : (G.toFiltration (Λ.lreg ρ t) Q hcup hcross).Near n w X Y)
    (hX : Fits w.length X) (hY : Fits w.length Y) :
    (G.toFiltration ρ Q hcup hcross).Near n (u ++ w ++ t) (X.map (Move.shift u.length))
      (Y.map (Move.shift u.length))

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits
statement:
theorem foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ) (acc : ℕ),
      L.reverse.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + d) acc = acc * 10 ^ L.length + Nat.ofDigits 10 L
  | [], acc => by simp
  | d :: L, acc => by
    rw [List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append, foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits L acc]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, List.length_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, pow_succ]
    ring

  | [], _, rest, acc => by simp
  | c :: n, h, rest, acc => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_render
statement:
theorem lexAux_render : ∀ ts : List Tok, ts.all Tok.wf = true → lexAux (render ts) [] = ts
  | [], _ => rfl
  | t :: ts, h => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have ih := lexAux_render ts h.2
    rw [render_cons]
    cases t with
    | ident s =>
      obtain ⟨hne, hs⟩

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseLayers_layersToks

theorem parseLayers_layersToks :
    ∀ (ls : List (Layer S)) (a b : Obj S), Chain a ls b → ls ≠ [] →

  | [], _, _, _, h => absurd rfl h
  | L :: ls, a, b, ⟨hv, hdom, hc⟩, _ => by

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.readDigits_map_digitChar
statement:
theorem readDigits_map_digitChar :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ), (∀ d ∈ L, d < 10) → ∀ acc,
      readDigits acc (L.map digitChar) = some (L.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + d) acc)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | d :: L, h, acc => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, readDigits, charDigit_digitChar (h d (by simp)), List.foldl_cons]
    exact readDigits_map_digitChar L (fun d hd => h d (by simp [hd])) _

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.layers_rightBelow
statement:
theorem layers_rightBelow (e : S.genDom x.h ⟶ S.genCod x.h) :

theorem single_eq_smul_of (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :

theorem smul_comp_lin (r : R) (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :

theorem toList_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (F : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :

theorem toList_comp_of (F : LinDiagram R a b) (g : b ⟶ c) :

theorem toList_mapDomain {a' b' : Obj S} (φ : (a ⟶ b) → (a' ⟶ b'))

statement:
theorem toList_of (d : a ⟶ b) :

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_single
statement:
theorem toList_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_comp
statement:
theorem derivDiag_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :

statement: theorem derivDiag_eqToHom (h : a = b) : D.derivDiag (eqToHom h) = (0 : LinDiagram R a b)

statement:
theorem derivDiag_gh (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) :
    D.derivDiag (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (S.odd x.h).toNat) • Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftBelow (D.δ x.g) +
        Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightAbove (D.δ x.h)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_hg
statement:
theorem derivDiag_hg (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) :
    D.derivDiag (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (S.odd x.g).toNat) • Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightBelow (D.δ x.h) +
        Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftAbove (D.δ x.g)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_id
statement: theorem derivDiag_id (a : Obj S) : D.derivDiag (𝟙 a) = (0 : LinDiagram R a a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_layer
statement:
theorem derivDiag_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_layer_of
statement:
theorem derivDiag_layer_of (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b)
    (d : S.genDom L.gen ⟶ S.genCod L.gen) (hd : D.δ L.gen = of d) :
    D.derivDiag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb) =
      of (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker d ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right hv.genWhiskerOK) ha hb)

statement: theorem derivDiag_ofGen (g : S.Gen) : D.derivDiag (ofGen g) = D.δ g

statement:
theorem derivDiag_whisker (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_cast
statement:
theorem derivFree_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (F : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_comp
statement:
theorem derivFree_comp (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    D.derivFree (F ≫ G) = D.derivFree F ≫ parityInv G + F ≫ D.derivFree G

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_derivFree_comp
statement:
theorem derivFree_derivFree_comp (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    D.derivFree (D.derivFree (F ≫ G)) =
      D.derivFree (D.derivFree F) ≫ G + F ≫ D.derivFree (D.derivFree G)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem derivFree_mem_ideal (hP : D.Compatible P) {a b : Obj S} {F : LinDiagram R a b}

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_of
statement: @[simp] theorem derivFree_of (d : a ⟶ b) : D.derivFree (of d : LinDiagram R a b) = D.derivDiag d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_single
statement:
theorem derivFree_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    D.derivFree (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • D.derivDiag d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_single_comp_single
statement:
theorem derivFree_single_comp_single (d : a ⟶ b) (e : b ⟶ c) (r s : R) :
    D.derivFree ((Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫ (Finsupp.single e s : LinDiagram R b c)) =
      D.derivFree (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫
          parityInv (Finsupp.single e s : LinDiagram R b c) +
        (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫ D.derivFree (Finsupp.single e s)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_whisk
statement:
theorem derivFree_whisk (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_whisker
statement:
theorem derivFree_whisker (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_append
statement:
theorem derivL_append (ls ms : List (Layer S)) :
    D.derivL (ls ++ ms) = ((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ms) •
      Finsupp.mapDomain (· ++ ms) (D.derivL ls) + Finsupp.mapDomain (ls ++ ·) (D.derivL ms)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_cons
statement:
theorem derivL_cons (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    D.derivL (L :: ls) = ((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ls) •
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun l => l.map (·.whisker ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right) ++ ls)
        (toList (D.δ L.gen)) +
      Finsupp.mapDomain (L :: ·) (D.derivL ls)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_map_whisker
statement:
theorem derivL_map_whisker (ls : List (Layer S)) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    D.derivL (ls.map (·.whisker u v)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (List.map (·.whisker u v)) (D.derivL ls)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem derivL_nil : D.derivL [] = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.diag_cast_interchange
statement:
theorem diag_cast_interchange {a a' b b' c c' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b')
    (hc : a.tensor b = c) (hc' : a'.tensor b' = c') :
    P.diag (cast (whiskerR f b ≫ whiskerL a' g) hc hc') =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) •
        P.diag (cast (whiskerL a g ≫ whiskerR f b') hc hc')

statement:
theorem lin_mapDomain_eq_smul {a b c d : Obj S} (φ ψ : (a ⟶ b) → (c ⟶ d))
    (F : LinDiagram R a b) (k : R)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ Finsupp.support F, P.diag (φ e) = k • P.diag (ψ e)) :
    P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain φ F : LinDiagram R c d) =
      k • P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain ψ F : LinDiagram R c d)

statement: theorem toList_derivDiag (d : a ⟶ b) : toList (D.derivDiag d) = D.derivL (Diagram.layers d)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.derivEnd_apply
statement: theorem derivEnd_apply (f : End (P.obj a)) : P.derivEnd hP a f = P.deriv hP f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp
statement:
theorem deriv_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {G : LinDiagram R b c} {p : ℕ} (hG : G.HasParity p) :
    P.deriv hP (f ≫ P.lin G) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ p) • (P.deriv hP f ≫ P.lin G) + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.lin G)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp_diag
statement:
theorem deriv_comp_diag (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    P.deriv hP (f ≫ P.diag g) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ oddCount g) • (P.deriv hP f ≫ P.diag g) + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.diag g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp_lin
statement:
theorem deriv_comp_lin (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    P.deriv hP (P.lin F ≫ P.lin G) =
      P.deriv hP (P.lin F) ≫ P.lin (parityInv G) + P.lin F ≫ P.deriv hP (P.lin G)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_deriv_comp
statement:
theorem deriv_deriv_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) :
    P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (f ≫ g)) =
      P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP f) ≫ g + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP g)

statement: theorem deriv_id (a : Obj S) : P.deriv hP (𝟙 (P.obj a)) = 0

statement:

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_layer_of
statement:
theorem deriv_layer_of (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b)
    (d : S.genDom L.gen ⟶ S.genCod L.gen) (hd : D.δ L.gen = LinDiagram.of d) :
    P.deriv hP (P.diag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb)) =
      P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker d ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right hv.genWhiskerOK) ha hb)

statement: @[simp] theorem deriv_lin (F : LinDiagram R a b) : P.deriv hP (P.lin F) = P.lin (D.derivFree F)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_mul
statement:
theorem deriv_mul (f g : End (P.obj a)) {F : LinDiagram R a a} {p : ℕ} (hF : F.HasParity p)
    (hf : P.lin F = f) :
    P.derivEnd hP a (f * g) = P.derivEnd hP a f * g + ((-1 : R) ^ p) • (f * P.derivEnd hP a g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_ofGen

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons
statement:
theorem functor_map_mk_cons {a b : Obj S} (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S))

    I.functor.map (Diagram.mk (L :: ls) h) =
      eqToHom (congrArg I.obj h.2.1.symm) ≫ I.layer L h.1 ≫
        I.functor.map (Diagram.mk ls h.2.2)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_add (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (X + Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.evalW i j u v X + Q.evalW i j u v Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (i j : ι) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) =
      Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.cod x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ ∘ₗ
          Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.ext i -
        ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.cod x.h ++ v)⟩ ∘ₗ
            Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange_eq_zero
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange_eq_zero
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      Q.res (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ (m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)))⟩) ∘ₗ
          Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ
          Q.ext (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩) =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.res (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ (m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)))⟩) ∘ₗ
            Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ
            Q.ext (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩)))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    Q.evalW (Q.κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (x.cod.whisker u v)) u v
      (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange_eq_zero_of_comm
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange_eq_zero_of_comm
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    Q.evalW (Q.κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (x.cod.whisker u v)) u v
      (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_neg (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (-X : LinDiagram R a b) = -Q.evalW i j u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) ∘ₗ Q.ext i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_of_apply
statement:
theorem evalW_of_apply (d : a ⟶ b) (x : M i) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) x =
      Q.res j (Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) (Q.ext i x))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      r • (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_smul (r : R) (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (r • X : LinDiagram R a b) = r • Q.evalW i j u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_sub (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (X - Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.evalW i j u v X - Q.evalW i j u v Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem evalW_zero : Q.evalW i j u v (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_add (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_neg (X : LinDiagram R a b) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_of
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_of_apply
statement:
theorem eval_of_apply (d : a ⟶ b) (x : M i) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    Q.eval i j (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      r • (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers d) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_smul (r : R) (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (r • X : LinDiagram R a b) = r • Q.eval i j X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_sub (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (X - Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.eval i j X - Q.eval i j Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_whisker
statement:
theorem eval_whisker (X : LinDiagram R a b) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_zero : Q.eval i j (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_apply
statement:
theorem functor_map_apply {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (x : M (Q.κ a)) :
    (Q.functor.map f).hom x = Q.res (Q.κ b) (Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) (Q.ext (Q.κ a) x))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_hom {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Q.functor.map f).hom = Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_layer_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_layer_hom (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) {a b : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) :
    (Q.functor.map (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb)).hom =
      Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.op L ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_transport
statement:
theorem functor_map_transport {a b : Obj S} {i j : ι} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : Q.κ a = i)
    (hb : Q.κ b = j) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) ha.symm) ≫ Q.functor.map f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) hb) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem functor_obj (a : Obj S) : Q.functor.obj a = mod (M := M) (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem interp_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    Q.interp.layer L hv = ModuleCat.ofHom (Q.res (Q.κ L.cod) ∘ₗ Q.op L ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ L.dom))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_mapChain_hom

theorem interp_mapChain_hom {a b : Obj S} (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    (Q.interp.mapChain a ls b h).hom = Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.opList ls ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem interp_obj (a : Obj S) : Q.interp.obj a = mod (M := M) (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_append

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_nil_apply

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.piList_nil

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.piList_singleton

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_functor_map_transport

    (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) ha.symm) ≫ (pi κ A hκ).functor.map f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) hb) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (piList A i (Diagram.layers f))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_op_apply

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.res_ext_apply

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.res_opList_ext_res

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_eval_of_apply

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_del_ge
statement:
theorem getD_del_ge {p q : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : p ≤ q) :
    (del p w).getD q 0 = w.getD (q + 2) 0

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_del_lt
statement:
theorem getD_del_lt {p q : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : q < p) (hp : p + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    (del p w).getD q 0 = w.getD q 0

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_ge
statement:
theorem getD_ins_ge {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD (q + 2) 0 = w.getD q 0

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_lt
statement:
theorem getD_ins_lt {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : q < p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD q 0 = w.getD q 0

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem getD_ins_self (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD p 0 = a

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem getD_ins_succ (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD (p + 1) 0 = b

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins_inj
statement:
theorem ins_inj {p : ℕ} {a b a' b' : Fin 2} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length)
    (h : ins p a b w = ins p a' b' w) : a = a' ∧ b = b'

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins_ins
statement:
theorem ins_ins {p k : ℕ} (a b c d : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k ≤ w.length) :
    ins (p + 2 + k) c d (ins p a b w) = ins p a b (ins (p + k) c d w)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.length_del
statement:
theorem length_del {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    (del p w).length + 2 = w.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.length_ins
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_ins (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    (ins p a b w).length = w.length + 2

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_ext
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_ext (n : ℕ) : (loc R).ext n = ext R n

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_op
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_op (L : Layer sig) : (loc R).op L = op R L

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_opList
statement: theorem loc_opList (ls : List (Layer sig)) : (loc R).opList ls = evalLayers R ls

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_res
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_res (n : ℕ) : (loc R).res n = res R n

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_κ
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_κ (a : Obj sig) : (loc R).κ a = a.word.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loop_op
statement:
theorem loop_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R p (cupOp R p F) w = -2 * F w

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.mapChain_apply
statement:
theorem mapChain_apply {a b : Obj sig} (ls : List (Layer sig)) (h : Chain a ls b)
    (f : Word a.word.length → R) (w : Word b.word.length) :
    ((interp R).mapChain a ls b h).hom f w = evalLayers R ls (ext R _ f) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.map_apply
statement:
theorem map_apply {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) (f : Word a.word.length → R)
    (w : Word b.word.length) :
    ((interp R).functor.map d).hom f w = evalLayers R (Diagram.layers d) (ext R _ f) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_agree
statement:
theorem op_agree (L : Layer sig) {F F' : Fn R} (h : Agree L.dom.word.length F F') :
    Agree L.cod.word.length (op R L F) (op R L F')

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem op_cap (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) : op R ⟨s, l, .cap, r⟩ = capOp R l.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem op_cup (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) : op R ⟨s, l, .cup, r⟩ = cupOp R l.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.res_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem res_apply (n : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : Word n) : res R n F w = F w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrict_apply (n m : ℕ) (T : Fn R →ₗ[R] Fn R) (f : Word n → R) (w : Word m) :
    restrict R n m T f w = T (ext R n f) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.set_getD_self
statement: theorem set_getD_self {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) : w.set p (w.getD p 0) = w

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_cod_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_cod_cap : sig.cod .cap = []

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_cod_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_cod_cup : sig.cod .cup = [(), ()]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_dom_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_dom_cap : sig.dom .cap = [(), ()]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_dom_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_dom_cup : sig.dom .cup = []

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagA_op
statement:
theorem zigzagA_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R p (cupOp R (p + 1) F) w = F w

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagB_op
statement:
theorem zigzagB_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R (p + 1) (cupOp R p F) w = F w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsDyck.del_pair
statement:
theorem IsDyck.del_pair {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 2 ≤ w.length)
    (h0 : w.getD p 0 = 0) (h1 : w.getD (p + 1) 0 = 1) : IsDyck (del p w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsDyck.ins_pair
statement:
theorem IsDyck.ins_pair {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ w.length) :
    IsDyck (ins i 0 1 w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsDyck.length_even
statement: theorem IsDyck.length_even {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) : Even w.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_append
statement: @[simp] theorem bal_append (u v : List (Fin 2)) : bal (u ++ v) = bal u + bal v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem bal_cons (a : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) : bal (a :: w) = step a + bal w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_ins
statement:
theorem bal_ins (i : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {x : List (Fin 2)} (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    bal (ins i a b x) = bal x + step a + step b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem bal_nil : bal [] = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_replicate_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bal_replicate_zero (n : ℕ) : bal (List.replicate n 0) = n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_take_ins
statement:
theorem bal_take_ins (i k : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {x : List (Fin 2)} (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    bal ((ins i a b x).take k) =
      if k ≤ i then bal (x.take k) else if k = i + 1 then bal (x.take i) + step a
      else bal (x.take (k - 2)) + step a + step b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bal_take_succ
statement:
theorem bal_take_succ {k : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : k < w.length) :
    bal (w.take (k + 1)) = bal (w.take k) + step (w.getD k 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capT_ins_left
statement:
theorem capT_ins_left {i p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) (hpi : p ≤ i)
    (hi : i + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    capT (i + 2) (ins p 0 1 w) = ins p 0 1 (capT i w) ∧
      loopT (i + 2) (ins p 0 1 w) = loopT i w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capT_ins_right
statement:
theorem capT_ins_right {i p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) (hip : i + 2 ≤ p)
    (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    capT i (ins p 0 1 w) = ins (p - 2) 0 1 (capT i w) ∧ loopT i (ins p 0 1 w) = loopT i w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capT_rep_pred
statement:
theorem capT_rep_pred (p : ℕ) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    capT p (List.replicate (p + 1) 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) = List.replicate (p + 1) 0 ++ r ∧
      loopT p (List.replicate (p + 1) 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) = false

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capT_rep_self
statement:
theorem capT_rep_self (p : ℕ) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    capT p (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) = List.replicate p 0 ++ r ∧
      loopT p (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) = true

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capT_rep_succ
statement:
theorem capT_rep_succ (p : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    capT (p + 1) (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: c :: r) = List.replicate p 0 ++ c :: r ∧
      loopT (p + 1) (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: c :: r) = false

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.decomp_of_head
statement:
theorem decomp_of_head {w : List (Fin 2)} (h0 : w.head? = some 0) (h1 : (1 : Fin 2) ∈ w) :
    ∃ r, w = List.replicate (firstPair w) 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.del_rep
statement:
theorem del_rep (j : ℕ) (c a b : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    del j (List.replicate j c ++ a :: b :: r) = List.replicate j c ++ r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.dle_antisymm
statement:
theorem dle_antisymm {t w : List (Fin 2)} (h₁ : dle t w) (h₂ : dle w t)
    (hl : t.length = w.length) : t = w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.dle_ins
statement:
theorem dle_ins {t w : List (Fin 2)} (h : dle t w) {p : ℕ} (ht : p ≤ t.length)
    (hw : p ≤ w.length) {a b : Fin 2} (hab : step a + step b = 0) :
    dle (ins p a b t) (ins p 0 1 w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.dle_refl
statement: theorem dle_refl (w : List (Fin 2)) : dle w w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.drop_ins_ge
statement:
theorem drop_ins_ge {k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hk : p ≤ k) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).drop (k + 2) = w.drop k

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.drop_ins_le
statement:
theorem drop_ins_le {k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hk : k ≤ p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).drop k = ins (p - k) a b (w.drop k)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.drop_rep
statement:
theorem drop_rep (j : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    (List.replicate j c ++ r).drop j = r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.dyck_decomp
statement:
theorem dyck_decomp {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) (hne : w ≠ []) :
    ∃ r, w = List.replicate (firstPair w) 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.firstPair_rep
statement:
theorem firstPair_rep (j : ℕ) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    firstPair (List.replicate j 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) = j

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_bwdList_lt
statement:
theorem fwd_bwdList_lt {w : List (Fin 2)} (hw : IsDyck w) {y : ℕ} (hy : y < w.length)
    (h1 : w.getD y 0 = 1) : fwd 0 (bwdList w y) < y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_cons_one_succ
statement: theorem fwd_cons_one_succ (d : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) : fwd (d + 1) (1 :: w) = fwd d w + 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_cons_one_zero
statement: theorem fwd_cons_one_zero (w : List (Fin 2)) : fwd 0 (1 :: w) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_cons_zero
statement: theorem fwd_cons_zero (d : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) : fwd d (0 :: w) = fwd (d + 1) w + 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_ins
statement:
theorem fwd_ins (d : ℕ) {k : ℕ} {v : List (Fin 2)} (hk : k ≤ v.length) :
    fwd d (ins k 0 1 v) = if fwd d v < k then fwd d v else fwd d v + 2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_le_length
statement: theorem fwd_le_length (d : ℕ) (v : List (Fin 2)) : fwd d v ≤ v.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fwd_lt_length
statement: theorem fwd_lt_length {d : ℕ} {v : List (Fin 2)} (h : bal v < -(d : ℤ)) : fwd d v < v.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.getD_ins_lt'
statement:
theorem getD_ins_lt' {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : q < p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD q 0 = w.getD q 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.getD_rep_add
statement:
theorem getD_rep_add (j k : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    (List.replicate j c ++ r).getD (j + k) 0 = r.getD k 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.getD_rep_lt
statement:
theorem getD_rep_lt {j i : ℕ} (h : i < j) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    (List.replicate j c ++ r).getD i 0 = c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ins_eq_append
statement:
theorem ins_eq_append {p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    ins p a b w = w.take p ++ a :: b :: w.drop p

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ins_getD_del
statement:
theorem ins_getD_del {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    ins p (w.getD p 0) (w.getD (p + 1) 0) (del p w) = w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ins_rep
statement:
theorem ins_rep (j : ℕ) (c a b : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    ins j a b (List.replicate j c ++ r) = List.replicate j c ++ a :: b :: r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isDyck_iff
statement:
theorem isDyck_iff (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    IsDyck w ↔ (∀ k ∈ Finset.range (w.length + 1), 0 ≤ bal (w.take k)) ∧ bal w = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isDyck_nil
statement: theorem isDyck_nil : IsDyck []

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.length_capT
statement:
theorem length_capT {i : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : i + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    (capT i w).length + 2 = w.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.length_eq_bal
statement: theorem length_eq_bal (w : List (Fin 2)) : (w.length : ℤ) = bal w + 2 * (w.count 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.length_set'
statement: theorem length_set' (w : List (Fin 2)) (y : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) : (w.set y c).length = w.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.map_ins
statement:
theorem map_ins (f : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    (ins p a b w).map f = ins p (f a) (f b) (w.map f)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.reverse_ins
statement:
theorem reverse_ins {p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).reverse = ins (w.length - p) b a w.reverse

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.set_ins_ge
statement:
theorem set_ins_ge {y p : ℕ} (a b c : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hy : p ≤ y) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).set (y + 2) c = ins p a b (w.set y c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.set_ins_lt
statement:
theorem set_ins_lt {y p : ℕ} (a b c : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hy : y < p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).set y c = ins p a b (w.set y c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.set_rep
statement:
theorem set_rep (j : ℕ) (c a b : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    (List.replicate j c ++ a :: r).set j b = List.replicate j c ++ b :: r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.step_le_one
statement: theorem step_le_one (a : Fin 2) : step a ≤ 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.step_one
statement: @[simp] theorem step_one : step 1 = -1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.step_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem step_zero : step 0 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.take_ins_ge
statement:
theorem take_ins_ge {k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hk : p ≤ k) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).take (k + 2) = ins p a b (w.take k)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.take_ins_le
statement:
theorem take_ins_le {k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hk : k ≤ p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).take k = w.take k

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.take_rep
statement:
theorem take_rep (j : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    (List.replicate j c ++ r).take j = List.replicate j c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.append_right
statement:
theorem PmEq.append_right {a : ℕ} {u u' : List Step} {b : ℕ} (hu : ht a u = b) (hu' : ht a u' = b)
    (h : PmEq (evW R δ a u b) (evW R δ a u' b)) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ a (u ++ v) c) (evW R δ a (u' ++ v) c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.comp_left
statement: theorem PmEq.comp_left {x y : B ⟶ D} (h : PmEq x y) (f : A ⟶ B) : PmEq (f ≫ x) (f ≫ y)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.comp_right
statement: theorem PmEq.comp_right {x y : A ⟶ B} (h : PmEq x y) (f : B ⟶ D) : PmEq (x ≫ f) (y ≫ f)

StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.evW_cons_cup

statement: theorem map {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] (f : M →+ N) (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (f x) (f y)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.neg_left
statement: theorem neg_left (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (-x) y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.neg_right
statement: theorem neg_right (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq x (-y)

statement: theorem of_eq (h : x = y) : PmEq x y
