statement: theorem of_eq_neg (h : x = -y) : PmEq x y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.refl
statement: theorem refl (x : M) : PmEq x x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.smul
statement: theorem smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module R M] (r : R) (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (r • x) (r • y)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.symm
statement: theorem symm (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq y x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.trans
statement: theorem trans (h₁ : PmEq x y) (h₂ : PmEq y z) : PmEq x z

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.zero_iff
statement: theorem zero_iff (h : PmEq x y) : x = 0 ↔ y = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Step.shift_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem Step.shift_cap (m i : ℕ) : (Step.cap i).shift m = .cap (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Step.shift_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem Step.shift_cup (m i : ℕ) : (Step.cup i).shift m = .cup (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capsW_succ'
statement: theorem capsW_succ' (m : ℕ) : capsW (m + 1) = shiftW 1 (capsW m) ++ [.cap 0]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.diag_eq_evW
statement:
theorem diag_eq_evW {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) :
    (pres R δ).diag d = evW R δ a (steps d) b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.diag_mk_eq_evW
statement:
theorem diag_mk_eq_evW (ls : List (Layer sig)) :
    ∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : Chain (strands a) ls (strands b)),
      (pres R δ).diag (Diagram.mk ls h) = evW R δ a (ls.map toStep) b ∧
        Valid a (ls.map toStep) ∧ ht a (ls.map toStep) = b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_append
statement:
theorem evW_append (a : ℕ) (u v : List Step) {b : ℕ} (hb : ht a u = b) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (u ++ v) c = evW R δ a u b ≫ evW R δ b v c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem evW_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ (a + 2) (.cap i :: u) b = cap R δ a i ≫ evW R δ a u b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_cap
statement:
theorem evW_cap_cap {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j + 2 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cap j :: .cap i :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap i :: .cap (j - 2) :: v) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_cup
statement:
theorem evW_cap_cup {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup j :: .cap i :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap i :: .cup (j - 2) :: v) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_of_lt
statement:
theorem evW_cap_of_lt {a : ℕ} (ha : a < 2) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (.cap i :: u) b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem evW_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (.cup i :: u) b = cup R δ a i ≫ evW R δ (a + 2) u b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup_cap
statement:
theorem evW_cup_cap {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W) (hi : i ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap j :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap (j - 2) :: .cup i :: v) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup_cup
statement:
theorem evW_cup_cup {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W + 2) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cup j :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cup (j - 2) :: .cup i :: v) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCap
statement:
theorem evW_farCap (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {i j W : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j)
    (hW : W = j + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW j u ++ .cap i :: v) c)
      (evW R δ W (.cap i :: (shiftW (j - 2) u ++ v)) c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCaps
statement:
theorem evW_farCaps (m : ℕ) (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {W : ℕ}
    (hW : W = m + m + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW (m + m) u ++ capsW m ++ v) c)
      (evW R δ W (capsW m ++ u ++ v) c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCup
statement:
theorem evW_farCup (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {i j W : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j)
    (hW : W + 2 = j + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (.cup i :: (shiftW j u ++ v)) c)
      (evW R δ W (shiftW (j - 2) u ++ .cup i :: v) c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCups
statement:
theorem evW_farCups (m : ℕ) (u : List Step) {W : ℕ} (hu : Valid W u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (nestW m ++ shiftW (m + m) u ++ v) c) (evW R δ W (u ++ nestW m ++ v) c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_loop
statement:
theorem evW_loop {W i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap i :: v) c = δ • evW R δ W v c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_nil_of_ne
statement: theorem evW_nil_of_ne {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≠ b) : evW R δ a [] b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_nil_self
statement: @[simp] theorem evW_nil_self (a : ℕ) : evW R δ a [] a = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_snake
statement:
theorem evW_snake (m : ℕ) {r W : ℕ} (hW : W = m + r) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW m (nestW m) ++ capsW m ++ v) c) (evW R δ W v c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_snake'
statement:
theorem evW_snake' (m : ℕ) {W : ℕ} (hW : m ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (nestW m ++ shiftW m (capsW m) ++ v) c) (evW R δ W v c)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_zigzagA
statement:
theorem evW_zigzagA {W i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup (i + 1) :: .cap i :: v) c = evW R δ W v c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_zigzagB
statement:
theorem evW_zigzagB {W i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap (i + 1) :: v) c = -evW R δ W v c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.hom_induction_evW
statement:
theorem hom_induction_evW {a b : ℕ} {p : (X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) → Prop}
    (word : ∀ u : List Step, Valid a u → ht a u = b → p (evW R δ a u b)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ f g, p f → p g → p (f + g)) (smul : ∀ (r : R) f, p f → p (r • f))
    (f : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) : p f

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_append
statement: theorem ht_append (a : ℕ) (u v : List Step) : ht a (u ++ v) = ht (ht a u) v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) : ht a (.cap i :: u) = ht (a - 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_capsW
statement: theorem ht_capsW (m A : ℕ) : ht A (capsW m) = A - (m + m)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) : ht a (.cup i :: u) = ht (a + 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_mirrorSnake
statement:
theorem ht_mirrorSnake (m : ℕ) {W : ℕ} (hW : m ≤ W) :
    ht W (nestW m ++ shiftW m (capsW m)) = W

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_nestW
statement: theorem ht_nestW (m A : ℕ) : ht A (nestW m) = A + (m + m)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_nil (a : ℕ) : ht a [] = a

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_shiftW
statement: theorem ht_shiftW (m a : ℕ) {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) : ht (m + a) (shiftW m u) = m + ht a u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_steps
statement: theorem ht_steps {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) : ht a (steps d) = b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.nestW_succ'
statement: theorem nestW_succ' (m : ℕ) : nestW (m + 1) = nestW m ++ [.cup m]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftW_append (m : ℕ) (u v : List Step) :
    shiftW m (u ++ v) = shiftW m u ++ shiftW m v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftW_cons (m : ℕ) (s : Step) (u : List Step) :
    shiftW m (s :: u) = s.shift m :: shiftW m u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftW_nil (m : ℕ) : shiftW m [] = []

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_shiftW
statement: theorem shiftW_shiftW (m n : ℕ) (u : List Step) : shiftW m (shiftW n u) = shiftW (m + n) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_zero
statement: theorem shiftW_zero (u : List Step) : shiftW 0 u = u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.strands_tensor
statement: theorem strands_tensor (m a : ℕ) : (strands m).tensor (strands a) = strands (m + a)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_append
statement:
theorem valid_append {a : ℕ} {u v : List Step} :
    Valid a (u ++ v) ↔ Valid a u ∧ Valid (ht a u) v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem valid_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    Valid a (.cap i :: u) ↔ i + 2 ≤ a ∧ Valid (a - 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_capsW
statement: theorem valid_capsW (m A : ℕ) (h : m + m ≤ A) : Valid A (capsW m)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem valid_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    Valid a (.cup i :: u) ↔ i ≤ a ∧ Valid (a + 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_nestW
statement: theorem valid_nestW (m A : ℕ) : Valid A (nestW m)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem valid_nil (a : ℕ) : Valid a []

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_shiftW
statement: theorem valid_shiftW (m a : ℕ) {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) : Valid (m + a) (shiftW m u)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_steps
statement: theorem valid_steps {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) : Valid a (steps d)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_add
statement:
theorem wLs_add (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (x + y) = wLs R δ m x + wLs R δ m y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_cap
statement:
theorem wLs_cap (m : ℕ) {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) :
    wLs R δ m (cap R δ a i) = cap R δ (m + a) (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_comp
statement:
theorem wLs_comp (m : ℕ) {a b c : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) (y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c) :
    wLs R δ m (x ≫ y) = wLs R δ m x ≫ wLs R δ m y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_cup
statement:
theorem wLs_cup (m : ℕ) {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) :
    wLs R δ m (cup R δ a i) = cup R δ (m + a) (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wLs_eqToHom (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : X R δ a = X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by
      have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
      rw [show a = b by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this])

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_evW
statement:
theorem wLs_evW (m : ℕ) {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (b : ℕ) :
    wLs R δ m (evW R δ a u b) = evW R δ (m + a) (shiftW m u) (m + b)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_neg
statement:
theorem wLs_neg (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (-x) = -wLs R δ m x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_smul
statement:
theorem wLs_smul (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (r : R) (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (r • x) = r • wLs R δ m x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_zero
statement: theorem wLs_zero (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} : wLs R δ m (0 : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_cap
statement:
theorem canon_comp_cap (n : ℕ) : ∀ (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = n + 2 →
    ∀ i ≤ n, IsDyck (capT i w) ∧
      PmEq (canon R δ (n + 2) w ≫ cap R δ n i)
        (δ ^ loopPow (loopT i w) • canon R δ n (capT i w))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_cup
statement:
theorem canon_comp_cup (n : ℕ) : ∀ (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = n →
    ∀ i ≤ n, PmEq (canon R δ n w ≫ cup R δ n i) (canon R δ (n + 2) (ins i 0 1 w))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_evW
statement:
theorem canon_comp_evW (u : List Step) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = k →
    Valid k u → IsDyck (trackW w u).1 ∧ (trackW w u).1.length = ht k u ∧
      PmEq (canon R δ k w ≫ evW R δ k u (ht k u))
        (δ ^ (trackW w u).2 • canon R δ (ht k u) (trackW w u).1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_succ_succ
statement:
theorem canon_succ_succ (n : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    canon R δ (n + 2) w = canon R δ n (del (firstPair w) w) ≫ cup R δ n (firstPair w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_zero
statement: theorem canon_zero (w : List (Fin 2)) : canon R δ 0 w = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.firstPair_ins_ge
statement:
theorem firstPair_ins_ge {p i : ℕ} (r : List (Fin 2)) (hi : p + 2 ≤ i)
    (hr : i ≤ p + 2 + r.length) :
    firstPair (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) = p ∧
      del p (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) =
        ins (i - 2) 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ r)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.firstPair_ins_le
statement:
theorem firstPair_ins_le {p i : ℕ} (r : List (Fin 2)) (hi : i ≤ p + 1) :
    firstPair (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) = i ∧
      del i (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) =
        List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ins_rep_add
statement:
theorem ins_rep_add (p k : ℕ) (a b c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    ins (p + k) a b (List.replicate p c ++ r) = List.replicate p c ++ ins k a b r

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.rep_add
statement:
theorem rep_add (i j : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    List.replicate (i + j) c ++ r = List.replicate i c ++ (List.replicate j c ++ r)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.span_canon
statement:
theorem span_canon (N : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range fun w : DyckSeq N => canon R δ N w.1) = ⊤

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_append
statement:
theorem trackW_append (w : List (Fin 2)) (u v : List Step) :
    trackW w (u ++ v) = ((trackW (trackW w u).1 v).1, (trackW (trackW w u).1 v).2 + (trackW w u).2)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem trackW_cap (w : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    trackW w (.cap i :: u) =
      ((trackW (capT i w) u).1, (trackW (capT i w) u).2 + loopPow (loopT i w))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem trackW_cup (w : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    trackW w (.cup i :: u) = trackW (ins i 0 1 w) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem trackW_nil (w : List (Fin 2)) : trackW w [] = (w, 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_genFun_mul
statement:
theorem qbracket_genFun_mul :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n => qbracket x π (n + 1)) *
      (1 - PowerSeries.C (qbracket x π 2) * PowerSeries.X +
        PowerSeries.C π * PowerSeries.X ^ 2) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_genFun_mul'
statement:
theorem qbracket_genFun_mul' :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n => qbracket x π n) *
      (1 - PowerSeries.C (qbracket x π 2) * PowerSeries.X +
        PowerSeries.C π * PowerSeries.X ^ 2) = PowerSeries.X

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_mul
statement:
theorem qbracket_mul (m n : ℕ) :
    qbracket x π (n + 1) * qbracket x π (m + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (min m n + 1), π ^ r * qbracket x π (n + m - 2 * r + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qbracket_mul_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (xz x 1 - π * xz x (-1)) * qbracket x π n = xz x n - π ^ n * xz x (-(n : ℤ))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem qbracket_mul_of_le (m n : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) :
    qbracket x π (n + 1) * qbracket x π (m + 1) =
      ∑ r ∈ range (m + 1), π ^ r * qbracket x π (n + m - 2 * r + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_one
statement: @[simp] theorem qbracket_one : qbracket x π 1 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_succ_eq
statement:
theorem qbracket_succ_eq (n : ℕ) :
    qbracket x π (n + 1) = ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1), π ^ r * xz x ((n : ℤ) - 2 * r)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_succ_mul_two
statement:
theorem qbracket_succ_mul_two (n : ℕ) :
    qbracket x π (n + 1) * qbracket x π 2 = qbracket x π (n + 2) + π * qbracket x π n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_two
statement: theorem qbracket_two : qbracket x π 2 = xz x 1 + π * xz x (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qbracket_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qbracket_zero : qbracket x π 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qint_mul_eq
statement:
theorem qint_mul_eq (q : Aˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((q : A) + ((q⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)) * qint q n = xz q n - (-1) ^ n * xz q (-(n : ℤ))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qint_mul_two
statement:
theorem qint_mul_two (q : Aˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    qint q (n + 1) * qint q 2 = qint q (n + 2) - qint q n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qint_ne_zero
statement:
theorem qint_ne_zero {q : Aˣ} (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    qint q n ≠ 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.qint_two
statement: theorem qint_two (q : Aˣ) : qint q 2 = (q : A) - ((q⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.xz_congr
statement: theorem xz_congr (x : Aˣ) {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) : xz x a = xz x b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.xz_mul_xz
statement: theorem xz_mul_xz (x : Aˣ) (a b : ℤ) : xz x a * xz x b = xz x (a + b)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_00
statement: @[simp] theorem capCoeff_00 : capCoeff R q 0 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_01
statement: @[simp] theorem capCoeff_01 : capCoeff R q 0 1 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_10
statement: @[simp] theorem capCoeff_10 : capCoeff R q 1 0 = ((q⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_11
statement: @[simp] theorem capCoeff_11 : capCoeff R q 1 1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_sign
statement:
theorem capCoeff_sign (a b : Fin 2) : (-1 : R) ^ (a.val + b.val) * capCoeff R q a b =
    -capCoeff R q a b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capOp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem capOp_apply (p : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    capOp R q p F w = psign R p w * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, capCoeff R q a b * F (ins p a b w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cap_cap_op
statement:
theorem cap_cap_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R q (p + k) (capOp R q p F) w = -capOp R q p (capOp R q (p + 2 + k) F) w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cap_cup_op
statement:
theorem cap_cup_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    cupOp R q (p + k) (capOp R q p F) w = -capOp R q p (cupOp R q (p + 2 + k) F) w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_00
statement: @[simp] theorem cupCoeff_00 : cupCoeff R q 0 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_01
statement: @[simp] theorem cupCoeff_01 : cupCoeff R q 0 1 = -(q : R)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_10
statement: @[simp] theorem cupCoeff_10 : cupCoeff R q 1 0 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_11
statement: @[simp] theorem cupCoeff_11 : cupCoeff R q 1 1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_sign
statement:
theorem cupCoeff_sign (a b : Fin 2) : (-1 : R) ^ (a.val + b.val) * cupCoeff R q a b =
    -cupCoeff R q a b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupOp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cupOp_apply (p : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    cupOp R q p F w = psign R p w * (cupCoeff R q (w.getD p 0) (w.getD (p + 1) 0) * F (del p w))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cup_cap_op
statement:
theorem cup_cap_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 + k ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R q (p + 2 + k) (cupOp R q p F) w = -cupOp R q p (capOp R q (p + k) F) w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cup_cup_op
statement:
theorem cup_cup_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 4 ≤ w.length) :
    cupOp R q (p + 2 + k) (cupOp R q p F) w = -cupOp R q p (cupOp R q (p + k) F) w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_ext
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_ext (n : ℕ) : (loc R q).ext n = ext R n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_op
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_op (L : Layer sig) : (loc R q).op L = op R q L

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_res
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_res (n : ℕ) : (loc R q).res n = res R n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_κ
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_κ (a : Obj sig) : (loc R q).κ a = a.word.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.loop_op
statement:
theorem loop_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R q p (cupOp R q p F) w = -((q : R) - ((q⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) * F w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.nOdd_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem nOdd_cons (a : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) : nOdd (a :: w) = a.val + nOdd w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.nOdd_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem nOdd_nil : nOdd [] = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.op_agree
statement:
theorem op_agree (L : Layer sig) {F F' : Fn R} (h : Agree L.dom.word.length F F') :
    Agree L.cod.word.length (op R q L F) (op R q L F')

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem op_cap (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) :
    op R q ⟨s, l, .cap, r⟩ = capOp R q l.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem op_cup (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) :
    op R q ⟨s, l, .cup, r⟩ = cupOp R q l.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_del_ge
statement:
theorem psign_del_ge {p q : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ w.length) :
    psign R q w =
      psign R (q - 2) (del p w) * (-1) ^ ((w.getD p 0).val + (w.getD (p + 1) 0).val)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_del_le
statement:
theorem psign_del_le {p q : ℕ} (w : List (Fin 2)) (h : p ≤ q) :
    psign R p (del q w) = psign R p w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_ins_ge
statement:
theorem psign_ins_ge {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : q ≤ p)
    (hq : q ≤ w.length) :
    psign R (p + 2) (ins q a b w) = psign R p w * (-1) ^ (a.val + b.val)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_ins_le
statement:
theorem psign_ins_le {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ≤ w.length) : psign R p (ins q a b w) = psign R p w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_mul_self
statement: theorem psign_mul_self (p : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) : psign R p w * psign R p w = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_succ
statement:
theorem psign_succ {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    psign R (p + 1) w = psign R p w * (-1) ^ (w.getD p 0).val

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagA_op
statement:
theorem zigzagA_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R q p (cupOp R q (p + 1) F) w = F w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagB_op
statement:
theorem zigzagB_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R q (p + 1) (cupOp R q p F) w = -F w

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.comp_cup_right
statement:
theorem comp_cup_right {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    x ≫ cup R δ b b = cup R δ a a ≫ wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.comp_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem comp_mem_evenSpan {a b c : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} {y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c}
    (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) (hy : y ∈ evenSpan R δ b c) : x ≫ y ∈ evenSpan R δ a c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem evW_mem_evenSpan {a b : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (hb : ht a u = b)
    (he : Even u.length) : evW R δ a u b ∈ evenSpan R δ a b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_slideCap
statement:
theorem evW_slideCap (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ (A + 2) (u ++ .cap (ht A u) :: v) c =
      ((-1 : R) ^ u.length) • evW R δ (A + 2) (.cap A :: (u ++ v)) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_slideCup
statement:
theorem evW_slideCup (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ A (u ++ .cup (ht A u) :: v) c =
      ((-1 : R) ^ u.length) • evW R δ A (.cup A :: (u ++ v)) c

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evenSpan_induction
statement:
theorem evenSpan_induction {a b : ℕ} {p : (X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) → Prop}
    (word : ∀ u, Valid a u → ht a u = b → Even u.length → p (evW R δ a u b)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (r : R) x, p x → p (r • x))
    {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) : p x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_add
statement: theorem ht_add {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (k : ℕ) : ht (a + k) u = ht a u + k

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.id_mem_evenSpan
statement: theorem id_mem_evenSpan (a : ℕ) : 𝟙 (X R δ a) ∈ evenSpan R δ a a

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.strands_tensor_one
statement: theorem strands_tensor_one (a : ℕ) : (strands a).tensor (strands 1) = strands (a + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_add
statement: theorem valid_add {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (k : ℕ) : Valid (a + k) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_add
statement:
theorem wR1_add {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (x + y) = wR1 R δ x + wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_cap
statement: theorem wR1_cap {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) : wR1 R δ (cap R δ a i) = cap R δ (a + 1) i

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_comp
statement:
theorem wR1_comp {a b c : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) (y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c) :
    wR1 R δ (x ≫ y) = wR1 R δ x ≫ wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_cup
statement: theorem wR1_cup {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) : wR1 R δ (cup R δ a i) = cup R δ (a + 1) i

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wR1_eqToHom {a b : ℕ} (h : X R δ a = X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by
      have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
      rw [show a = b by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this])

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_evW
statement:
theorem wR1_evW {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (b : ℕ) :
    wR1 R δ (evW R δ a u b) = evW R δ (a + 1) u (b + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_id
statement: theorem wR1_id (a : ℕ) : wR1 R δ (𝟙 (X R δ a)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem wR1_mem_evenSpan {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    wR1 R δ x ∈ evenSpan R δ (a + 1) (b + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_neg
statement: theorem wR1_neg {a b : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) : wR1 R δ (-x) = -wR1 R δ x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_smul
statement:
theorem wR1_smul {a b : ℕ} (r : R) (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (r • x) = r • wR1 R δ x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_sub
statement:
theorem wR1_sub {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (x - y) = wR1 R δ x - wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_zero
statement: theorem wR1_zero {a b : ℕ} : wR1 R δ (0 : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR2_comp_cap_right
statement:
theorem wR2_comp_cap_right {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x) ≫ cap R δ b b = cap R δ a a ≫ x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bsum_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem bsum_cons (X : 𝒞) (l : List 𝒞) : bsum (X :: l) = (X ⊞ bsum l)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.bsum_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem bsum_nil : bsum ([] : List 𝒞) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fromBsum_comp_toBsum
statement:
theorem fromBsum_comp_toBsum {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A)) (h : Orthogonal l) :
    fromBsum l ≫ toBsum l = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.iso_bsum_of_retract
statement:
theorem iso_bsum_of_retract (L : List 𝒞) (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, IsSchur (k := k) P) :
    ∀ (Z : 𝒞) (σ : Z ⟶ bsum L) (τ : bsum L ⟶ Z), σ ≫ τ = 𝟙 Z →
      ∃ L' : List 𝒞, L'.Sublist L ∧ Nonempty (Z ≅ bsum L')

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id
statement:
theorem retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A))
    (h : (l.map fun p => p.a ≫ p.b).sum = 𝟙 A) : toBsum l ≫ fromBsum l = 𝟙 A

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.toBsum_comp_fromBsum
statement:
theorem toBsum_comp_fromBsum {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A)) :
    toBsum l ≫ fromBsum l = (l.map fun p => p.a ≫ p.b).sum

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.ext_proj
statement: theorem ext_proj {X Y : C} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : ∀ p, proj R p f = proj R p g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {X Y : C} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (f : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (p : ZMod 2) (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p → P g)
    (add : ∀ g h, P g → P h → P (g + h)) : P f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.inv_mem
statement:
theorem inv_mem {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p) :
    e.inv ∈ parity (R := R) Y X p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_smul
statement:
theorem koszulSign_smul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p q : ZMod 2) (x : M) :
    koszulSign p q • x = sign R (p * q) • x

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.mem_iff_proj
statement:
theorem mem_iff_proj {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ proj R p f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_add_proj
statement: theorem proj_add_proj {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R 0 f + proj R 1 f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_add_proj_add_one
statement:
theorem proj_add_proj_add_one (s : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R s f + proj R (s + 1) f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_apply
statement:
theorem proj_apply (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    letI

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_comp_of_mem_left
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_comp_of_mem_right
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_eq_of_add
statement:
theorem proj_eq_of_add {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f g h : X ⟶ Y} (e : f = g + h)
    (hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p) (hh : h ∈ parity (R := R) X Y (p + 1)) : proj R p f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_id
statement: theorem proj_id (X : C) (p : ZMod 2) : proj R p (𝟙 X) = if p = 0 then 𝟙 X else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_mem
statement: theorem proj_mem (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R p f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_of_mem
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p) :
    proj R p f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem_ne {p q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q)
    (h : q ≠ p) : proj R p f = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_proj
statement: theorem proj_proj (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R p (proj R p f) = proj R p f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_proj_of_ne
statement:
theorem proj_proj_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : q ≠ p) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R p (proj R q f) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_twist
statement:
theorem proj_twist (p q : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R q (twist R p f) = sign R (p * q) • proj R q f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_add
statement: theorem sign_add (p q : ZMod 2) : sign R (p + q) = sign R p * sign R q

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_mul
statement: theorem sign_mul (p q : ZMod 2) : sign R (p * q) = (koszulSign p q : R)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_mul_self
statement: theorem sign_mul_self (p : ZMod 2) : sign R p * sign R p = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_one
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_one : sign R 1 = -1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_smul_sign_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem sign_smul_sign_smul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (p : ZMod 2)
    (x : M) : sign R p • sign R p • x = x

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.sign_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sign_zero : sign R 0 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_add
statement:
theorem twist_add (p q : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    twist R (p + q) f = twist R p (twist R q f)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_apply
statement:
theorem twist_apply (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    twist R p f = proj R 0 f + sign R p • proj R 1 f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_comp
statement:
theorem twist_comp (p : ZMod 2) {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    twist R p (f ≫ g) = twist R p f ≫ twist R p g

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_id
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_id (p : ZMod 2) (X : C) : twist R p (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 X

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_mem
statement:
theorem twist_mem (p : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) : twist R p f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_of_mem (p : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) : twist R p f = sign R (p * q) • f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_one_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_one_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    twist R 1 f = sign R q • f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_twist
statement: theorem twist_twist (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist R p (twist R p f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_zero {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist R 0 f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.zmod2_add_one_ne
statement: theorem zmod2_add_one_ne (p : ZMod 2) : p + 1 ≠ p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.zmod2_add_self
statement: theorem zmod2_add_self (p : ZMod 2) : p + p = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.EvenlyDense.iso_mem
statement:
theorem EvenlyDense.iso_mem (Y : D) :
    (hF.iso F Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj (hF.obj F Y)) Y 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.evenlyDense
statement:
theorem Superequivalence.evenlyDense {F : C ⥤ D} (e : Superequivalence R F) :
    EvenlyDense R F

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.map_mem
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.map_proj
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.map_twist
statement:
theorem map_twist (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (p : ZMod 2)
    {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (twist R p f) = twist R p (F.map f)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.mem_of_map_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_map_mem (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] [F.Faithful]
    {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : F.map f ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) p) :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ofIsoFunctor_preservesParity
statement:
theorem ofIsoFunctor_preservesParity (he : ∀ X, (e X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (obj X) X 1) :
    IsSuperfunctor R (ofIsoFunctor (R := R) obj e)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.pi_map_eq
statement:
theorem pi_map_eq {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pi (R := R)).map f = (ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ twist R 1 f ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.pi_map_ζ
statement:
theorem pi_map_ζ (X : C) :
    (pi (R := R)).map (ζ (R := R) X).hom = -(ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.βIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem βIso_hom_app [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (βIso (R := R) F).hom.app X = (β R F X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_comm
statement:
theorem β_comm [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ξ (R := R) X).inv =
      (pi (R := R)).map (β R F X).hom ≫ (β R F ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_comp
statement:
theorem β_comp (G : D ⥤ E) (X : C) :
    (β R (F ⋙ G) X).hom = (β R G (F.obj X)).hom ≫ G.map (β R F X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (β R F X).hom = (ζ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ζ (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom_eq_neg
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq_neg [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (β R F X).hom = -((pi (R := R)).map (F.map (ζ (R := R) X).inv) ≫
      (ζ (R := R) (F.obj ((pi (R := R)).obj X))).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_interchange
statement:
theorem linEndW_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (i : ι) :
    linEndW A i u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) =
      A ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.cod x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ i *
          A ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)⟩ i -
        ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (A ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.cod x.h ++ v)⟩ i *
            A ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ i)

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_interchange_eq_zero
statement:
theorem linEndW_interchange_eq_zero {κ : Obj S → ι}
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      let i := κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩
      A ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ i * A ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ i =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (A ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ i * A ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩ i))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    linEndW A (κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at
statement:
theorem interchange_at (g h : S.Gen) (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    ((if S.odd g && S.odd h then -1 else 1 : ℤ) : R) •
      (P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
          (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
        P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
          (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃))

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at_of_even
statement:
theorem interchange_at_of_even (g h : S.Gen) (hgh : S.odd g = false ∨ S.odd h = false)
    (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
      P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃)

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at_of_odd
statement:
theorem interchange_at_of_odd (g h : S.Gen) (hg : S.odd g = true) (hh : S.odd h = true)
    (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    -(P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
      P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃))

theorem braiding_naturality {X X' Y Y' : C} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ X'} {g : Y ⟶ Y'}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X X' p) (hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) Y Y' q) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom f g ≫ (braiding (R := R) X' Y').hom =

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.app_injective

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_app
statement:
theorem comp_app (x : F ⟶ G) (y : G ⟶ H) (r : ZMod 2) (X : C) :
    (x ≫ y).app r X = x.app 0 X ≫ y.app r X + x.app 1 X ≫ y.app (r + 1) X

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_app_one
statement:

statement:

    (x ≫ y).app 0 X = x.app 0 X ≫ y.app 0 X + x.app 1 X ≫ y.app 1 X

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {C' : Type*} [Category C'] [Preadditive C'] [Linear R C'] [Supercategory R C']
    (F : Superfunctor R C D) (G : Superfunctor R D E) (H : Superfunctor R E C') :
    (F.comp G).comp H = F.comp (G.comp H)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_id
statement: theorem comp_id (F : Superfunctor R C D) : F.comp (id R D) = F

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_total
statement:
theorem comp_total (x : F ⟶ G) (y : G ⟶ H) (X : C) :

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.comp_whiskerRight
statement:

    whiskerRight (x ≫ z) G = whiskerRight x G ≫ whiskerRight z G

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.component_add_component
statement: theorem component_add_component (x : F ⟶ G) : component 0 x + component 1 x = x

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.component_app
statement:
theorem component_app (p : ZMod 2) (x : F ⟶ G) (q : ZMod 2) (X : C) :
    (component p x).app q X = if q = p then x.app p X else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.component_mem
statement: theorem component_mem (p : ZMod 2) (x : F ⟶ G) : component p x ∈ parityHom F G p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.hcomp_comp_hcomp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp_hcomp {L : Superfunctor R C D} {L' : Superfunctor R D E} {pu py : ZMod 2}
    (x : F ⟶ H) (u : H ⟶ L) (y : G' ⟶ K') (v : K' ⟶ L')
    (hu : u ∈ parity (R := R) H L pu) (hy : y ∈ parity (R := R) G' K' py) :
    hcomp x y ≫ hcomp u v = koszulSign pu py • hcomp (x ≫ u) (y ≫ v)

@[simp] theorem comp_val {X Y Z : Underlying R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = f.1 ≫ g.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {X Y : Underlying R C} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (X : Underlying R C) : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).1 = 𝟙 X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.map_map_val
StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    η ▷ (g ≫ h) ≫ (associator f' g h).inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ η ▷ g ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_middle
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_middle (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ g')
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    f ◁ (η ▷ h) ≫ (associator f g' h).inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ (f ◁ η) ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d}
    (η : h ⟶ h') :
    f ◁ g ◁ η ≫ (associator f g h').inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ (f ≫ g) ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    η ▷ g ▷ h ≫ (associator f' g h).hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ η ▷ (g ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_middle (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (f ◁ η) ▷ h ≫ (associator f g' h).hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ f ◁ (η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    (f ≫ g) ◁ η ≫ (associator f g h').hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ f ◁ g ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_whiskerRight' {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) (i : b ⟶ c) :
    (η ≫ θ) ▷ i = η ▷ i ≫ θ ▷ i

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.hom_inv_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem hom_inv_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.hom ▷ h ≫ e.inv ▷ h = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem inv_hom_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.inv ▷ h ≫ e.hom ▷ h = 𝟙 (g ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom = (associator (𝟙 a) f g).inv ≫ (leftUnitor f).hom ▷ g

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_comp_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_comp_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).inv = (leftUnitor f).inv ▷ g ≫ (associator (𝟙 a) f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_inv_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ≫ (leftUnitor g).inv = (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    𝟙 a ◁ η ≫ (leftUnitor g).hom = (leftUnitor f).hom ≫ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_whiskerRight (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor f).hom ▷ g = (associator (𝟙 a) f g).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.neg_whiskerRight
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) : (-η) ▷ h = -(η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.pentagon_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pentagon_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) (i : d ⟶ e) :
    f ◁ (associator g h i).inv ≫ (associator f (g ≫ h) i).inv ≫ (associator f g h).inv ▷ i =
      (associator f g (h ≫ i)).inv ≫ (associator (f ≫ g) h i).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom = (associator f g (𝟙 c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (rightUnitor g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_comp_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_comp_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).inv = f ◁ (rightUnitor g).inv ≫ (associator f g (𝟙 c)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_inv_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ≫ (rightUnitor g).inv = (rightUnitor f).inv ≫ η ▷ 𝟙 b

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (rightUnitor g).hom = (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.super_interchange_assoc
StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.unitors_equal
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitors_equal (a : B) : (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom = (rightUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.unitors_inv_equal
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitors_inv_equal (a : B) : (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).inv = (rightUnitor (𝟙 a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_comp' (f : a ⟶ b) {g h i : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    f ◁ (η ≫ θ) = f ◁ η ≫ f ◁ θ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_hom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem whiskerLeft_hom_inv (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.hom ≫ f ◁ e.inv = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem whiskerLeft_inv_hom (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.inv ≫ f ◁ e.hom = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_neg (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) : f ◁ (-η) = -(f ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_rightUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_rightUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    f ◁ (rightUnitor g).hom = (associator f g (𝟙 c)).inv ≫ (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_zero (f : a ⟶ b) (g h : b ⟶ c) : f ◁ (0 : g ⟶ h) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zsmul
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_zsmul (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (n : ℤ) (η : g ⟶ h) :
    f ◁ (n • η) = n • (f ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whisker_exchange_of_even_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whisker_exchange_of_even_left {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} {η : f ⟶ g}
    (hη : η ∈ parity (R := R) f g 0) (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whisker_exchange_of_even_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whisker_exchange_of_even_right {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ g) {θ : h ⟶ i}
    (hθ : θ ∈ parity (R := R) h i 0) :
    η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_whiskerRight (f g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) : (0 : f ⟶ g) ▷ h = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.zsmul_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem zsmul_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (n : ℤ) (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (n • η) ▷ h = n • (η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.associator_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (Bicategory.associator f g h).hom.1 = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.associator_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (Bicategory.associator f g h).inv.1 = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).obj = f.obj ≫ g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.comp₂_val
statement: @[simp] theorem comp₂_val {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) : (η ≫ θ).1 = η.1 ≫ θ.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.hom1_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem hom1_obj {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (hom1 (R := R) f).obj = f

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem id_obj (a : Underlying2 R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).obj = 𝟙 a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.id₂_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id₂_val (f : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 f : f ⟶ f).1 = 𝟙 f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.leftUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).hom.1 = (leftUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.leftUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).inv.1 = (leftUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.rightUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor f).hom.1 = (rightUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.rightUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor f).inv.1 = (rightUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (Bicategory.whiskerLeft f η).1 = f.obj ◁ η.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (Bicategory.whiskerRight η h).1 = η.1 ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.pi_whisker_ζ
statement:
theorem pi_whisker_ζ (a : B) :
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom =
      -(pi (R := R) a ◁ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_comp
statement:
theorem β_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (β (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom =
      (associator f g (pi (R := R) c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (β (R := R) g).hom ≫
        (associator f (pi (R := R) b) g).inv ≫ (β (R := R) f).hom ▷ g ≫
          (associator (pi (R := R) a) f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (β (R := R) f).hom =
    f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv ≫
      (ζ (R := R) a).inv ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_comp_ζ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem β_hom_comp_ζ (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f =
      f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_eq_neg_hcomp
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq_neg_hcomp (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom = -((leftUnitor (f ≫ pi (R := R) b)).inv ≫
      hcomp (ζ (R := R) a).inv (f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom) ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ (rightUnitor f).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement:
theorem β_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) a ≫ f) 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_id
statement:
theorem β_id (a : B) :
    (β (R := R) (𝟙 a)).hom = (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_inv
statement:
theorem β_inv (f : a ⟶ b) : (β (R := R) f).inv =
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f ≫ (leftUnitor f).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).inv ≫
      f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_naturality
statement:
theorem β_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ x = x ▷ pi (R := R) b ≫ (β (R := R) g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_pi
statement: theorem β_pi (a : B) : (β (R := R) (pi (R := R) a)).hom = -𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem
statement: theorem ζ_inv_mem (a : B) : (ζ (R := R) a).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a) (pi (R := R) a) 1

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_comm
statement:
theorem ξ_comm (f : a ⟶ b) :
    f ◁ (ξ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (ξ (R := R) a).inv ▷ f =
      (associator f (pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) b)).inv ≫ (β (R := R) f).hom ▷ pi (R := R) b ≫
        (associator (pi (R := R) a) f (pi (R := R) b)).hom ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ (β (R := R) f).hom ≫
          (associator (pi (R := R) a) (pi (R := R) a) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).hom =
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq_hcomp
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq_hcomp (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).hom =
    hcomp (ζ (R := R) a).hom (ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_mem (a : B) :
    (ξ (R := R) a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (pi (R := R) a ≫ pi (R := R) a) (𝟙 a) 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_inv
statement:
theorem ξ_inv (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).inv =
    (ζ (R := R) a).inv ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).inv ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).inv ▷ pi (R := R) a

name: StringDiagrams.SCat.isSuperequivalence_iff
statement:
theorem isSuperequivalence_iff {C D : SCat.{w, v₁, u₁} R} (F : C ⟶ D) :
    TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence R F ↔ Nonempty (Superequivalence R F.toFunctor)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.add_app
statement: @[simp] theorem add_app (α β : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (α + β).app a = α.app a + β.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.app_injective
statement: theorem app_injective : Function.Injective (fun (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) => α.app a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_app (α : θ ⟶ θ') (β : θ' ⟶ θ'') (a : B) :
    (α ≫ β).app a = α.app a ≫ β.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {α β : θ ⟶ θ'} (h : ∀ a, α.app a = β.app a) : α = β

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem id_app (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : B) :
    (𝟙 θ : θ ⟶ θ).app a = 𝟙 (θ.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.mem_parityHom
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom {p : ZMod 2} {α : θ ⟶ θ'} :
    α ∈ parityHom θ θ' p ↔ ∀ a, α.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {p : ZMod 2} {α : θ ⟶ θ'} :
    α ∈ parity (R := R) θ θ' p ↔ ∀ a, α.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.neg_app
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_app (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (-α).app a = -α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.nsmul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem nsmul_app (n : ℕ) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (n • α).app a = n • α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.projHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem projHom_app (p : ZMod 2) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) :
    (projHom p α).app a = proj R p (α.app a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.smul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_app (r : R) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (r • α).app a = r • α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.sub_app
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_app (α β : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (α - β).app a = α.app a - β.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.zero_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_app (a : B) : (0 : θ ⟶ θ').app a = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.zsmul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zsmul_app (n : ℤ) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (n • α).app a = n • α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.mapComp_naturality
statement:
theorem mapComp_naturality {a b c : B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ f')
    (θ : g ⟶ g') :
    hcomp (F.map₂ η) (F.map₂ θ) ≫ (F.mapComp f' g').hom =
      (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (hcomp η θ)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem map₂_neg {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : F.map₂ (-η) = -F.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem map₂_zero {a b : B} (f g : a ⟶ b) : F.map₂ (0 : f ⟶ g) = 0

name: CategoryTheory.Iso.inv_heq_of_hom_heq
statement:
theorem _root_.CategoryTheory.Iso.inv_heq_of_hom_heq {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {X Y X' Y' : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (e' : X' ≅ Y') (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y')
    (h : HEq e.hom e'.hom) : HEq e.inv e'.inv

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.eqToHom_mem
statement: theorem eqToHom_mem {X Y : C} (h : X = Y) : eqToHom h ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.eqToHom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem eqToHom_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f = g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    eqToHom e ▷ h = eqToHom (congrArg (· ≫ h) e)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_eqToHom {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g = h) :
    f ◁ eqToHom e = eqToHom (congrArg (f ≫ ·) e)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.isStrict
statement: theorem isStrict : F.toTwoSuperfunctor.IsStrict

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map_comp_comp_left
statement:
theorem map_comp_comp_left {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    F.map ((f ≫ g) ≫ h) = (F.map f ≫ F.map g) ≫ F.map h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map_comp_comp_right
statement:
theorem map_comp_comp_right {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    F.map (f ≫ g ≫ h) = F.map f ≫ F.map g ≫ F.map h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map_comp_id
statement: theorem map_comp_id {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : F.map (f ≫ 𝟙 b) = F.map f ≫ 𝟙 (F.obj b)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map_id_comp
statement: theorem map_id_comp {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : F.map (𝟙 a ≫ f) = 𝟙 (F.obj a) ≫ F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map₂_associator_inv_eq
statement:
theorem map₂_associator_inv_eq {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    F.map₂ (associator f g h).inv = eqToHom (F.map_comp_comp_right f g h) ≫
      (associator (F.map f) (F.map g) (F.map h)).inv ≫
        eqToHom (F.map_comp_comp_left f g h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map₂_leftUnitor_eq
statement:
theorem map₂_leftUnitor_eq {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.map₂ (leftUnitor f).hom = eqToHom (F.map_id_comp f) ≫ (leftUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫
      eqToHom rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map₂_rightUnitor_eq
statement:
theorem map₂_rightUnitor_eq {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.map₂ (rightUnitor f).hom = eqToHom (F.map_comp_id f) ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫
      eqToHom rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map₂_whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem map₂_whiskerLeft_eq {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    F.map₂ (f ◁ η) = eqToHom (F.map_comp f g) ≫ F.map f ◁ F.map₂ η ≫
      eqToHom (F.map_comp f h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.map₂_whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem map₂_whiskerRight_eq {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    F.map₂ (η ▷ h) = eqToHom (F.map_comp f h) ≫ F.map₂ η ▷ F.map h ≫
      eqToHom (F.map_comp g h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.toTwoSuperfunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem toTwoSuperfunctor_map {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.toTwoSuperfunctor.map f = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.toTwoSuperfunctor_mapComp
statement:
theorem toTwoSuperfunctor_mapComp {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    F.toTwoSuperfunctor.mapComp f g = eqToIso (F.map_comp f g).symm

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.toTwoSuperfunctor_mapId
statement:
theorem toTwoSuperfunctor_mapId (a : B) :
    F.toTwoSuperfunctor.mapId a = eqToIso (F.map_id a).symm

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.toTwoSuperfunctor_map₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem toTwoSuperfunctor_map₂ {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    F.toTwoSuperfunctor.map₂ η = F.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.StrictCore.toTwoSuperfunctor_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem toTwoSuperfunctor_obj (a : B) : F.toTwoSuperfunctor.obj a = F.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.associator_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (associator X Y Z).hom.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)
        (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.associator_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (associator X Y Z).inv.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)
        (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.comp_app
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_app (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (a : B) : (f ≫ g).app a = f.app a ≫ g.app a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.eqToHom_app
statement:
theorem eqToHom_app {P Q : DrinfeldCenter R B} (h : P = Q) (a : B) :
    (eqToHom h : P ⟶ Q).app a = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.ext_of_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_eq {P Q : DrinfeldCenter R B} (hX : P.toTwoNatTrans.X = Q.toTwoNatTrans.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), P.toTwoNatTrans.x f =
      eqToHom (by rw [hX]) ≫ Q.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hX])) :
    P = Q

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : ∀ a, f.app a = g.app a) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.id_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem id_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).app a = 𝟙 (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.leftUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (leftUnitor X).hom.app a = (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.leftUnitor_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (leftUnitor X).inv.app a = (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.massociator_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem massociator_hom_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (α_ X Y Z).hom.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.massociator_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem massociator_inv_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (α_ X Y Z).inv.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔
      ∀ a, f.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mleftUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mleftUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (λ_ X).hom.app a = (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mrightUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mrightUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (ρ_ X).hom.app a = (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mwhiskerLeft_app
StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mwhiskerRight_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mwhiskerRight_app {X X' : DrinfeldCenter R B} (α : X ⟶ X')
    (Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.rightUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.rightUnitor_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (rightUnitor X).inv.app a = (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorHom_app {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : DrinfeldCenter R B} (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂)
    (a : B) : (f ⊗ₘ g).app a =
      X₂.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ f.app a ≫ g.app a ▷ Y₁.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorObj_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_X (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (tensorObj X Y).toTwoNatTrans.X a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ≫ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorObj_x
statement:
theorem tensorObj_x (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (tensorObj X Y).toTwoNatTrans.x f =
      (associator f (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).inv ≫
        Y.toTwoNatTrans.x f ▷ X.toTwoNatTrans.X b ≫
          (associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).hom ≫
            Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ X.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫
              (associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorUnit_X
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_X (a : B) : (tensorUnit R B).toTwoNatTrans.X a = 𝟙 a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorUnit_x
statement:
theorem tensorUnit_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (tensorUnit R B).toTwoNatTrans.x f = (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensor_X (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (X ⊗ Y).toTwoNatTrans.X a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ≫ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_assoc
statement:
theorem tensor_assoc (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) :
    tensorObj (tensorObj X Y) Z = tensorObj X (tensorObj Y Z)

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_unit
statement: theorem tensor_unit (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) : tensorObj X (tensorUnit R B) = X

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.unit_X
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_X (a : B) : (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)).toTwoNatTrans.X a = 𝟙 a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.unit_tensor
statement: theorem unit_tensor (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) : tensorObj (tensorUnit R B) X = X

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.whiskerLeft_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) {Y Y' : DrinfeldCenter R B}
    (β : Y ⟶ Y') (a : B) : (whiskerLeft X β).app a = β.app a ▷ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerObj_X

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerObj_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem centerObj_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (centerObj R B).toTwoNatTrans.x f = (β (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerζ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem centerζ_hom_mem :

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerξ_hom_eq

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerξ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem centerξ_hom_mem :
    (centerξ R B).hom ∈
      parity (R := R) (centerObj R B ⊗ centerObj R B) (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofOplax_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofOplax_X (η : idU R B ⟶ idU R B) (nat) (a : B) :
    (ofOplax η nat).X a = (η.app ⟨a⟩).obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofOplax_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofOplax_x (η : idU R B ⟶ idU R B) (nat) {a b : B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : (ofOplax η nat).x f = (η.naturality (Underlying2.hom1 f)).1

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplax_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplax_app (θ : EndId R B) (a : Underlying2 R B) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplax_naturality
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplax_naturality (θ : EndId R B) {a b : Underlying2 R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.braidingApp_naturality
statement:
theorem braidingApp_naturality {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (X ⊗ Y).toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫ braidingApp X Y a ▷ (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).map f =
      (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).map f ◁ braidingApp X Y b ≫ (Y ⊗ X).toTwoNatTrans.x f

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.braiding_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem braiding_hom_app (a : B) :
    (braiding X Y).hom.app a = X.toTwoNatTrans.x (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.EndId.x_comp'
statement:
theorem EndId.x_comp' (θ : EndId R B) {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    θ.x (f ≫ g) = (BicategoryStruct.associator f g (θ.X c)).hom ≫ f ◁ θ.x g ≫
      (BicategoryStruct.associator f (θ.X b) g).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ g ≫ (BicategoryStruct.associator (θ.X a) f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.add_whiskerRight'
statement:
theorem add_whiskerRight' {X X' : Envelope R C} (f g : X ⟶ X') (Y : Envelope R C) :
    (f + g) ▷ Y = f ▷ Y + g ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_left'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left' {X X' : Envelope R C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : Envelope R C) :
    (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_middle'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_middle' (X : Envelope R C) {Y Y' : Envelope R C} (g : Y ⟶ Y')
    (Z : Envelope R C) :
    (X ◁ g) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X Y' Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (g ▷ Z)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_right'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_right' (X Y : Envelope R C) {Z Z' : Envelope R C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on' [CommRing R] [Linear R C] [Supercategory R C] {X Y : Envelope R C}
    {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (f : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (r : ZMod 2) (g : X ⟶ Y), toHom g ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj r → P g)
    (add : ∀ g h, P g → P h → P (g + h)) : P f

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.tensorHom_def'

@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_hom (X : Envelope R C) :

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_rightUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_inv (X : Envelope R C) :
    toHom (ρ_ X).inv = (ρ_ X.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_superTensorHom
statement:
theorem toHom_superTensorHom {X X' Y Y' : Envelope R C} {f : X ⟶ X'} {g : Y ⟶ Y'}
    {pf pg : ZMod 2} (hf : toHom f ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj X'.obj pf)
    (hg : toHom g ∈ parity (R := R) Y.obj Y'.obj pg) :
    toHom (MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom f g) =
      sign R (X.par * pg + pf * Y'.par + X.par * Y'.par + X.par * Y.par) •
        MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (toHom f) (toHom g)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerLeft (X : Envelope R C) {Y Y' : Envelope R C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    toHom (X ◁ g) = X.obj ◁ toHom (twist R X.par g)

theorem associator_naturality_left {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : C) :

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_middle (X : C) {Y Y' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (Z : C) :

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_of_whiskers
statement:
theorem MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_of_whiskers {C : Type w₁} [Category.{w₂} C]
    [MonoidalCategoryStruct C]
    (tensorHom_def : ∀ {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂),
      f ⊗ₘ g = f ▷ X₂ ≫ Y₁ ◁ g)
    (whiskerLeft_comp : ∀ (X : C) {Y Z W : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ W),
      X ◁ (f ≫ g) = X ◁ f ≫ X ◁ g)
    (comp_whiskerRight : ∀ {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (W : C),
      (f ≫ g) ▷ W = f ▷ W ≫ g ▷ W)
    (left : ∀ {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : C),
      (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z))
    (middle : ∀ (X : C) {Y Y' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (Z : C),
      (X ◁ g) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X Y' Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (g ▷ Z))
    (right : ∀ (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z'),
      (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h))
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : C} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) :
    ((f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ⊗ₘ f₃) ≫ (α_ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃).hom = (α_ X₁ X₂ X₃).hom ≫ (f₁ ⊗ₘ (f₂ ⊗ₘ f₃))

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_right
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_right (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.associator_whiskerLeft_ζL_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_whiskerLeft_ζL_ζL (X : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom =
      -((ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom ▷ X ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.associator_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_ζL (X Y : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 X Y).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (ζL (R := R) X).hom ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_whiskerLeft_ξ_inv
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_whiskerLeft_ξ_inv (X : C) :
    (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).inv =
      (ζR (R := R) X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.whiskerLeft_ζR_inv_associator_inv_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_ζR_inv_associator_inv_ζL (X : C) :
    𝛑 ◁ (ζR (R := R) X).inv ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).inv ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom ▷ 𝛑 =
      -((ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζR (R := R) X).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (X : C) :
    (β (R := R) X).hom = (𝛇).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom ≫ (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (𝛇).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement: theorem β_hom_mem (X : C) : (β (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X) (X ⊗ 𝛑) 0

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_naturality
statement:
theorem β_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (β (R := R) Y).hom = (β (R := R) X).hom ≫ f ▷ 𝛑

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_pi
statement: theorem β_pi : (β (R := R) 𝛑).hom = -𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_tensor
statement:
theorem β_tensor (X Y : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 X Y).hom ≫ (β (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom ≫ (α_ X Y 𝛑).hom =
      (β (R := R) X).hom ▷ Y ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 Y).hom ≫ X ◁ (β (R := R) Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_unit
statement: theorem β_unit : (β (R := R) (𝟙_ C)).hom ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom = (ρ_ 𝛑).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζL_hom_mem (X : C) : (ζL (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X) X 1

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_naturality
statement:
theorem ζL_naturality {X Y : C} {q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y).hom = sign R q • ((ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ f)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_pi
statement: theorem ζL_pi : (ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom = -(ζR (R := R) 𝛑).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζR_hom_mem (X : C) : (ζR (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (X ⊗ 𝛑) X 1

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_associator (X Y : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).inv ≫ (α_ X Y 𝛑).hom = X ◁ (ζR (R := R) Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator (X : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) X).inv ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 𝛑).hom = -(X ◁ (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator_ζL (X Y : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) X).inv ▷ Y ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 Y).hom ≫ X ◁ (ζL (R := R) Y).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_naturality
statement:
theorem ζR_naturality {X Y : C} {q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    f ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (ζR (R := R) Y).hom = sign R q • ((ζR (R := R) X).hom ≫ f)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem
statement: theorem ζ_inv_mem : (𝛇).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙_ C) 𝛑 1

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_comm
statement:
theorem ξ_comm (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom ≫ (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).inv =
      (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (β (R := R) X).hom ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).inv ≫
        (β (R := R) X).hom ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 𝛑).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom
statement: theorem ξ_hom : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom = (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).hom ≫ (𝛇).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom =

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq_neg
statement: theorem ξ_hom_eq_neg : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom = -((ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom ≫ (𝛇).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem
statement: theorem ξ_hom_mem : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) (𝟙_ C) 0

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_whiskerRight_leftUnitor

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_right (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    X ◁ (Y ◁ h) ≫ (α_ X Y Z').inv = (α_ X Y Z).inv ≫ (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_tensor
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_tensor (X Y : C) :
    (λ_ (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (α_ (𝟙_ C) X Y).inv ≫ (λ_ X).hom ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:

theorem rightUnitor_inv_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ρ_ X).inv ≫ f ▷ 𝟙_ C = f ≫ (ρ_ Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_tensor_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_tensor_inv (X Y : C) :
    (ρ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv = X ◁ (ρ_ Y).inv ≫ (α_ X Y (𝟙_ C)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal
statement: theorem unitors_equal : (λ_ (𝟙_ C)).hom = (ρ_ (𝟙_ C)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ
statement: theorem jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ : (jIso hF).hom ≫ F.map (𝛇C).hom = (𝛇D).hom ≫ hF.εIso.hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_mem
