name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.β_comm_left
statement:
theorem β_comm_left (X : C) :
    (jIso hF).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (hF.μIso 𝛑C X).hom ≫
        F.map (MonoidalPiSupercategory.β (R := R) X).hom =
      (𝛇D).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ρ_ X).inv ≫ F.map (X ◁ (𝛇C).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.β_comm_right
statement:
theorem β_comm_right (X : C) :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.β (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ (jIso hF).hom ≫
        (hF.μIso X 𝛑C).hom =
      (𝛇D).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ρ_ X).inv ≫ F.map (X ◁ (𝛇C).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.ξ_comm_aux
statement:
theorem ξ_comm_aux :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := D)).hom ≫ hF.εIso.hom =
      ((jIso hF).hom ▷ 𝛑D ≫ F.obj 𝛑C ◁ (jIso hF).hom) ≫ (hF.μIso 𝛑C 𝛑C).hom ≫
        F.map (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem γ_hom_eq (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).hom = (Q (R := R)).map (F.map (σ (R := R) X).inv) ≫
      (σ (R := R) (F.obj ((Q (R := R)).obj X))).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem_degree (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F]
    (X : C) : (γ R F X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_id
statement: theorem γ_id (X : C) : (γ R (𝟭 C) X).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_inv
statement:
theorem γ_inv (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).inv = F.map (σ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (σ (R := R) (F.obj X)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γ_naturality (F : C ⥤ D) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (Q (R := R)).map (F.map f) ≫ (γ R F Y).hom = (γ R F X).hom ≫ F.map ((Q (R := R)).map f)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_pi
statement:
theorem γ_pi (X : C) :
    (γ R (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)) X).hom = (PiSupercategory.β R 𝐐 X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ζ_hom_mem_degree (X : C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (𝚷.obj X) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ζ_inv_mem_degree (X : C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (𝚷.obj X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_mem_degree (X : C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (𝚷.obj (𝚷.obj X)) X 0

statement:
theorem σPowNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPowNat_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σPowNat_hom_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σPowNat R n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X (-n)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_hom_mem
statement: theorem σPow_hom_mem (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem σPow_hom_mem_degree (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X (-m)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_inv_mem
statement: theorem σPow_inv_mem (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_inv_mem_degree
statement: theorem σPow_inv_mem_degree (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X _ m

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem σPow_zero (X : C) : σPow R 0 X = Iso.refl X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σ_hom_mem
statement: theorem σ_hom_mem (X : C) : (σ (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝐐.obj X) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σ_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem σ_hom_mem_degree (X : C) : (σ (R := R) X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (𝐐.obj X) X (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σ_inv_mem
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem (X : C) : (σ (R := R) X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X (𝐐.obj X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σ_inv_mem_degree
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem_degree (X : C) : (σ (R := R) X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (𝐐.obj X) 1

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σ_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem σ_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝐐.map f ≫ (σ (R := R) Y).hom = (σ (R := R) X).hom ≫ f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbarPowNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem σbarPowNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbarPowNat_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbarPowNat_hom_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σbarPowNat R n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X n

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbar_hom_mem
statement: theorem σbar_hom_mem (X : C) : (σbar (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝐐⁻.obj X) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbar_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbar_hom_mem_degree (X : C) :
    (σbar (R := R) X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (𝐐⁻.obj X) X 1

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbar_inv_mem
statement: theorem σbar_inv_mem (X : C) : (σbar (R := R) X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X (𝐐⁻.obj X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbar_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbar_inv_mem_degree (X : C) :
    (σbar (R := R) X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (𝐐⁻.obj X) (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbar_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem σbar_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝐐⁻.map f ≫ (σbar (R := R) Y).hom = (σbar (R := R) X).hom ≫ f

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom {A B C D : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C)
    (H : C ⟶ D) : (associator F G H).hom = 𝟙 (F ≫ G ≫ H)

statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv {A B C D : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C)
    (H : C ⟶ D) : (associator F G H).inv = 𝟙 (F ≫ G ≫ H)

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.hom_def
statement: theorem hom_def (A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R) : (A ⟶ B) = GradedHom R A B

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (leftUnitor F).hom = 𝟙 F

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.leftUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (leftUnitor F).inv = 𝟙 F

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (rightUnitor F).hom = 𝟙 F

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.rightUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (rightUnitor F).inv = 𝟙 F

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val {A B C : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) {G K : B ⟶ C}
    (y : G ⟶ K) : (F ◁ y).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerLeft F.as.toSuperfunctor y.1

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {A B C : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} {F H : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ H)
    (G : B ⟶ C) : (x ▷ G).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerRight x.1 G.as.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.comp_toSuperfunctor
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_toSuperfunctor (F : GradedSuperfunctor R A B) (G : GradedSuperfunctor R B C) :
    (F.comp G).toSuperfunctor = F.toSuperfunctor.comp G.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.iSupIndep_degNat
statement: theorem iSupIndep_degNat (F G : GradedSuperfunctor R A B) : iSupIndep (degNat F G)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.id_toSuperfunctor
statement: @[simp] theorem id_toSuperfunctor : (id R A).toSuperfunctor = Superfunctor.id R A

StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.whiskerLeft_mem_degNat

StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.whiskerRight_mem_degNat
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_degNat {F H : GradedSuperfunctor R A B} {n : ℤ}
    {x : F.toSuperfunctor ⟶ H.toSuperfunctor} (hx : x ∈ degNat F H n)
    (G : GradedSuperfunctor R B C) :
    Superfunctor.whiskerRight x G.toSuperfunctor ∈ degNat (F.comp G) (H.comp G) n

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.whiskerRight_mem_hom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_hom {F H : GradedSuperfunctor R A B}
    {x : F.toSuperfunctor ⟶ H.toSuperfunctor} (hx : x ∈ (family R A B).hom F H)
    (G : GradedSuperfunctor R B C) :
    Superfunctor.whiskerRight x G.toSuperfunctor ∈ (family R A C).hom (F.comp G) (H.comp G)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCat.hom_def
statement: theorem hom_def (A B : QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R) : (A ⟶ B) = GradedHom R A B

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_tmul (U V W : SVec k) (u : U) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (α_ U V W).hom ((u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w) = u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_inv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_tmul (U V W : SVec k) (u : U) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (α_ U V W).inv (u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)) = (u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_naturality_left
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left {U U' : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ U') (V W : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerRight f V) W ≫ (associator U' V W).hom =
      (associator U V W).hom ≫ whiskerRight f (tensorObj V W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.coe_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_toLinearMap {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : ⇑(toLinearMap f) = ⇑f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_apply {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) (u : U) :
    (f ≫ g) u = g (f u)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.comp_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem comp_whiskerRight {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) (X : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (f ≫ g) X = whiskerRight f X ≫ whiskerRight g X

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_part
statement:
theorem ext_part {V : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] {f g : V →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ q (v : V), v ∈ V.part q → f v = g v) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_tensor
statement:
theorem ext_tensor {V W : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {f g : V ⊗[k] W →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ p q (v : V) (w : W), v ∈ V.part p → w ∈ W.part q → f (v ⊗ₜ w) = g (v ⊗ₜ w)) :
    f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {V W : SVec k} {f g : V ⟶ W} (h : ∀ v, f v = g v) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (V : SVec k) (v : V) : (𝟙 V : V ⟶ V) v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.isInternal_part
statement: theorem isInternal_part : DirectSum.IsInternal V.part

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.leftUnitor_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_tmul (V : SVec k) (r : k) (v : V) :
    (λ_ V).hom (r ⊗ₜ v) = r • v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_iff {p : ZMod 2} {v : V} : v ∈ V.part p ↔ V.proj p v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_one_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_one_iff {v : V} : v ∈ V.part 1 ↔ V.odd v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_zero_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_zero_iff {v : V} : v ∈ V.part 0 ↔ V.odd v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_sub_part_iff
statement: theorem mem_sub_part_iff {q : ZMod 2} {v : U} : v ∈ (sub V U hU).part q ↔ (v : V) ∈ V.part q

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.odd_apply_odd
statement: theorem odd_apply_odd (v : V) : V.odd (V.odd v) = V.odd v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ofHom_apply {V W : SVec k} (f : V →ₗ[k] W) (v : V) : ofHom f v = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofHom_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] theorem ofHom_toLinearMap {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : ofHom (toLinearMap f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofIsCompl_part_one
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_part_one (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (M₀ M₁ : Submodule k M)
    (h : IsCompl M₀ M₁) : (ofIsCompl M M₀ M₁ h).part 1 = M₁

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofIsCompl_part_zero
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_part_zero (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (M₀ M₁ : Submodule k M)
    (h : IsCompl M₀ M₁) : (ofIsCompl M M₀ M₁ h).part 0 = M₀

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofProd_mem_part_one
statement:
theorem ofProd_mem_part_one {V₀ V₁ : Type u} [AddCommGroup V₀] [Module k V₀] [AddCommGroup V₁]
    [Module k V₁] (v : V₁) : ((0, v) : ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁) ∈ (ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁).part 1

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofProd_mem_part_zero
statement:
theorem ofProd_mem_part_zero {V₀ V₁ : Type u} [AddCommGroup V₀] [Module k V₀] [AddCommGroup V₁]
    [Module k V₁] (v : V₀) : ((v, 0) : ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁) ∈ (ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁).part 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piObj_part
statement: theorem piObj_part (V : SVec k) (p : ZMod 2) : (piObj V).part p = V.part (p + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piObj_proj
statement: theorem piObj_proj (V : SVec k) (p : ZMod 2) : (piObj V).proj p = V.proj (p + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_add_proj
statement: theorem proj_add_proj : V.proj 0 + V.proj 1 = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_apply_add
statement: theorem proj_apply_add (v : V) : V.proj 0 v + V.proj 1 v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_apply_add'
statement: theorem proj_apply_add' (q : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj q v + V.proj (q + 1) v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part
statement:
theorem proj_apply_of_mem_part {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part q) :
    V.proj p v = if p = q then v else 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_comp_proj_add_one
statement: theorem proj_comp_proj_add_one (p : ZMod 2) : V.proj p ∘ₗ V.proj (p + 1) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_comp_proj_of_ne
statement: theorem proj_comp_proj_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : p ≠ q) : V.proj p ∘ₗ V.proj q = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_comp_proj_self
statement: theorem proj_comp_proj_self (p : ZMod 2) : V.proj p ∘ₗ V.proj p = V.proj p

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_mem_part
statement: theorem proj_mem_part (p : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj p v ∈ V.part p

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_one
statement: theorem proj_one : V.proj 1 = V.odd

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_one_proj_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem proj_one_proj_zero (v : V) : V.proj 1 (V.proj 0 v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_proj_apply
statement: theorem proj_proj_apply (p : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj p (V.proj p v) = V.proj p v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_proj_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem proj_proj_apply_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : p ≠ q) (v : V) :
    V.proj p (V.proj q v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_zero
statement: theorem proj_zero : V.proj 0 = LinearMap.id - V.odd

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_zero_proj_one
statement: @[simp] theorem proj_zero_proj_one (v : V) : V.proj 0 (V.proj 1 v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.restrictHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictHom_apply (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') (v : U) :
    (restrictHom (hU := hU) (hU' := hU') f hf v : W) = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.rightUnitor_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_tmul (V : SVec k) (r : k) (v : V) :
    (ρ_ V).hom (v ⊗ₜ r) = r • v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_apply
statement:
theorem sgn_apply (V : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) (v : V) :
    V.sgn b v = V.proj 0 v + sign k b • V.proj 1 v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem sgn_apply_of_mem {V : SVec k} (b : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part q) :
    V.sgn b v = sign k (q * b) • v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_comp_sgn
statement: theorem sgn_comp_sgn (V : SVec k) (a b : ZMod 2) : V.sgn a ∘ₗ V.sgn b = V.sgn (a + b)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_sgn_apply
statement: theorem sgn_sgn_apply (V : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.sgn b (V.sgn b v) = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sgn_zero (V : SVec k) : V.sgn 0 = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sub_odd_apply
statement: theorem sub_odd_apply (v : U) : ((sub V U hU).odd v : V) = V.odd v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sub_proj_apply
statement: theorem sub_proj_apply (q : ZMod 2) (v : U) : ((sub V U hU).proj q v : V) = V.proj q v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_def
statement: theorem tensorObj_def (V W : SVec k) : V ⊗ W = tensorObj V W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_odd_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorObj_odd_tmul (V W : SVec k) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (tensorObj V W).odd (v ⊗ₜ w) = V.proj 1 v ⊗ₜ W.proj 0 w + V.proj 0 v ⊗ₜ W.proj 1 w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_proj_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_proj_tmul (V W : SVec k) (q : ZMod 2) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (tensorObj V W).proj q (v ⊗ₜ w) =
      V.proj 0 v ⊗ₜ W.proj q w + V.proj 1 v ⊗ₜ W.proj (1 + q) w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_sgn
statement:
theorem tensorObj_sgn (V W : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (tensorObj V W).sgn b = map (V.sgn b) (W.sgn b)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorUnit_def
statement: theorem tensorUnit_def : 𝟙_ (SVec k) = unit

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tmul_mem_part
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_part {V W : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ∈ V.part p)
    (hw : w ∈ W.part q) : v ⊗ₜ[k] w ∈ (tensorObj V W).part (p + q)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_comp
statement:
theorem toLinearMap_comp {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) :
    toLinearMap (f ≫ g) = toLinearMap g ∘ₗ toLinearMap f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_id
statement: @[simp] theorem toLinearMap_id (V : SVec k) : toLinearMap (𝟙 V) = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_ofHom
statement: @[simp] theorem toLinearMap_ofHom {V W : SVec k} (f : V →ₗ[k] W) : toLinearMap (ofHom f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_proj_one_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_proj_one_apply (r : k) : (unit : SVec k).proj 1 r = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_proj_zero_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_proj_zero_apply (r : k) : (unit : SVec k).proj 0 r = r

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_sgn
statement: theorem unit_sgn (b : ZMod 2) : (unit : SVec k).sgn b = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_def
statement: theorem whiskerRight_def {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) : f ▷ W = whiskerRight f W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_id
statement: theorem whiskerRight_id (V W : SVec k) : whiskerRight (𝟙 V) W = 𝟙 (tensorObj V W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_tmul
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_tmul {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) (v : V) (w : W) :
    whiskerRight f W (v ⊗ₜ w) = f v ⊗ₜ w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_tmul'

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.tensorHom_permMat
statement:
theorem tensorHom_permMat {ι κ ι' κ' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι'] [Fintype κ']
    {X : ι → D} {Y : κ → D} {X' : ι' → D} {Y' : κ' → D} (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i))
    (e' : ι' ≃ κ') (ψ : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ Y' (e' i)) :
    tensorHom (permMat e φ) (permMat e' ψ) =
      permMat (X := fun x => X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ⊗ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e')
        (fun x => (φ x.1 ⊗ₘ ψ x.2 : X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2 ⟶ Y (e x.1) ⊗ Y' (e' x.2)))

theorem map_associator_hom (X Y Z : C) :
    F.map (α_ X Y Z).hom = (cF.μIso (X ⊗ Y) Z).inv ≫ (cF.μIso X Y).inv ▷ F.obj Z ≫
      (α_ (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (F.obj Z)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ (cF.μIso Y Z).hom ≫
        (cF.μIso X (Y ⊗ Z)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem map_leftUnitor_hom (X : C) :
    F.map (λ_ X).hom =
      (cF.μIso (𝟙_ C) X).inv ≫ cF.εIso.inv ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem map_rightUnitor_hom (X : C) :
    F.map (ρ_ X).hom =
      (cF.μIso X (𝟙_ C)).inv ≫ F.obj X ◁ cF.εIso.inv ≫ (ρ_ (F.obj X)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem map_whiskerLeft (Z : C) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem map_whiskerRight {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : C) :
    F.map (f ▷ Z) = (cF.μIso X Z).inv ≫ F.map f ▷ F.obj Z ≫ (cF.μIso Y Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counit_interchange (A : D) {Y Y' : D} (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ◁ g ≫ (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ Y' =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ Y ≫ A ◁ g

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange_hom

theorem counit_interchange_hom (A B : D) :
    F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ◁ (e.counitIso.hom.app B : F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ⟶ B) ≫
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ B =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ≫
        A ◁ (e.counitIso.hom.app B : F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ⟶ B)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange_inv

theorem counit_interchange_inv (A B : D) :

      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ B ≫
        A ◁ (e.counitIso.inv.app B : B ⟶ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B))

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.map₂_associator_inv'
statement:
theorem map₂_associator_inv' {B : Type u₁} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] {C : Type u₂}
    [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] (H : Pseudofunctor B C) {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    H.map₂ (α_ f g h).inv = (H.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ H.map f ◁ (H.mapComp g h).hom ≫
      (α_ (H.map f) (H.map g) (H.map h)).inv ≫ (H.mapComp f g).inv ▷ H.map h ≫
        (H.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp_central
statement:
theorem postcomp_central {pC : ∀ a : C, a ⟶ a} {pD : ∀ a : D, a ⟶ a} {pE : ∀ a : E, a ⟶ a}
    (eD : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pD b ⟶ pD a ≫ f)
    (eE : ∀ {a b : E} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pE b ⟶ pE a ≫ f)
    {F G : Pseudofunctor C D} (H : Pseudofunctor D E)
    (jF : ∀ a, pD (F.obj a) ≅ F.map (pC a)) (jG : ∀ a, pD (G.obj a) ≅ G.map (pC a))
    (jH : ∀ a, pE (H.obj a) ≅ H.map (pD a))
    (hH : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), H.map f ◁ (jH b).hom ≫ (H.mapComp f (pD b)).inv ≫
      H.map₂ (eD f) = eE (H.map f) ≫ (jH a).hom ▷ H.map f ≫ (H.mapComp (pD a) f).inv)
    (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax)
    (hη : ∀ a, eD (η.app a) ≫ (jF a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (pC a) =
      η.app a ◁ (jG a).hom) (a : C) :
    eE ((postcomp η H).app a) ≫ (jH (F.obj a) ≪≫ H.map₂Iso (jF a)).hom ▷ (postcomp η H).app a ≫
        (postcomp η H).naturality (pC a) =
      (postcomp η H).app a ◁ (jH (G.obj a) ≪≫ H.map₂Iso (jG a)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp_central
statement:
theorem precomp_central {pB : ∀ a : B, a ⟶ a} {pC : ∀ a : C, a ⟶ a} {pD : ∀ a : D, a ⟶ a}
    (eD : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pD b ⟶ pD a ≫ f)
    (P : Pseudofunctor B C) {F G : Pseudofunctor C D}
    (jP : ∀ a, pC (P.obj a) ≅ P.map (pB a)) (jF : ∀ a, pD (F.obj a) ≅ F.map (pC a))
    (jG : ∀ a, pD (G.obj a) ≅ G.map (pC a))
    (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax)
    (hη : ∀ a, eD (η.app a) ≫ (jF a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (pC a) =
      η.app a ◁ (jG a).hom) (a : B) :
    eD ((precomp P η).app a) ≫ (jF (P.obj a) ≪≫ F.map₂Iso (jP a)).hom ▷ (precomp P η).app a ≫
        (precomp P η).naturality (pB a) =
      (precomp P η).app a ◁ (jG (P.obj a) ≪≫ G.map₂Iso (jP a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_comp
statement:
theorem famMap_comp (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') {X Y : S}
    (f : d.FamAll X Y) : (Φ.comp Ψ).famMap f = Ψ.famMap (Φ.famMap f)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_id
statement: theorem famMap_id {X Y : S} (f : d.FamAll X Y) : (id d).famMap f = f

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.id_F
statement: @[simp] theorem id_F : (id d).F = 𝟭 S

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.id_γ_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem id_γ_hom_app (X : S) : (id d).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 (d.Q.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.self_F
statement: @[simp] theorem self_F : (self d).F = d.Q

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.self_γ_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem self_γ_hom_app (X : S) : (self d).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_comp_hom_app
statement:
theorem Γ_comp_hom_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).hom.app X = (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_comp_inv_app
statement:
theorem Γ_comp_inv_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).inv.app X = Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).inv.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even
statement:
theorem Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X ⟶ Ψ.F.obj X)
    (hnat : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 →
      Φ.F.map g ≫ x Y = x X ≫ Ψ.F.map g)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x ((d.pow i).obj X) = (d'.pow i).map (x X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_id_hom_app
statement: theorem Γ_id_hom_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) : ((id d).Γ i).hom.app X = 𝟙 ((d.pow i).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_id_inv_app
statement: theorem Γ_id_inv_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) : ((id d).Γ i).inv.app X = 𝟙 ((d.pow i).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_inv_app_comp_of_even
statement:
theorem Γ_inv_app_comp_of_even {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X ⟶ Ψ.F.obj X)
    (hnat : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 →
      Φ.F.map g ≫ x Y = x X ≫ Ψ.F.map g)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).inv.app X ≫ (d'.pow i).map (x X) = x ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_self_hom_app
statement:
theorem Γ_self_hom_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((self d).Γ i).hom.app X ≫ (d.succ i).hom.app X = (d.comm i).hom.app X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_zero_hom_app
statement: theorem Γ_zero_hom_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : S) : (Φ.Γ 0).hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_zero_inv_app
statement: theorem Γ_zero_inv_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : S) : (Φ.Γ 0).inv.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_famComp
statement:
theorem val_famComp (m : ℤ) {Z : C} (f : d.FamAll X Y) (g : d.FamAll Y Z) (i k : ℤ) :
    val t (d.famComp m f g) i k = val t f i (i - m) ≫ val t g (i - m) k

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_zero
statement: theorem val_zero (f : d.FamAll X Y) (j : ℤ) : val t f 0 j = f 0 j ≫ (τ t j Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (τNat t n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τNat t n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-n)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τNeg_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNeg_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧
      (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ ((n : ℤ) + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τ_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t i X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ t i X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-i)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_inv_mem
statement:
theorem τ_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t i X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ t i X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ i

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_succ
statement:
theorem τ_succ (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t (i + 1) X).hom = (d.succ i).inv.app X ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj X)).hom ≫ (τ t i X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_succ_inv
statement:
theorem τ_succ_inv (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t (i + 1) X).inv = (τ t i X).inv ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj X)).inv ≫ (d.succ i).hom.app X

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_zero
statement: theorem τ_zero (X : C) : τ t 0 X = Iso.refl _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.Q_map_eq
statement: theorem Q_map_eq {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : d.Q.map f = (t.σ X).hom ≫ f ≫ (t.σ Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.succ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem succ_hom_mem_degree (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (d.succ i).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.succ_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem succ_inv_mem_degree (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (d.succ i).inv.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.σ_inv_mem
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem (X : C) : (t.σ X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X (d.Q.obj X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.σ_inv_mem_degree
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem_degree (X : C) : (t.σ X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (d.Q.obj X) 1

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.counitIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem counitIso_hom_app (a b : B) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (counitIso (R := R) a b).hom.app f = (associator f (𝐪⁻ b) (𝐪 b)).hom ≫
      f ◁ (jj (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.homShift_Q
statement: @[simp] theorem homShift_Q (a b : B) : (homShift R a b).Q = postcomp R (𝐪 b)

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.homShift_Qi
statement: @[simp] theorem homShift_Qi (a b : B) : (homShift R a b).Qi = postcomp R (𝐪⁻ b)

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.ii_inv_mem
statement: theorem ii_inv_mem (a : B) : (ii (R := R) a).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a) (𝐪 a ≫ 𝐪⁻ a) 0

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.postShift_F
statement: @[simp] theorem postShift_F (a : B) (h : b ⟶ c) : (postShift R a h).F = postcomp R h

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.postShift_γ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem postShift_γ_hom_app (a : B) (h : b ⟶ c) (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (postShift R a h).γ.hom.app g = (γR (R := R) g h).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.postShift_γ_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem postShift_γ_inv_app (a : B) (h : b ⟶ c) (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (postShift R a h).γ.inv.app g = (γR (R := R) g h).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.preShift_F
statement: @[simp] theorem preShift_F (c : B) (f : a ⟶ b) : (preShift R c f).F = precomp R f

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.preShift_γ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem preShift_γ_hom_app (c : B) (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (preShift R c f).γ.hom.app g = (associator f g (𝐪 c)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.preShift_γ_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem preShift_γ_inv_app (c : B) (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (preShift R c f).γ.inv.app g = (associator f g (𝐪 c)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.q_iiU
statement:
theorem q_iiU (a : B) :
    Bicategory.whiskerRight (iiU (R := R) a).hom (Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 a)) ≫ (λ_ _).hom =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft (Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 a)) (jjU a).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.unitIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem unitIso_hom_app (a b : B) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (unitIso (R := R) a b).hom.app f = (rightUnitor f).inv ≫ f ◁ (ii (R := R) b).inv ≫
      (associator f (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻ b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.unit_counit_triangle
statement:
theorem unit_counit_triangle (a b : B) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (unitIso (R := R) a b).hom.app f ▷ 𝐪 b ≫ (counitIso (R := R) a b).hom.app (f ≫ 𝐪 b) =
      𝟙 (f ≫ 𝐪 b)

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.unit_counit_triangleU
statement:
theorem unit_counit_triangleU {a b : B} (f' : (⟨a⟩ : Underlying2 R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) :
    Bicategory.whiskerRight ((ρ_ f').inv ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft f' (iiU (R := R) b).inv ≫
        (α_ f' _ _).inv) (Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 b)) ≫
      (α_ (f' ≫ Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 b)) _ _).hom ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft (f' ≫ Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 b)) (jjU (R := R) b).hom ≫
          (ρ_ _).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γR_hom
statement:
theorem γR_hom (g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (γR (R := R) g h).hom = (associator g h (𝐪 c)).hom ≫ g ◁ (𝛄 h).hom ≫
      (associator g (𝐪 b) h).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γR_hom_mem
statement:
theorem γR_hom_mem (g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (γR (R := R) g h).hom ∈ parity (R := R) ((g ≫ h) ≫ 𝐪 c) ((g ≫ 𝐪 b) ≫ h) 0

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γR_inv
statement:
theorem γR_inv (g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (γR (R := R) g h).inv = (associator g (𝐪 b) h).hom ≫ g ◁ (𝛄 h).inv ≫
      (associator g h (𝐪 c)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γR_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γR_naturality {g g' : a ⟶ b} (η : g ⟶ g') (h : b ⟶ c) :
    η ▷ h ▷ 𝐪 c ≫ (γR (R := R) g' h).hom = (γR (R := R) g h).hom ≫ η ▷ 𝐪 b ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γR_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γR_naturality_right (g : a ⟶ b) {h i : b ⟶ c} (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    (γR (R := R) g h).hom ≫ (g ≫ 𝐪 b) ◁ θ = (g ◁ θ) ▷ 𝐪 c ≫ (γR (R := R) g i).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γU_comp
statement:
theorem γU_comp {a b c : Underlying2 R B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (γU (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom = (α_ f g _).hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft f (γU g).hom ≫
      (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight (γU f).hom g ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γU_id
statement:
theorem γU_id (a : Underlying2 R B) : (γU (R := R) (𝟙 a)).hom =
    (λ_ (Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 a.obj))).hom ≫ (ρ_ (Underlying2.hom1 (𝐪 a.obj))).inv

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γ_inv_mem
statement: theorem γ_inv_mem (f : a ⟶ b) : (𝛄 f).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝐪 a ≫ f) (f ≫ 𝐪 b) 0

name: StringDiagrams.CentralShift.γ_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γ_inv_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    𝐪 a ◁ η ≫ (𝛄 g).inv = (𝛄 f).inv ≫ η ▷ 𝐪 b

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_eq {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (hX : θ.X = θ'.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), θ.x f = eqToHom (by rw [hX]) ≫ θ'.x f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hX])) :
    θ = θ'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_X
statement: @[simp] theorem id_X (a : B) : (id F).X a = 𝟙 (F.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_x
statement:
theorem id_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (id F).x f = (rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (F.map f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplaxTrans_app (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    ((toOplaxTrans θ).app a).obj = θ.X a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_naturality
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplaxTrans_naturality (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b : Underlying2 R B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : ((toOplaxTrans θ).naturality f).1 = θ.x f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem vcomp_X (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) (a : B) :
    (vcomp θ θ').X a = θ.X a ≫ θ'.X a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x
statement:
theorem vcomp_x (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (vcomp θ θ').x f = (associator (F.map f) (θ.X b) (θ'.X b)).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ θ'.X b ≫
      (associator (θ.X a) (G.map f) (θ'.X b)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ θ'.x f ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (H.map f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.x_comp_eq
statement:
theorem x_comp_eq (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    θ.x (f ≫ g) = (F.mapComp f g).inv ▷ θ.X c ≫ (associator (F.map f) (F.map g) (θ.X c)).hom ≫
      F.map f ◁ θ.x g ≫ (associator (F.map f) (θ.X b) (G.map g)).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ G.map g ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (G.map f) (G.map g)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ (G.mapComp f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.x_id_eq
statement:
theorem x_id_eq (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : B) :
    θ.x (𝟙 a) = (F.mapId a).inv ▷ θ.X a ≫ (leftUnitor (θ.X a)).hom ≫
      (rightUnitor (θ.X a)).inv ≫ θ.X a ◁ (G.mapId a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.pi_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_map {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map η = η ▷ 𝛑 b

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.pi_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_obj {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj f = f ≫ 𝛑 b

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.whiskerLeft_ξ_pi
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_ξ_pi (a : B) :
    𝛑 a ◁ (𝛏 a).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝛑 a)).hom =
      (α_ (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a)).inv ≫ (𝛏 a).hom ▷ 𝛑 a ≫ (λ_ (𝛑 a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem β_inv_naturality {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    𝛑 a ◁ η ≫ (𝛃 g).inv = (𝛃 f).inv ≫ η ▷ 𝛑 b

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_pi_inv
statement: theorem β_pi_inv (a : B) : (𝛃 (𝛑 a)).inv = -𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξApp_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξApp_hom {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) f).hom = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξApp_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξApp_inv {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) f).inv = (ξHom (R := R) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_hom
statement:
theorem ξHom_hom {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) f).hom = (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛏 b).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_inv
statement:
theorem ξHom_inv {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) f).inv = (ρ_ f).inv ≫ f ◁ (𝛏 b).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ξHom_naturality {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝛑 b ▷ 𝛑 b ≫ (ξHom (R := R) g).hom = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom ≫ η

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_pi
statement:
theorem ξHom_pi {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom ▷ 𝛑 b

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξ_hom_app {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := a ⟶ b)).hom.app f = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξ_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξ_inv_app {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := a ⟶ b)).inv.app f = (ξHom (R := R) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.neg_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem neg_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (-η) ▷ h = -(η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_neg {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    f ◁ (-η) = -(f ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_zero {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} :
    f ◁ (0 : g ⟶ h) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem zero_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (0 : f ⟶ g) ▷ h = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom
statement:
theorem jIso_hom (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom = (𝛇 (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛇 a).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛇 a).hom = (𝛇 (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem jIso_hom_mem (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ∈ Supercategory.parity (R := R) (𝛑 (F.obj a)) (F.map (𝛑 a)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jβ_comm
statement:
theorem jβ_comm {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.map f ◁ (F.jIso b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝛑 b)).hom ≫
        F.map₂ (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) f).hom =
      (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (F.map f)).hom ≫ (F.jIso a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝛑 a) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jξ_comm
statement:
theorem jξ_comm (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj a) ≫ F.map (𝛑 a) ◁ (F.jIso a).hom ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (PiTwoSupercategory.ξ (R := R) a).hom =
      (PiTwoSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom

      (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (hF.γ.hom.app X) ≫ hF.β.hom.app ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj X) ≫

      (λ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_hcomp
statement:
theorem toHom_hcomp {f h : a ⟶ b} {g k : b ⟶ c} {x : f ⟶ h} {y : g ⟶ k} {px py : ZMod 2}
    (hx : toHom x ∈ parity (R := R) f.obj h.obj px)
    (hy : toHom y ∈ parity (R := R) g.obj k.obj py) :
    toHom (hcomp x y) =

        hcomp (toHom x) (toHom y)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.eq_of_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem eq_of_whiskerLeft {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : g ≫ f ≅ 𝟙 b)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (g ≫ f) (𝟙 b) 0) {h h' : b ⟶ c} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    η = (leftUnitor h).inv ≫ e.inv ▷ h ≫ (associator g f h).hom ≫ g ◁ f ◁ η ≫
      (associator g f h').inv ≫ e.hom ▷ h' ≫ (leftUnitor h').hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.eq_of_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem eq_of_whiskerRight {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : f ≫ g ≅ 𝟙 a)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ g) (𝟙 a) 0) {h h' : c ⟶ a} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    η = (rightUnitor h).inv ≫ h ◁ e.inv ≫ (associator h f g).inv ≫ η ▷ f ▷ g ≫
      (associator h' f g).hom ≫ h' ◁ e.hom ≫ (rightUnitor h').hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.mu_naturality_left

theorem mu_naturality_left {c d f : C} {k k' : c ⟶ d} (η : k ⟶ k') (l : d ⟶ f) :
    (hF.e c ◁ (η ▷ hF.e' d)) ▷ (hF.e d ≫ l ≫ hF.e' f) ≫ hF.mu k' l =

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.mu_naturality_right

      hF.mu k l ≫ hF.e c ◁ ((k ◁ η) ▷ hF.e' f)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.natComp_aux
statement:
theorem natComp_aux {𝒞 : Type*} [Bicategory 𝒞] {A B' C' A' B'' C'' : 𝒞} {sa : A ⟶ A'}
    {sb : B' ⟶ B''} {sc : C' ⟶ C''} {pf : A ⟶ B'} {pg : B' ⟶ C'} {pfg p0 p1 : A ⟶ C'}
    {qf : A' ⟶ B''} {qg : B'' ⟶ C''} {qfg q1 : A' ⟶ C''}
    (nfg : pfg ≫ sc ⟶ sa ≫ qfg) (n0 : p0 ≫ sc ⟶ sa ≫ (qf ≫ qg)) (nf : pf ≫ sb ⟶ sa ≫ qf)
    (ng : pg ≫ sc ⟶ sb ≫ qg) (β : qfg ⟶ qf ≫ qg) (bβ : pfg ⟶ p0) (c : p0 ⟶ pf ≫ pg)
    (c' : qf ≫ qg ⟶ qf ≫ qg) (k : pfg ⟶ p1) (l : p1 ⟶ pf ≫ pg) (k' : qfg ⟶ q1)
    (l' : q1 ⟶ qf ≫ qg)
    (h1 : bβ ▷ sc ≫ n0 = nfg ≫ sa ◁ β)
    (h2 : n0 ≫ sa ◁ c' = c ▷ sc ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ pf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nf ▷ qg ≫
      (α_ _ _ _).hom)
    (h3 : k ≫ l = bβ ≫ c) (h4 : k' ≫ l' = β) (hc' : c' = 𝟙 _) :
    nfg ≫ sa ◁ (k' ≫ l') = (k ≫ l) ▷ sc ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ pf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫
      nf ▷ qg ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.natComp_aux'
statement:
theorem natComp_aux' {𝒞 : Type*} [Bicategory 𝒞] {A B' C' A' B'' C'' : 𝒞} {sa : A ⟶ A'}
    {sb : B' ⟶ B''} {sc : C' ⟶ C''} {pf : A ⟶ B'} {pg : B' ⟶ C'} {pfg p1 : A ⟶ C'}
    {qf : A' ⟶ B''} {qg : B'' ⟶ C''} {qfg q0 q1 : A' ⟶ C''}
    (nfg : pfg ≫ sc ⟶ sa ≫ qfg) (n0 : (pf ≫ pg) ≫ sc ⟶ sa ≫ q0) (nf : pf ≫ sb ⟶ sa ≫ qf)
    (ng : pg ≫ sc ⟶ sb ≫ qg) (β : pfg ⟶ pf ≫ pg) (bβ : qfg ⟶ q0) (c : q0 ⟶ qf ≫ qg)
    (c' : pf ≫ pg ⟶ pf ≫ pg) (k : qfg ⟶ q1) (l : q1 ⟶ qf ≫ qg) (k' : pfg ⟶ p1)
    (l' : p1 ⟶ pf ≫ pg)
    (h1 : β ▷ sc ≫ n0 = nfg ≫ sa ◁ bβ)
    (h2 : n0 ≫ sa ◁ c = c' ▷ sc ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ pf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫ nf ▷ qg ≫
      (α_ _ _ _).hom)
    (h3 : k ≫ l = bβ ≫ c) (h4 : k' ≫ l' = β) (hc' : c' = 𝟙 _) :
    nfg ≫ sa ◁ (k ≫ l) = (k' ≫ l') ▷ sc ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ pf ◁ ng ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫
      nf ▷ qg ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.natId_aux
statement:
theorem natId_aux {𝒞 : Type*} [Bicategory 𝒞] {X Y : 𝒞} {σ : X ⟶ Y} {m m0 m1 : X ⟶ X}
    {m' m1' : Y ⟶ Y} (n : m ≫ σ ⟶ σ ≫ m') (n0 : m0 ≫ σ ⟶ σ ≫ 𝟙 Y) (i : m ⟶ m0)
    (i' : m' ⟶ 𝟙 Y) (j : m0 ⟶ 𝟙 X) (j' : 𝟙 Y ⟶ 𝟙 Y) (k : m ⟶ m1) (l : m1 ⟶ 𝟙 X)
    (k' : m' ⟶ m1') (l' : m1' ⟶ 𝟙 Y)
    (h1 : i ▷ σ ≫ n0 = n ≫ σ ◁ i') (h2 : n0 ≫ σ ◁ j' = j ▷ σ ≫ (λ_ σ).hom ≫ (ρ_ σ).inv)
    (h3 : k ≫ l = i ≫ j) (h4 : k' ≫ l' = i') (hj' : j' = 𝟙 _) :
    n ≫ σ ◁ (k' ≫ l') = (k ≫ l) ▷ σ ≫ (λ_ σ).hom ≫ (ρ_ σ).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.natId_aux'
statement:
theorem natId_aux' {𝒞 : Type*} [Bicategory 𝒞] {X Y : 𝒞} {σ : X ⟶ Y} {m' m1' : X ⟶ X}
    {m m0 m1 : Y ⟶ Y} (n : m' ≫ σ ⟶ σ ≫ m) (n0 : 𝟙 X ≫ σ ⟶ σ ≫ m0) (i' : m' ⟶ 𝟙 X)
    (i : m ⟶ m0) (j : m0 ⟶ 𝟙 Y) (j' : 𝟙 X ⟶ 𝟙 X) (k : m ⟶ m1) (l : m1 ⟶ 𝟙 Y)
    (k' : m' ⟶ m1') (l' : m1' ⟶ 𝟙 X)
    (h1 : i' ▷ σ ≫ n0 = n ≫ σ ◁ i) (h2 : n0 ≫ σ ◁ j = j' ▷ σ ≫ (λ_ σ).hom ≫ (ρ_ σ).inv)
    (h3 : k ≫ l = i ≫ j) (h4 : k' ≫ l' = i') (hj' : j' = 𝟙 _) :
    n ≫ σ ◁ (k ≫ l) = (k' ≫ l') ▷ σ ≫ (λ_ σ).hom ≫ (ρ_ σ).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.nat_lift_aux
statement:
theorem nat_lift_aux {a' b' a b : B} {sf sg : a' ⟶ b'} {ta : a' ⟶ a} {tb : b' ⟶ b}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} {ea : F.obj a' ⟶ F.obj a} {eb : F.obj b' ⟶ F.obj b} (sε : sf ⟶ sg)
    (ε : f ⟶ g) (nf : sf ≫ tb ⟶ ta ≫ f) (ng : sg ≫ tb ⟶ ta ≫ g) (ℓa : F.map ta ≅ ea)
    (ℓb : F.map tb ≅ eb) (hℓa : ℓa.inv ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hℓb : ℓb.hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (xf : F.map sf ≫ eb ⟶ ea ≫ F.map f) (xg : F.map sg ≫ eb ⟶ ea ≫ F.map g)
    (hf : F.map₂ nf = (F.mapComp _ _).inv ≫ F.map sf ◁ ℓb.hom ≫ xf ≫ ℓa.inv ▷ F.map f ≫
      (F.mapComp _ _).hom)
    (hg : F.map₂ ng = (F.mapComp _ _).inv ≫ F.map sg ◁ ℓb.hom ≫ xg ≫ ℓa.inv ▷ F.map g ≫
      (F.mapComp _ _).hom)
    (hn : F.map₂ sε ▷ eb ≫ xg = xf ≫ ea ◁ F.map₂ ε) :
    sε ▷ tb ≫ ng = nf ≫ ta ◁ ε

    hF.θ'nat (f ≫ g) ≫ hF.θ'app a ◁ (F.toPseudo.map₂ ((F.comp hF.inverse).toOplax.mapComp f g) ≫
        (F.toPseudo.mapComp _ _).hom) =
      (F.toPseudo.map₂ ((TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).toOplax.mapComp f g) ≫
          (F.toPseudo.mapComp _ _).hom) ▷ hF.θ'app c ≫ (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        F.toPseudo.map ((TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).toOplax.map f) ◁ hF.θ'nat g ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫
          hF.θ'nat f ▷ F.toPseudo.map ((F.comp hF.inverse).toOplax.map g) ≫
            (α_ _ _ _).hom
